jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Position Summary:**  
The Maintenance Coordinator will be the central point of contact for scheduling and tracking repair and maintenance requests across all locations. This role works closely with our in\-house construction and maintenance teams (a sister entity within our organization) to dispatch the right resource for each job, and coordinates with outside vendors when internal staff aren't available or the job requires specialized trades. This is primarily a desk\-based role. This role may also occasionally support new restaurant opening logistics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the main point of contact for maintenance and repair requests coming in from store locations (SoCal, Fresno, Hawaii)
* Triage incoming requests and determine whether to route to internal construction/maintenance staff or an outside vendor
* Schedule and dispatch internal maintenance/construction crews for repairs, installs, and facility work
* Schedule and coordinate outside vendors/technicians (HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, specialized trades) when internal staff can't cover the job
* Track open work orders from request to completion across both internal crews and outside vendors, following up to ensure timely resolution
* Maintain a master maintenance log/calendar across all 100\+ locations
* Communicate with store managers to prioritize urgent vs. routine repairs
* Coordinate scheduling between internal crews to avoid overlaps or gaps in coverage
* Negotiate and coordinate service calls, quotes, and invoices with third\-party vendors
* Monitor recurring issues by location/equipment type and flag patterns to leadership
* Assist with scheduling preventive maintenance programs (HVAC servicing, equipment inspections, etc.)
* Maintain vendor contact lists, service agreements, and warranty documentation for outside vendors
* Support occasional coordination tasks for new restaurant openings as needed
* Handle general administrative duties: invoices, purchase orders, vendor/crew files

**Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years experience in facilities coordination, maintenance scheduling, dispatch, or similar operations/admin role
* Strong organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple open work orders and coordinate both internal staff and outside vendors simultaneously
* Comfortable communicating with internal crews, vendors, and store\-level managers via phone/email
* Proficient in Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable learning new software/tracking systems
* Problem\-solver who can prioritize urgent issues under time pressure
* Reliable, punctual, and detail\-oriented
* Multi\-unit restaurant, retail, or facilities/property management experience is a plus

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Overview**


Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Project Coordinator in our Quality, Outcome Research, \& Analytics (QORA) department!


This is a full\-time, benefits\-eligible, grant\-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire April 1, 2027 with the possibility of extension.


This position can be home\-based.


The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work\-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award\-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work\-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.


**Responsibilities**


The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of health sciences research and measure development initiatives through project coordination, administrative support, stakeholder engagement, and program operations. Working closely with internal staff, subject matter experts, researchers, and external partners, this role coordinates meetings and activities, maintains project documentation and databases, supports reporting efforts, and ensures smooth day\-to\-day operations.


* Support day\-to\-day operations of initiatives, including scheduling internal, external, and cross\-functional meetings, managing agendas, capturing notes and action items, tracking follow\-up activities, coordinating materials, and maintaining project documentation.
* Develop, input, and maintain information in project tracking systems, databases, SharePoint sites, and other software platforms.
* Handle administrative and financial tasks, including processing invoices, tracking budgets and expenses, and supporting contract and grant administration activities.
* Support virtual meeting logistics and technology setup.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project participants, subject matter experts, and external partners, coordinating communications, responding to inquiries, and assisting with onboarding activities.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, status reports, meeting summaries, dashboards, stakeholder updates, and other materials aligned with project goals and timelines.
* Assist with the development and dissemination of program materials, templates, reports, and resources.
* Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, and meeting schedules to support successful execution of research and measure development activities.

**Qualifications**


* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of three (3\) years of relevant experience that includes administrative and/or project coordination experience.
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet specified timelines.
* Administrative expertise with sophisticated clerical responsibilities and data management.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal skills with proven ability to develop collaborative working relationships internally and externally.
* Experience coordinating meetings, events, or project activities across multiple stakeholder groups.

**Here are some of the preferred experience and skills we are seeking:**


* Bachelor's degree in health sciences, public health, healthcare administration, research, or a related field.
* Experience supporting health sciences, research, quality improvement, measurement, or healthcare\-related projects.
* Experience working with subject matter experts, researchers, healthcare professionals, or external partners.
* Knowledge of basic data tracking, reporting, or research support processes.

**Proficiency Requirement**


* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience working with project management, database, or collaboration systems is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**


The expected pay range will be $20\.51 per hour to $25\.64 per hour. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards \& Benefits to see more details.


* **Compensation** – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
* **Performance and Recognition** – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
* **Benefits** – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well\-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.

jobs.title: VISTA Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Piece by Piece is a Los Angeles nonprofit offering free mosaic art workshops to residents of South LA, Skid Row, and other neighborhoods affected by homelessness, trauma, or economic insecurity. Workshops promote healing, build skills, and generate income. As the VISTA Program Coordinator, you will build on the classroom, attendance, certification, and peer mentorship systems developed in Year Two. You will gather feedback from instructors, staff, and participants, then update classroom workflows, expand attendance and certification tracking, and launch the peer mentorship program by onboarding and matching trained mentors with new participants. You will finish by documenting every system in clear guides and training staff to maintain them. We are looking for someone with strong organizational skills, an interest in classroom or program operations, and comfort building simple tools, checklists, and training materials. This is a capacity building role. Rather than running these programs indefinitely, you will refine and scale systems that Piece by Piece staff can operate on their own after your term ends. You will gain experience in program design and nonprofit operations, along with training and professional development offered through AmeriCorps VISTA. This assignment begins October 19, 2026 and runs a full year of service in Los Angeles, California. To learn more, contact us using the information listed on this posting.  

  

  

**Member Duties :** Review usage data and feedback on classroom workflows, the attendance tracker, and the certification tracker from Year Two, and interview instructors, staff, and participants. Revise classroom setup and communication tools, and expand attendance and certification tracking to more classes. Onboard and match mentors from the Year Two peer mentorship pilot with new participants. Update user guides, training materials, and standard operating procedures for all systems, and train designated staff to maintain them. Document outcomes and hand off a written transition summary to program staff.
  

  

**Program Benefits :** Relocation Allowance , Health Coverage\* , Living Allowance , Choice of Education Award or End of Service Stipend .

This shared culture of passion and dedication pulses through Cedars\-Sinai and, it’s just one of the many reasons we’ve achieved our sixth\-consecutive Magnet designation for nursing excellence. Join us, and discover why U.S. News \& World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals!


The Clinical Program Coordinator, RN provides clinical leadership and program coordination for community\-based preventive health, immunization, screening, and outreach programs. This hands\-on role works with participants across the lifespan and helps expand access to preventive care, health education, and connections to ongoing healthcare and community resources.


About the Role


This position offers a distinctive combination of hands\-on nursing, clinical leadership, program coordination, education, and community engagement. It is well suited for an RN who enjoys preventive care, working with diverse populations, coordinating programs and events, and helping improve access to care outside the traditional hospital setting.

Since 1998, Sports Basement has been more than a sporting goods store \- we're a community hub offering the best brands at Basement prices, with giving back baked into our DNA. What started as a weekend\-only shop in a San Francisco warehouse has grown into multiple fully stocked Bay Area locations, several newly opened Southern California stores, in\-house snow and bike shops, a thriving rentals program, and a robust ecommerce website at sportsbasement.com. We've come a long way, and we couldn't be prouder of the company we've become.

We're here to help our communities shine a little brighter, live a little greener, and make the outdoors more fun and accessible for everyone. Because your gear is more than just stuff, and we're more than just a store.

* Couches before profit

jobs.description:
Piece by Piece is a Los Angeles nonprofit offering free mosaic art workshops to residents of South LA, Skid Row, and other neighborhoods affected by homelessness, trauma, or economic insecurity. Workshops help participants build confidence, promote wellness, and generate income. As the VISTA Outreach Coordinator, you will build on the referral and participant recruitment systems developed in Year Two. You will evaluate current referral partnerships, identify priority gaps, attend community events and resource fairs, and formalize new partnerships with community organizations. You will also design and pilot a standardized warm handoff process with program staff, then document it and train staff to run it after your service year. We are looking for someone comfortable representing an organization at public events, building relationships with community partners, and creating clear, simple tracking tools and documentation. This is a capacity building role focused on strengthening systems, not on carrying an ongoing caseload of individual participant follow up. You will design and test a referral process that staff can operate independently going forward. You will gain experience in community outreach and partnership development, along with training and professional development offered through AmeriCorps VISTA. This assignment begins October 19, 2026 and runs a full year of service in Los Angeles, California. To learn more, contact us using the information listed on this posting.  

  

  

**Member Duties :** Evaluate the strength and reach of referral partnerships and analyze CRM referral data to identify priority gaps. Attend community events, resource fairs, and service provider meetings, following up with leads. Formalize new referral partnerships and joint outreach efforts with community organizations. jobs.title: Event Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Ready to join a dynamic company in the hospitality and service industry where people help drive the success of the business? Since its inception in 1957, Invited has operated with the central purpose of building relationships and enriching the lives of our members, guests and more than 17,000 employees. We are the largest owner and operator of private clubs nationwide, with 130\+ country clubs, city clubs, and athletic clubs. Our Clubs offer first\-class amenities, including championship golf courses, modern workspaces, handcrafted cuisine, resort\-style pools, state\-of\-the\-art racquet facilities, fitness centers, and much more. Come be a part of this incredible and inclusive team at Invited! **Job Summary**
The Event Sales Coordinator assists with the planning and coordination of event sales at the club to enhance the member and/or guest experience. The Event Sales Coordinator works closely with the Event Sales Manager to ensure all event details are meticulously managed, from initial inquiry to final execution. This position is responsible for providing administrative support, maintaining client records, and ensuring smooth communication between the sales team, clients, and internal departments. The Coordinator plays a crucial role in supporting the achievement of the annual event sales plan by assisting with prospecting efforts and client interactions. **Reporting Structure**

* Reports to the Event Sales Director

 **Day to Day**

* Assist the Event Sales Manager with the coordination and execution of event sales, including managing event details, logistics, and client communication.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during the event planning process, ensuring all client needs and preferences are documented and communicated effectively.
* Support the creation and distribution of event proposals, contracts, event orders, floor plans and diagrams ensuring accuracy and attention to detail.
* Maintain and update the client database with accurate information, assisting in the development of a prospect inventory.
* Ensure that all event\-related documents, including contracts and payment records, are properly filed and organized.
* Assist with basic financial tracking, such as recording deposits and payments in coordination with the accounting team.
* Manage event supplies and inventory, coordinating with vendors as needed.
* Coordinate with the kitchen and service teams to ensure event details are communicated and executed as planned.
* Participate in regular sales and event meetings, providing updates on event status and client interactions.
* Provide general administrative support to the Event Sales Manager and Director as needed.

 **Additional Duties**

* Due to the dynamic nature of the club, employees are expected to assist others as needed and take on additional tasks as assigned by management.
* Follow all company, club, and department policies, procedures, and instructions.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and a commitment to excellence in interactions with members, colleagues, and staff.
* Follow safe working practices, ensuring compliance with safety guidelines and encouraging others to do the same.
* Take the initiative in personal and professional growth and maintain any required certifications relevant to your role.
* Address and resolve challenges using available resources, working with regional and corporate teams to support club operations.
* Attend daily briefings and actively engage in required activities to stay informed and contribute to the team’s success.

 **About You**
Required

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* A minimum of 1 year of experience in a customer\-facing or sales support role in the hospitality or events industry.


Preferred

* College coursework in hospitality, marketing, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of marketing and prospecting strategies.
* Basic understanding of Microsoft Office and event management software.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

 **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, and perform physical activities for extended periods.
* Ability to work in varying temperatures and environments, with potential exposure to dust, fumes, or gases.
* Capable of climbing ladders, squatting, kneeling, reaching, grasping, twisting, bending, and folding/unfolding as required.
* Able to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 25 lbs. occasionally.
* Effective communication skills, including talking and hearing, with sufficient visual acuity.

 **Primary Tools/Equipment**

* Computer
* Keyboard
* Telephone (3 lbs.)
* Copier (150 lbs.)
* General office supplies

 **Work Schedule**

* Attendance requirements for this position as outlined on the weekly schedule.
* Additional hours are required to meet deadlines of the position, including weekends and/or holidays.

 **What We Offer**
We believe in taking care of our team, and our Total Rewards package reflects that commitment. Your actual base pay will be determined by your skills, experience, education, location, and—if you're in a non\-exempt role—hours worked. While not all roles at Invited are full\-time, those full\-time team members have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes:* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Life insurance
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Generous paid time off and leave programs (*time off as required by applicable law is also provided for part time team members*)

  

Want to learn more? Visit www.invitedbenefits.com for full details.

jobs.title: Music Research Coordinator, Disney Music Group
jobs.description:
The Disney Music Group (DMG) is the music hub for The Walt Disney Company (TWDC), encompassing all aspects of music commercialization and marketing: recorded music (Walt Disney Records and Hollywood Records), Disney Music Publishing, and Disney Concerts. DMG distributes music both physically and digitally and also licenses music throughout the world in various forms of media including television, print, gaming, and consumer products.

**Role Overview:**


The Music Research team works closely with production partners across The Walt Disney Company's iconic brands on music cue sheets for productions presented by our world\-class entertainment studios. Our goal is to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of music reporting to performing rights organizations and interested parties worldwide. By doing so, the team supports royalty distributions, publishing revenue, and helps maintain compliance with industry reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Communicate with internal and external production stakeholders regarding Soundmouse onboarding and training, and provide ongoing support throughout the production lifecycle.
* Review quarterly promo reports and create music video cue sheets to submit to the Performing Rights Organizations (PROs).
* Review, edit, and approve domestic and international cue sheets as assigned.
* Review, edit, and approve Parks \& Resorts cue sheets.
* Research songs, music rights, and interested party information to support cue sheet preparation and reporting.
* Locate and provide cue sheets for owned, acquired, and licensed content, supporting a high volume of requests from internal teams, PROs, and external interested parties.
* Coordinate the transfer and retrieval of assets from physical archive storage.
* Handle various administrative and operational tasks as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 1\+ years of professional experience
* College degree and/or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
* General music industry knowledge (music publishing, licensing, and performing rights).
* Familiarity with cue sheets and music reporting workflows preferred.
* Soundmouse, RapidCue, or other automated cue sheet program experience preferred.
* Demonstrated research and analytical skills.
* Comfortable working with technology and able to learn new systems, databases, and workflows quickly.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
* Highly organized with sharp attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external partners.
* Resourceful problem\-solver with the ability to resolve routine issues and seek guidance or escalate as needed.
* Ability to manage assigned priorities and deadlines while maintaining accuracy.
* Must be available to work onsite 4 days per week (Monday\-Thursday). Fridays are remote with flexibility to work onsite as needed.

  


The hiring range for this position in Burbank, CA is $51,000 to $66,000 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Natural Collection Corp is a fast\-growing wholesale apparel company based in Los Angeles, operating multiple in\-house labels focused on premium resortwear and lifestyle fashion. Our primary brand, Mojito Collection, specializes in modern resortwear for men and women.

We focus primarily on wholesale and B2B partnerships, working with retailers, boutiques, and private\-label clients across the U.S., Latin America, and the Caribbean. With over 20 years of industry experience, we design, develop, and manufacture high\-quality apparel built for style, versatility, and long\-term brand growth.

**About the Role:** 

This is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Los Angeles, CA. The account manager will work closely with the CEO and sales team to drive wholesale revenue, manage customer relationships, generate new business, and deliver exceptional customer service.

This role blends **outbound sales, account management, and customer support**, with strong upside through commission on new and maintained accounts.

**Key Responsibilities: Sales, Outbound Calling \& Lead Generation**

* Work directly with the CEO to support key wholesale accounts and growth initiatives
* Open new wholesale accounts through proactive outreach, cold calling, follow\-ups, and relationship building
* Conduct outbound calling campaigns to generate leads, follow up on inquiries, promote collections, and drive new business
* Maintain and grow assigned accounts through consistent follow\-ups and reorder strategies
* Conduct customer follow\-ups approximately 30 days after shipment to encourage repeat orders
* Stay on top of sales representatives and assigned accounts to maximize reorder potential
* Target and develop specific brands and collections, including Mojito Collection and Couture Island

**Customer Support \& Relationship Management**

* Engage with customers via phone, email, and in person to understand needs and provide tailored solutions
* Handle inbound product inquiries with a strong sales and upselling approach
* Manage wholesale customer service issues and complaints professionally and efficiently
* Assist clients with product details, pricing, order support, and troubleshooting
* Maintain accurate customer records, communications, and order data within internal systems

**Sales Operations \& Presentations**

* Coordinate samples with production and provide updated price lists
* Create and deliver professional sales presentations and buyer decks
* Maintain pricing sheets and sales materials
* Utilize NuOrder to manage wholesale orders, accounts, and communications
* Leverage AI tools and digital systems to improve outreach, efficiency, and sales performance

**Travel \& Business Development**

* Travel as needed to visit accounts, open new accounts, attend trade shows, and support sales efforts

**Compensation \& Growth**

* Commission on every new account opened
* Commission on accounts assigned for ongoing management and revenue growth
* Significant upside as the company continues expanding

**Qualifications**

* Proven sales experience, customer service background, or wholesale/account management experience preferred
* Strong outbound calling, follow\-up, and relationship\-building abilities
* Comfortable engaging customers via phone, email, and in person
* Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple accounts and leads effectively
* Sales\-driven mindset combined with strong customer service professionalism
* Comfortable using wholesale platforms such as NuOrder (or ability to learn quickly)
* Proficiency with AI tools to support sales outreach and operations
* Strong computer literacy including Microsoft Excel, Word, and CRM\-style systems
* Ability to create polished PowerPoint presentations and professional sales slides
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong email etiquette
* Experience with data entry, record accuracy, and basic analysis preferred
* Familiarity with outbound sales strategies or call\-center style operations is a plus
* Bilingual or multilingual skills are a strong plus
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed
* Interest in fashion, apparel, or lifestyle brands is a plus

**Additional Note – Growth Mindset \& Opportunity**

We are looking for driven individuals who are willing to go the extra mile and grow alongside the company. Our brand is scaling, and we are seeking team members who are hardworking, proactive, and not limited by a traditional 9–5 mindset. This is an opportunity for motivated professionals who want to build something meaningful, take ownership of their role, and benefit from the long\-term upside of a growing business.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $20\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience with outbound sales or cold calling?
* Are you comfortable making daily outbound calls to generate new wholesale accounts and follow up on leads?

Work Location: In person

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Utilize technical expertise and strategic thinking to identify and drive revenue growth within named focus accounts by identifying new opportunities to develop business across our full range of products and services.

* Continually provide market and competitor feedback to the organization around customer trends, market development and competitive activities observed within your territory.

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related discipline as well as a minimum of 2 years field sales account management experience in life sciences, ideally in region.
* Demonstrable ability to speak to antibody\-based applications, proteomics, reagents and similar protein based solutions and products with customers and translate into business opportunities.
* Proven ability to build and manage relationships with scientific end\-users and decision\-makers in biopharma and academic markets.
* Experience in account management or technical support within life sciences with experience in selling solutions and services across complex research workflows
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to simplify complex scientific concepts, paired with strong organizational and project management abilities and a proactive, customer\-focused approach to problem\-solving

* Experience and knowledge of sales tools and various Oracle Platforms, CRMs, Sales Force etc.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you ready to take ownership of client partnerships and drive performance in facility management?**

  

Join City Wide Facility Solutions as a Facility Solutions Manager and play a key role in making our clients’ spaces shine while building your career in a collaborative, growth\-focused environment.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Be the go\-to expert for multiple client accounts, managing day\-to\-day operations, retention, and satisfaction.
* Customize service strategies and scheduling that exceed client expectations.
* Negotiate service agreements and pricing for new contracts and add\-on solutions.
* Oversee contractor relationships, ensuring compliance, quality, and clear communication on performance.
* Conduct site walkthroughs to verify standards, resolve issues, and champion excellence.
* Partner with Night Managers and the Director of Operations to execute and enhance service delivery.
* Track service activities, supplies, and client feedback in our advanced CRM and planning tools.
* Respond quickly to client concerns, troubleshooting and resolving issues with urgency.
* Monitor and manage staffing and resource needs to maintain outstanding service.

**Why City Wide:**

* Competitive salary, benefits, and growth potential.
* Dynamic, supportive team culture focused on excellence and client impact.
* Opportunities for advancement and professional development.
* Make a real difference for clients, contractors, and your career.

**Ready to drive performance and make an impact? Apply now!**

 **Requirements** **You’ll Succeed Here If:**

* You have 3\+ years’ experience in facility management, operations, or building services.
* You’re detail\-oriented, proactive, and confident in building relationships.
* You communicate clearly—verbally and in writing—with clients and teams.
* Expert in Microsoft Office and comfortable with database/CRM technology.
* You hold a high school diploma (Bachelor’s degree preferred).
* You have reliable transportation for on\-site visits.
* **Candidate must reside in or near the Long Beach \- Southwest Los Angeles area.**

  

**Benefits**  

City Wide offers a competitive salary, including commission for this position. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision and PTO.

  

More on City Wide...


City Wide Facility Solutions is the largest management company in the building maintenance industry and services Kansas City\-based businesses. We have over 60 years of business and continue to experience healthy business growth across our communities. Our culture supports the company’s Mission: to create a Ripple Effect by positively impacting the people and communities they serve. Learn more at www.gocitywide.com


City Wide is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (6-month project hire)
jobs.description:
**Skydance Games**, a division of **Paramount, a Skydance Corporation,** is building the future of franchise\-driven interactive entertainment. As part of a global storytelling company defined by iconic worlds and multigenerational fandom, we see gaming not as an extension of our brands, but as one of the most powerful ways their stories come to life and evolve alongside the audiences who love them.  

  

Through creativity, collaboration, and trust, we empower our teams to push boundaries and turn bold ideas into experiences that resonate with fans around the world.  

  

Do you want to craft games that challenge expectations and inspire players? Come build something extraordinary with us.

For more information on how we process your personal information, please review the Privacy policy located at https://privacy.paramount.com/recruitment\-privacy\-notice.

\-  

Skydance/Paramount Games is looking for an experienced and passionate Social Media Manager to develop and execute the social media strategy for the brand and all upcoming titles. You will work closely with our global partners and internal departments on all global strategy and planning across all platforms and channels. You’ll lead all content development, shoots and collaborations with internal and external Paramount partners to publish content. You’ll help define the brand



This role requires attention to detail, careful adherence to deadlines, a keen ability to pivot, and the ability to stay cool under pressure. It will also be an absolute blast, providing the opportunity to create content with world\-famous and beloved IPs; work alongside a historic development team; and the ability to lead world\-class social marketing campaigns.



The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of executing industry\-leading social media campaigns for a diverse array of titles and be comfortable playing a managerial role in a fast\-paced marketing team, setting standards through creativity and collaboration, and directly control brand social media channels.


* This will be a 6 month project hire with the potential for extension and/or conversion to staff hire.



### **Responsibilities: Include, but are not limited to:**

* Lead the strategy and execution of all tactics, social media opportunities and events tied to game launches.
* Lead creation of social content from concept through delivery and publishing, ensuring content adheres to all brand and IP requirements and supports growth for title and brand.
* Develop and pitch social\-first content series that grow and sustain a fan\-first audience, turning ideas into engaging, platform\-native executions.
* Work with all internal and external partners to ensure social and community beats and activations are aligned and executed between necessary parties.
* Manage all publishing and community engagement across all social media channels including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube and Threads.
* Collaborate proactively with teams managing creator activations to ensure correct amplification of the title’s messaging and brand pillars via influencer content.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators across social platforms, using data\-driven analysis to improve engagement, reach, and conversion rates.
* Keep up to date on industry best practices and provide recommendations for internal strategies. Be the driver for new platform experimentation and adoption.
### **Requirements**

* 5\+ years relevant work experience related to video game marketing.
* Track record of launching a minimum of 1 shipped AAA title for the US market.
* Strong understanding of the current video games landscape and modern social marketing tactics.
* Strong spoken/written communicator for partner, media, and business audiences.
* Have an affinity for pop culture, legendary brands in television and film.
* Experience working with global partners to build and execute social strategies, manage internal and partner stakeholders and navigating layered approval processes.
* Intermediate skills in Photoshop, Premiere, Sprinklr and TalkWalker.
* Great interpersonal communication skills – able to help others and ask for help when needed.
* Experience working with both creative minds and corporate entities.
* Self\-starter and strong team player who can work independently and responsibly.
* Experience managing and working closely with agencies.
The annual salary range for this position in Los Angeles is $85,000 – $125,000\. The salary offered may vary based on the candidate’s location, qualifications, experience and relevant expertise, among other factors.  

Paramount, a Skydance Corporation is a diversified media company creating high quality, event\-level entertainment for global audiences. The Company brings to life stories of immersive worlds across its feature film, television, interactive/games, and animation divisions.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a creative, fashion\-driven, and results\-oriented **Social Media Manager** to lead the social media presence and growth of CALI1850, Lazy Sunday, and Khaki \& Blue.

This is a hands\-on position for someone who understands fashion, social media culture, content creation, brand storytelling, and performance. We are not looking for someone who only schedules posts.

The ideal candidate can take ownership of each brand's social presence \- from content planning and execution to community engagement, influencer coordination, paid social support, analytics, and growth. You will work closely with our Design and E\-Commerce teams while taking primary ownership of social media strategy and execution.

Key ResponsibilitiesSocial Media Strategy \& Brand Management

· Develop and execute distinct social media strategies for CALI1850, Lazy Sunday, and Khaki \& Blue.

· Establish a clear and consistent social identity, voice, and visual direction for each brand.

· Create monthly and weekly social media content calendars.

· Identify relevant fashion, lifestyle, cultural, and social media trends, then translate them into brand\-appropriate content for each target customer.

Content Creation \& Execution

· Plan and manage Instagram posts, Reels, Stories, TikTok content, and other relevant social channels.

· Create engaging short\-form content using available product, model, lifestyle, and behind\-the\-scenes assets.

· Coordinate with designers on new products, collections, seasonal stories, and key items.

· Write strong, brand\-appropriate captions and social copy.

· Coordinate product shoots and social content shoots when necessary.

· Maintain a consistent posting schedule across all brands.

Community \& Influencer Management

· Monitor comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and customer engagement.

· Build relationships with followers and strengthen each brand's online community.

· Identify and coordinate appropriate influencers, creators, and micro\-influencers.

· Develop product seeding and collaboration opportunities and track creator performance.

Growth \& Paid Social

· Develop strategies to increase qualified followers, engagement, website traffic, and conversion.

· Work with the E\-Commerce team on Instagram/Facebook advertising, boosted posts, and campaign initiatives.

· Test creative concepts, audiences, formats, and messaging.

· Identify high\-performing organic content that can be expanded through paid promotion.

Analytics \& Reporting

· Track weekly and monthly KPIs, including follower growth, reach and impressions, engagement rate, Reels/video views, website traffic, conversion and sales when measurable, and top\-performing products and content.

· Prepare a concise weekly Social Media Performance Report.

· Recommend specific actions based on performance data rather than simply reporting numbers.

Qualifications

· **Experience:** 3\-5\+ years of hands\-on social media experience, preferably in fashion, apparel, beauty, lifestyle, or consumer brands.

· **Platforms:** Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, and emerging social platforms.

· **Audience \& trends:** Strong understanding of fashion trends and young consumer behavior.

· **Growth record:** Demonstrated experience growing a brand's social media audience and engagement.

· **Content:** Experience creating short\-form video content, especially Reels and TikTok.

· **Creative judgment:** Strong visual judgment and understanding of fashion merchandising and branding.

· **Communication:** Excellent written communication and caption\-writing skills.

· **Tools:** Comfortable working with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or similar content creation tools.

· **Preferred:** Understanding of Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager.

· **Additional pluses:** Shopify/e\-commerce experience and influencer or creator marketing experience.

Portfolio Requirement

**Please include links to social media accounts you have personally managed.**

Applicants should be prepared to explain and substantiate:

· Which accounts they managed and their specific responsibilities.

· Starting and ending follower counts and engagement improvements.

· Examples of successful Reels, TikToks, or campaigns.

· Analytics or other measurable results from their work.

What We Are Looking For

**Creative enough to understand fashion.**  
**Analytical enough to understand performance.**  
**Hands\-on enough to create and post content.**  
**Organized enough to manage multiple brands.**  
**Commercial enough to understand that social media ultimately needs to support brand growth and sales.**

This position will have meaningful ownership over the social media growth of our brands and will work directly with our Design and E\-Commerce teams.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and portfolio links, including examples of accounts and campaigns you personally managed. Applications without relevant work samples or measurable results may not receive priority consideration.

Recommended Screening Question

**Please provide 2\-3 Instagram or TikTok accounts you personally managed, the starting and ending follower counts, one campaign you consider successful, and the measurable result.**

jobs.title: Production Coordinator – Home Improvement
jobs.description:
Production Coordinator / Construction Project Coordinator – Home Improvement

**C\&M Home Revival \| Long Beach, CA**  
**Full\-Time \| $25–$30/hour, depending on experience**  
**Monday–Friday \| In Office**

Help Us Keep Great Projects Moving.

C\&M Home Revival is a growing home improvement company looking for an **experienced Production Coordinator / Construction Project Coordinator** to join our team in Long Beach.

This is a key position within our production operation. You'll be responsible for helping move projects from **contract to completion**, working directly with homeowners, project managers, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and our internal team.

We're looking for someone who already understands the pace and moving parts of residential construction and can step in, take ownership, and make things happen.

**Must Have:**

**Experience with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is required.**

You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets, organizing information, tracking multiple projects, and keeping details accurate.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll help keep multiple projects moving at the same time — making sure the right people, materials, paperwork, appointments, and information are all in place.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Coordinate residential home improvement projects from **contract through completion**
* Schedule pre\-site meetings, installations, inspections, deliveries, and subcontractor work
* Coordinate schedules between homeowners, project managers, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams
* Order and track project materials and identify potential shortages or delays
* Confirm projects are properly prepared before crews arrive
* Track permits, inspections, approvals, contracts, change orders, and completion documents
* Maintain accurate project information, notes, schedules, and updates in the CRM
* Communicate project schedules and updates with homeowners
* Follow up with subcontractors, installers, vendors, and internal team members
* Identify scheduling conflicts and production issues before they become larger problems
* Help resolve issues and keep projects moving when things don't go according to plan
* Coordinate punch\-list items, corrections, inspections, and final completion
* Help ensure final documentation and payments are collected
* Assist with warranty and service coordination when needed
* Maintain organized project files and documentation
* Track outstanding items until they are completed
* Keep management informed of project status, delays, and issues

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with **real construction or home improvement experience**.

You don't have to have the exact title of "Production Coordinator." If you've worked in construction operations, project coordination, scheduling, roofing, remodeling, general contracting, windows \& doors, solar, HVAC, restoration, or a similar industry, your experience may translate very well into this position.

We're looking for someone who is:

* Experienced in residential construction or home improvement
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Comfortable managing multiple projects at once
* Strong with scheduling and follow\-up
* Comfortable using **Excel or Google Sheets**
* Comfortable learning and using CRM/project management software
* Professional and confident communicating with homeowners
* Comfortable communicating with subcontractors, installers, vendors, and internal teams
* Proactive when problems arise
* Able to prioritize competing deadlines
* Able to work independently and take ownership
* Reliable and consistent with follow\-through
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment

**Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.**

This Isn't a "Sit at a Desk and Wait" Position

Construction has a lot of moving pieces.

A project gets sold.

Then the real work begins.

**Materials need to be ordered.**

**Permits need to be tracked.**

**Customers need to be contacted.**

**Installers need to be scheduled.**

**Subcontractors need to show up.**

**Inspections need to happen.**

**Problems need to be solved.**

And when something doesn't go according to plan, someone needs to recognize it, communicate it, and get it back on track.

**That's where you come in.**

We're looking for someone who naturally thinks:

What needs to happen next? Who is responsible? What are we waiting on? And what can I do to move this forward?

You shouldn't have to be reminded to follow up.

You shouldn't be comfortable letting something sit unresolved.

And you shouldn't wait for a customer to call before realizing there's a problem.

We want someone who **takes ownership and follows things through.**

What Success Looks Like

At the end of the day, your job is simple:

**Keep projects organized. Keep people informed. Keep jobs moving.**

A successful Production Coordinator knows the status of their projects, knows what needs to happen next, and knows what is holding a project up.

If a material hasn't arrived — you know about it.

If an installer hasn't confirmed — you follow up.

If an inspection needs to be scheduled — you get it moving.

If a homeowner needs an update — they hear from us before they have to ask.

If something goes wrong — you help find the solution.

**You become the person the team can rely on to keep things moving.**

Why Join C\&M Home Revival?

C\&M Home Revival is growing, and we're building a team of people who want to be part of that growth.

This is an opportunity to join a company where your work has a direct impact on the customer experience and the success of our projects.

We're looking for people who take pride in their work, want to grow professionally, and enjoy being part of a team where everyone has an important role in getting the job done.

Compensation \& Benefits

* **$25–$30/hour**, depending on experience
* *Full\-time* position
* Monday–Friday schedule
* In\-office position
* Paid training on company systems and proc

jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator: Mobile \& Permanent School Pantry**

**Temporary Position Description**

**Location**: Irvine, CA

**Reports To:** Program Supervisor

**Status**: Full\-Time, Hourly, Non\-Exempt; $26\.28 \- $27\.83/hour (DOE)

**Schedule**: Monday – Friday, 40 hours/week, Hybrid: in\-office 3 days \& remote 2 days

Would you like to go to work knowing that every day you’ll be making a real difference in the lives of community members in Orange County? At Second Harvest Food Bank that’s exactly what you’ll be doing – contributing to our mission to provide food for those who need it. You’ll be working alongside team members who are committed to living out the Food Bank’s core values of **Integrity \& Accountability, People First, Compassion, Purpose Driven, and Stewardship**. **Come join our upbeat, collaborative team who are improving lives every day.**

**About Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County**

Second Harvest Food Bank’s (SHFB) Vision: An Orange County with food and nutritional security for all. Our Mission: In collaboration with our partners, we provide dignified, equitable and consistent access to nutritious food, creating a foundation for community health. Since 1983 we have been a source of food security for all members of our community when they need our help.

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:** 

The role of the Program Coordinator is to manage the Mobile School Pantry \& Permanent School Pantry Programs. The primary objective of this position is to coordinate all aspects of both feeding programs to ensure food\-insecure individuals, families and children are being provided fresh, nutritious food at locations throughout Orange County.

The Mobile School Pantry (MSP) Program entails free “farmer’s market” style distributions at schools once a month – overseen and run by school staff and parent volunteers. Each distribution provides fresh produce and other perishable and staple items for 90\-250 families each month. We currently have 76 schools participating in the MSP program.

The Permanent School Pantry (PSP) Program involves distributing food at 7 on\-site pantries at K\-12 schools and community centers, with distributions happening multiple days each week. Clients book appointments to “shop” from the pantries on a weekly basis to select their groceries.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

**Mobile School Pantry and Permanent School Pantry**

* Oversee all aspects of coordinating the MSP Program and the PSP Program.
* Develop, maintain, and cultivate new and existing MSP and PSP partnerships.
* Train and supervise a portfolio of MSP and PSP sites. Set proper expectations for program operations to ensure the program model is carried out by partner, staff, and volunteers at all times. Training for parent volunteers will be in English and/or Spanish.
* Carry out new partner onboarding processes, re\-application processes, as well as on\-site, hands\-on partner training and re\-training as needed.
* Coordinate site delivery schedules with each partner and SHFB Logistics Department.
* Ensure monthly reporting is completed on\-time and accurately by all partners. Proactively look for anomalies in the data and seek answers from partners to address concerns.
* Proactively look for solutions to partner challenges in executing both programs. Including providing guidance and/or working with internal SHFB departments to overcome obstacles.
* Conduct compliance site visits at each MSP and PSP distribution location. Visit all partners once or twice per year, as needed.
* Ensure partner compliance with program rules and regulations, as detailed in the MSP \& PSP Program Agreements.
* Proactively look for ways to continuously improve both programs, including their effectiveness and how we can continue to better meet the needs of our partners and their clients.
* Ensure all Program information in documents, files, and spreadsheets is kept up to date.
* Communicate and work with SHFB Logistics and Operations departments to effectively execute the MSP Program and PSP Program as needed.
* Demonstrate Service Excellence and Integrity when carrying out all aspects of program management.
* Provide continuous feedback and insight to the Product Flow Specialist about product needs; advocate on behalf of MSP \& PSP partners so that we can better understand their needs and build our operating plan around those insights.
* Actively participate in weekly team meetings and report updates, concerns, and successes in group meetings and at 1:1s.
* Attend webinars and trainings to increase food bank, food \& nutritional insecurity, and Feeding America knowledge.
* Assist in collecting client stories for Grant Reports and various Development Department needs.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:**

* Ability to lift 25\-50 pounds to carry equipment and supplies as needed.
* Regular driving throughout Orange County.
* Extended periods of sitting working on computer or on phone.
* Indoor office environment, indoor warehouse environment with moderate noise at food bank location.
* Up to 25% of time spent off\-site at Partner locations and attending various meetings.
* Office hours are 8am – 4:30pm, but schedule varies based on department needs. Possible evening and weekend hours.

**REQUIREMENTS:** 

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience.
* Must have prior professional experience in non\-profit or program coordination.
* Bilingual in Spanish is required, in addition to English. Must be able to read, write, and present to an audience in both English and Spanish.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* A professional who is a reliable, proactive communicator and actively engaged member of the team.
* Self\-starter with the ability, confidence, and good judgment to move projects forward with minimal supervision from direct Supervisor.
* Nurture strong professional relationships with coworkers, partners – current and potential, and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: ReStore Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Restore Social Media Coordinator brings the ReStore marketing calendar to life through timely, mission\-aligned content, and manages the day\-to\-day execution of ReStore’s social media presence: content creation, photography and video, publishing, and community engagement.


The ideal candidate is creative, organized, comfortable in a fast\-paced retail environment, and able to recognize compelling content opportunities as they happen.


This position is **Part\-Time**, 25 \- 28 hours a week

**Responsibilities**

**Content Creation \& Publishing**

* Create and publish content across Instagram and Facebook according to the established ReStore marketing calendar, maintaining the weekly cadence detailed under Weekly Content Expectations.
* Capture, edit, and publish photos and short\-form video (Reels, Stories) of merchandise, store activity, employees, donations, and events, including music, text overlays, and transitions as appropriate.
* Write captions and calls\-to\-action that support sales, donations, events, and Habitat’s mission, and maintain consistent brand voice and visual identity across channels in alignment with organization\-wide brand standards.
* Plan content capture in advance for major campaigns and events, while staying flexible to cover timely merchandise, trends, and unplanned opportunities.
* Regularly visit ReStore locations to source fresh content, and maintain an organized digital library of photos, video, and templates, repurposing content across formats to maximize its value.
* Verify pricing, dates, locations, and other promotional details for accuracy before publication.

**Community Management \& Customer Engagement**

* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, and mentions during scheduled daily check\-in windows, in a timely, friendly, and professional manner consistent with ReStore’s brand voice.
* Answer routine customer questions (locations, hours, merchandise, promotions) and loop in store teams for anything requiring additional information.
* Escalate customer complaints, sensitive issues, or mission\-related inquiries to the appropriate team member.
* Engage with followers to strengthen community relationships and convert online engagement into store visits, donations, and event participation.

**Digital Design \& Email Support**

* Create campaign graphics, banners, and social frames using established brand templates, and perform basic photo editing (cropping, resizing, color correction).
* Prepare and edit photography and graphics for the weekly ReStore email blast.
* Coordinate with internal staff or external marketing partners when additional creative support is needed.

**Performance \& Reporting**

* Track platform analytics (reach, engagement, video views, follower growth) and use the insights to identify which content and campaigns perform best.
* Provide periodic updates to leadership on content performance, audience trends, and notable successes, evaluated on meaningful engagement and business impact rather than follower count alone.
* Recommend new content ideas, trends, and creative concepts based on performance data and platform trends.




**Weekly Content Expectations**

* Stories: Monday through Friday
* Primary posts: 7 per week, including at least 3 Reels/short\-form videos
* Community management: scheduled daily check\-in windows (see above)
* Email marketing: weekly email blast photography/image prep


Quantity should never come at the expense of quality, accuracy, or brand consistency.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in nonprofit management, fundraising, or related field.
* At least 2 years of experience in creating social media content for a business, nonprofit, or brand, including intern experience.
* Demonstrated ability to capture engaging photography and video using a smartphone and/or camera.
* Knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, Stories, Reels, and short\-form video editing.
* Working knowledge of Canva, Adobe Express, Photoshop, or similar tools, with basic graphic design skills (composition, typography, layout).
* Strong written communication skills for concise, engaging social copy.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines and work independently.
* Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment on when to escalate customer concerns, and the ability to accept feedback and revise creative work quickly.
* Experience with social media scheduling/analytics tools and email marketing platforms.
* Portfolio demonstrating social content, photography, video, or design work.

**About Us**
============


Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world.


The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.


**Role Summary**
================


We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Lab Operations Coordinator to keep engineering labs and test assets supplied, traceable, organized, and ready for use. This hands\-on role owns purchasing coordination, receiving, inventory, equipment records, supplier follow\-up, shipments, returns, and lab workflow for the Systems Integration and Diagnostics labs, and provides defined shared services — SAP transaction support and cross\-site part transfers — to partner engineering teams.


The position is based in Irvine, where the majority of builds and stocked material are located, and supports Palo Alto through remote coordination.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Purchasing and suppliers**

* Coordinate SAP requests, purchase orders, quotes, order status, backorders, invoices, returns, RMAs, and supplier follow\-up.
* Serve as the SAP execution point for partner engineering teams, absorbing recurring transactional work that currently fragments engineering time.
* Verify request completeness and escalate pricing, vendor, approval, or sourcing decisions to the appropriate owner..

**Inventory and equipment**
---------------------------


* Maintain accurate records for lab equipment, test assets, components, consumables, harness materials, spares, and shared tools within the Systems Integration and Diagnostics labs.
* Coordinate receiving, inspection, labeling, storage, issuance, asset records, calibration visibility, cycle counts, and discrepancy resolution.

**Shipping, logistics, and expediting**
---------------------------------------


* Coordinate builds with previously qualified suppliers for established, validated designs — order placement, part collection, delivery scheduling, receiving readiness, and dock coordination — so engineers are not managing routine build logistics.
* Chase and consolidate parts across sites against engineer\-provided BOMs; for example, sourcing connectors, terminals, and components stocked in Irvine for builds and first articles at other sites, and driving them to the requesting site.
* Coordinate incoming deliveries, inter\-site shipments, packing lists, tracking, carrier handoffs, and material movement between Palo Alto and Irvine.
* Support damaged shipments, missing items, returns, and supplier packing or quality issues through documented closure.

**Traceability and compliance support**
---------------------------------------


* Maintain BOM\-to\-asset traceability for test assets leaving the lab, including tagging, record linkage, and documentation sufficient to support data\-security and TISAX audit requirements.
* Apply and maintain a consistent asset tagging method (physical documentation, barcode/QR linkage to build records, or equivalent) across sites.

**Lab workflow and readiness**
------------------------------


* Maintain a visible view of requests, incoming material, shortages, equipment status, service actions, and readiness blockers.
* Coordinate with engineers and technicians around build milestones, lab capacity, need\-by dates, staging, storage, and escalation of risks.

**Process and reporting**
-------------------------


* Establish standard work for purchasing intake, receiving, inventory updates, asset tagging, shipment coordination, and issue escalation.
* Report on purchasing cycle time, open orders, overdue deliveries, inventory accuracy, calibration status, traceability coverage, and unresolved blockers.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* 3\+ years of experience in lab operations, purchasing administration, inventory control, asset management, logistics, manufacturing operations, or a similar environment


	+ 2\+ years will be considered with directly relevant lab or purchasing operations experience.
* Experience with an ERP or procurement platform; SAP experience strongly preferred, Coupa familiarity a plus.
* Strong spreadsheet, data\-management, recordkeeping, follow\-through, and communication skills.
* Ability to understand basic electrical/electronic lab equipment, part\-number structures, inventory concepts, calibration needs, and safe material handling.
* Experience supporting automotive, aerospace, electronics, hardware development, HIL, validation, prototype, or test\-lab environments is preferred.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, asset\-management systems, barcode/QR tracking, ESD practices, or multi\-site material movement is a plus.
* Ability to lift 45 pounds.
* Must possess a valid driver's license with a clean record.

jobs.title: Retail Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Bedrosians Tile and Stone**


Since 1948, Bedrosians have been a trusted leader in tile and stone. With 40\+ showrooms across the country, a growing eCommerce site, and strong relationships with designers, contractors, and retailers, we are investing in the future of omnichannel marketing to deliver seamless and inspiring customer experiences.

 **Position Overview**


The Retail Marketing Coordinator supports the execution of in\-store and regional marketing initiatives across Bedrosians showroom locations and retail channels. This role is focused on coordinating promotional campaigns, maintaining in\-store marketing assets, and assisting with product launches and retail events. The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, and enthusiastic about bringing marketing ideas to life in physical retail spaces.


This role will collaborate with showroom managers, sales teams, and the broader marketing department to help ensure consistency in brand messaging and execution across all retail\-facing touchpoints.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in the coordination and delivery of in\-store marketing materials, including signage, POP displays, brochures, and retail toolkits
* Support the rollout of new product launches by ensuring timely distribution of assets to showroom locations
* Collaborate with the creative team to request and review content for showroom events, campaigns, and merchandising updates
* Work with sales and showroom leadership to understand local marketing needs and help execute programs to support them
* Help plan and support seasonal promotions, showroom events, and grand openings
* Track and report on local marketing campaign performance, showroom engagement, and promotional outcomes
* Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to meet production and delivery deadlines for printed and digital materials
* Maintain accurate records of marketing inventory, showroom displays, and campaign calendars
* Conduct occasional showroom visits to support event execution and brand compliance

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
* 3–4 years of professional experience in retail, channel, or field marketing\-preferably in a consumer\-facing or showroom\-based environment
* Strong project coordination skills and attention to detail
* Ability to manage timelines and communicate effectively across multiple departments
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or Canva
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Passion for design, branding, and retail marketing
* Occasional travel to showroom locations required

 **Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with merchandising or retail operations
* Experience supporting marketing campaigns or store events
* Exposure to omni\-channel marketing or digital\-to\-store integrations
* Interest in home improvement, design, or building materials space

 **Why Join Us**


At Bedrosians, you'll contribute to bringing our brand to life where customers interact with it most\-on the showroom floor. You'll gain experience across multiple departments while helping create compelling and consistent retail experiences that support both national campaigns and local needs.

**Title:****A****ccount Manager \- Commercial Lines**  

**Hybrid Preferred:**Southern California (Aliso Viejo, Los Angeles County, Ontario, San Diego, or Santa Barbara)  

**Remote:** California residents  

**Book Focus:**Generalist and/or Construction \| **Required:** active property \& casualty (P\&C) license  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.**Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.**To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate****Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active property \& casualty (P\&C) licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential
* Company\-paid health insurance
* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time
* 401K with employer match
* Professional growth and career progression opportunities
* Respectful culture and work/family life balance
* Community service commitment
* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment
  

  

**What to Expect****(Application Process)****:**

* 30\-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)
**Salary Range**


The expected pay range for this position is $80,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 annually depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Technical
jobs.description:
At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!


Job Overview  

Contribute to T\-Mobile success by ensuring an outstanding Customer Experience. Utilizes expertise and leadership skills to direct team members and to resolve issues to ensure requirements are met. Communicates with end\-users to provide timely and accurate information and status updates. Help streamline operations when customers have service impacting challenges that need specialized support to enhance the overall customer experience for assigned strategic business customers. Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional business and technology development teams to solve problems and ensure customers have the best business solutions.**Job Responsibilities**:* Monitor progress toward resolution of customer problems. Initiates measures to maintain progress toward resolution of impairment/outages such as ticket tracking, resource assignment, escalations, engaging higher tier engineers and scheduling meetings/conference calls if required. Review reporting data to identify performance trends and opportunities. Facilitate quality and customer satisfaction goals to ensure customer retention and uphold the T\-Mobile brand by providing real time support.
* Analyze process flow and application of tools to identify and implement improvements that promote a painless customer experience.
* Ability to effectively acquire the right resources to apply toward resolution of sensitive or chronic troubles. Minimize and contain escalations by demonstrating helpful customer interactions and follow\-up skills.
* Provide timely feedback to the management team on customer trends, issues and needs.

  

**Education and Work Experience**:* High School Diploma/GED (Required)
* 2\-4 years \- Managing Technical Porjects
* Less than 2 years \- Reporting Experience

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**:* Business Planning Effective matrix management skills to influence/escalate for commitments when engaging fix actions. (Required)
* Task Management Strong multi\-tasking skills as well as prioritization of activities to resolve several customer emergencies at the same time. (Required)
* Product Knowledge Solid understanding of customer technologies and all Sprint products and services in order to understand and meet customer requirements. Extensive knowledge of T\-Mobile products and services for effective customer management. (Required)
* Root Cause Analysis Ability to interpret service performance for root cause analysis and corrective action. (Required)
* Communication Demonstrates strong business writing techniques and presentation skills on multiple levels including Customer, Vendor, and Executive.. (Required)
* MS Office Suite Proficient in MS Office \- specifically Excel, Word, Power Point, Visio (Required)
* Presentations Ability to present information to all levels of management up to and including the Executive level for both internal and external customers (Required)

  

**Licenses and Certifications**:* At least 18 years of age
* Legally authorized to work in the United States

  

**Travel**:  

Travel Required (Yes/No): Yes  

  

**DOT Regulated**:  

DOT Regulated Position (Yes/No): No  

Safety Sensitive Position (Yes/No): No

National Base Pay Range: $62,600 \- $112,900
The Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity represents the expected total cash compensation for this role at target performance, combining base salary and annual incentive opportunity. Actual earnings may be higher or lower depending on individual performance and overall company results.


The base pay range reflects the compensation component of this opportunity. The candidate’s actual pay will be based on various factors, such as work location, qualifications, and experience, so the actual starting pay will vary within this range. To find the pay range for this role based on hiring location, click here.
At T\-Mobile, employees in regular, non\-temporary roles are eligible for an annual bonus or periodic sales incentive or bonus, based on their role. Corporate employees are eligible for a year\-end bonus based on individual and/or company performance and which is set at a percentage of the employee’s eligible earnings in the prior year. Certain positions in Customer Care are eligible for monthly bonuses based on individual and/or team performance. The incentive component included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflects target performance. Actual earnings included in the Total Target Cash Earnings Opportunity reflect target performance; actual payouts may vary.  

  

At T\-Mobile, our benefits exemplify the spirit of One Team, Together! A big part of how we care for one another is working to ensure our benefits evolve to meet the needs of our team members. Full and part\-time employees have access to the same benefits when eligible.
