jobs.title: Community Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Joining Razer will place you on a global mission to revolutionize the way the world games. Razer is **a place to do great work**, offering you the opportunity to make an impact globally while working across a global team located across 5 continents. Razer is also **a great place to work,** providing you the unique, gamer\-centric \#LifeAtRazer experience that will put you in an accelerated growth, both personally and professionally.

**Job Responsibilities :**
--------------------------


The Community Content Specialist is a junior role that is for the social media savvy and for a marketing creative that possesses a great eye for content, especially for short form videos. This role works closely with the Community and Influencer teams, and is responsible for supporting relevant marketing teams to support the overall content strategy. This includes ideating and creating/filming/producing social media content, with an emphasis on short\-form video that will drive engagement for Razer’s handles, such as TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Ceating short\-form social media content that supports overall social and engagement plans.
* Create, film, and edit short\-form video content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
* Support the production of longer\-form video content, livestreams, event coverage, and other video requirements where needed.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date social content and production calendar, and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support timely delivery.
* Support the publishing and day\-to\-day management of Razer’s social channels, including routine moderation, community engagement, and channel housekeeping.
* Monitor social content performance and assist with regular reporting to identify content trends, audience insights, and opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate with global Marketing teams on social content requirements for campaigns, product launches, events, and other initiatives.
* Perform ad\-hoc department administrative duties as required.

 **Qualifications**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  

* 1–2 years of experience in video content creation, production, or a related field.
* 1 year of social media management experience.
* Hands\-on experience filming and editing video content for social media.
* Good understanding of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including common short\-form content formats and best practices.
* Good understanding of social media trends, online engagement, and digital content.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with social media management, analytics, and content calendaring tools.
* Ability to work effectively with teams across different regions, time zones, and cultures.
* Strong interest in gaming, with good knowledge of gaming culture and the wider gaming industry.

 **Education \& Experience**


Bachelor’s degree in Film/Video/Television Production, Communications, Marketing or Digital Media or equivalent work experience.

**Pre\-Requisites :**
---------------------

 **Salary Ranges:**


$50,700\.00 \- $84,500\.00 (per annum)

jobs.title: Regional Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Regional Sales Representative (Remote)**  

  

Simon Roofing, a leading commercial roofing solutions organization, is currently seeking driven individuals to join our team as **Regional Sales Representative (Remote)** for the **San Francisco Region**. Candidates should possess at least 2 years of experience in outside sales and demonstrate a strong desire for professional development. As part of our well\-established sales team, you will benefit from comprehensive training and ongoing support. This career opportunity offers uncapped bonus potential and ample room for advancement within our dynamic sales environment.  

  

In the role of *Regional Sales Representative*, you will be responsible for cultivating new client relationships and nurturing existing ones within your designated territory.  

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Developing and maintaining strong client relationships with a focus on exceptional customer service.
* Providing consultative roofing service solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.
* Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, networking, and relationship\-building efforts.
* Organizing and executing targeted programs and communications to reinforce the value propositions of Simon Roofing.

**Job Requirements:*** **A degree focusing on Sales, Construction Management, Communications, Business, Social Sciences, or Marketing is preferred.**
* **At least 2 years of outside sales experience. (Roofing experience not required.)**
* ***Work and reside in the San Francisco, California Region (REQUIRED).***
* ***Willing and able to work remotely (work from home).***
* Cold Calling/Prospecting experience
* Customer service oriented.
* Knowledgeable about the local community in your assigned territory.
* Ability to climb ladders to rooftops.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word; ability to do extensive research on the Internet.
* Team\-oriented, energetic, enthusiastic, self\-motivated, with a business development mindset
* Strong skills in organization, active listening, and sales closing.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
* Must pass a pre\-employment drug test and background screening.
* Authorized to work in the US.

**Benefits:*** Generous base salary of $60,000 per year (and up to $15,000 in performance bonuses).
* Average second\-year reps earn up to $90,000\.00 per year.
* A well\-defined Growth \& Commissions plan.
* Medical, dental, and vision care plans
* Free\-life insurance after 60 days of employment
* 401(k) plan with immediate enrollment option
* Paid Time Off plan \& Paid holidays
* Car allowance \& gas card
* Company laptop and cell phone

 **Who We Are**  

  

Since our modest beginnings in 1900 in Youngstown, Ohio, our family business has flourished due to our dedicated employees who consistently exceed customer expectations. With a commitment to staying ahead of the technology curve, we've expanded to operate 66 service centers and employ over 500 professionals across the United States.  

  

Despite our growth into one of the largest national commercial roofing companies, our core values remain unwavering. While roofing remains central to our operations, we've broadened our scope to include manufacturing top\-tier roofing and commercial flooring materials, as well as servicing, repairing, and installing commercial flooring surfaces.  

  

All of our affiliate businesses share our customer\-first service strategy, ensuring that our commitment to excellence extends across all our endeavors.

jobs.description:
**Title:** Assistant Route Service Sales Representative
  
  

**Location:**  

Tustin, CA, US, 92780
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
  

**Requisition Number:** 234105
  
  

Job Description
  
  

Cintas is seeking an Assistant Route Service Sales Representative. Responsibilities include providing route service to a set customer base, through the pick\-up and delivery of uniforms and facility services products such as floor mats, dust mops, air fresheners, soaps, restroom paper supplies and other ancillary products. Daily duties involve lifting, carrying and walking clean products into and soiled products out of customer accounts, as well as occasionally driving a company\-owned vehicle to and from numerous customer stops throughout the day. The vast majority of RSSRs work 4 days per week and no weekends.
  
  

Skills/Qualifications
  
  

Required
  
  

Qualified candidates must meet all requirements outlined by the Department of Transportation (DOT) for driving a regulated vehicle weighing more than 10,000 lbs. In order to comply with DOT requirements, qualified candidates must, prior to their first day of employment:
  
  

Have a valid driver’s license
  
Be at least 21 years of age
  
Obtain a DOT medical certification
  
Provide documentation regarding their previous employment
  
  

**All successful candidates will also possess:**  

The ability to meet the physical requirements of the position
  
A High School diploma, GED or Military Service
  
The ability to demonstrate a strong customer service orientation
  
Self\-motivation and the drive to work in an environment that relies on teamwork to meet goals
  
A positive attitude, along with ambition, organization and service spirit
  
  

This is a rewarding opportunity! To support our aggressive growth plans, we offer unique opportunities, including advancement, ongoing training, mentoring and the opportunity to develop world class business skills.
  
  

Benefits
  
Cintas offers comprehensive and competitive medical, dental and vision benefits, with premiums below the national average. We offer flexibility with four different medical plan options; one plan is offered at zero cost.
  
  

**Additionally, our employee\-partners enjoy:**  

* Competitive Pay
* 401(k) with Company Match/Profit Sharing/Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* Disability, Life and AD\&D Insurance, 100% Company Paid
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* Skills Development, Training and Career Advancement Opportunities


Compensation
  
A reasonable estimate of base salary for this role ranges between $19\.80 \- $24\.75/Hour. The range takes into account factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, and other business and organization needs. Please note, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decision are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each decision.
  
  

Company Information
  
Cintas Corporation helps more than one million businesses of all types and sizes get Ready™ to open their doors with confidence every day by providing products and services that help keep their customers’ facilities and employees clean, safe, and looking their best. With offerings including uniforms, mats, mops, towels, restroom supplies, workplace water services, first aid and safety products, eye\-wash stations, safety training, fire extinguishers, sprinkler systems and alarm service, Cintas helps customers get Ready for the Workday®. Headquartered in the U.S., Cincinnati, OH, Cintas is a publicly held Fortune 500 company traded over the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol CTAS and is a component of both the Standard \& Poor’s 500 Index and Nasdaq\-100 Index.

* Build strong relationships with retail and home delivery clients.
* Ensure every customer is greeted promptly, professionally, and courteously.
* Resolve client concerns, service issues, and garment claims quickly and professionally.
* Follow up with customers regarding delayed orders, special requests, and satisfaction concerns.
* Develop and maintain relationships with VIP, concierge, and high\-value clients.
* Increase client retention through personalized service and proactive communication.
* Generate referral business and positive online reviews.


**Retail Store Operations**


* Oversee daily operations of the retail location.
* Ensure all garments are processed accurately and ready when promised.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and professional store environment.
* Reconcile cash drawers and verify daily deposits.
* Monitor workflow between retail stores, production plant, and delivery routes.
* Maintain operational reports and performance metrics.
* Fill in for Customer Service Representatives when necessary.


**Team Leadership \& Development**


* Train, coach, and mentor Customer Service Representatives.
* Conduct onboarding for new team members.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Create schedules and manage timekeeping records.
* Foster teamwork, accountability, and positive workplace culture.
* Conduct daily huddles and team communication meetings.
* Monitor employee performance and provide constructive feedback.


**Administrative \& Office Support**


* Answer client emails, phone calls, and online inquiries.
* Support payroll preparation and administrative record keeping.
* Assist with HR documentation and compliance.
* Coordinate meetings, training schedules, and internal communications.
* Maintain organized digital and physical records.
* Support management with special projects and reporting.


**Marketing \& Business Development**


* Support implementation of marketing campaigns.
* Assist with social media engagement and customer outreach.
* Promote View Cleaners' Home \& Office Pickup and Delivery Service.
* Support customer loyalty and referral programs.
* Identify opportunities to increase sales and client engagement.

* Exceptional customer service and relationship\-building skills
* Strong verbal and written communication
* Leadership and coaching abilities
* Professional conflict resolution
* Organizational and project management skills
* Attention to detail
* Problem\-solving mindset
* Positive attitude and professionalism
* Ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, POS systems, CRM software, and email platforms


**Preferred**


* Dry cleaning, hospitality, luxury retail, or service industry experience
* Experience managing customer relationships and teams
* Knowledge of garment care and textile services


**About View Cleaners**



View Cleaners is Orange County's premier dry cleaning and laundry service, serving customers since 1976\. We specialize in luxury garment care, wedding gowns, designer apparel, household items, and complimentary home and office pickup and delivery service. Our mission is to provide world\-class customer experience through exceptional service, attention to detail, and lasting client relationships.

* Accountability
* Integrity
* Continuous Improvement
* Teamwork

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships, leading people, solving problems, and helping grow a high\-end service business.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**


Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Project Coordinator in our Quality, Outcome Research, \& Analytics (QORA) department!


This is a full\-time, benefits\-eligible, grant\-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire April 1, 2027 with the possibility of extension.


This position can be home\-based.


The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work\-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award\-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work\-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.


**Responsibilities**


The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of health sciences research and measure development initiatives through project coordination, administrative support, stakeholder engagement, and program operations. Working closely with internal staff, subject matter experts, researchers, and external partners, this role coordinates meetings and activities, maintains project documentation and databases, supports reporting efforts, and ensures smooth day\-to\-day operations.


* Support day\-to\-day operations of initiatives, including scheduling internal, external, and cross\-functional meetings, managing agendas, capturing notes and action items, tracking follow\-up activities, coordinating materials, and maintaining project documentation.
* Develop, input, and maintain information in project tracking systems, databases, SharePoint sites, and other software platforms.
* Handle administrative and financial tasks, including processing invoices, tracking budgets and expenses, and supporting contract and grant administration activities.
* Support virtual meeting logistics and technology setup.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project participants, subject matter experts, and external partners, coordinating communications, responding to inquiries, and assisting with onboarding activities.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, status reports, meeting summaries, dashboards, stakeholder updates, and other materials aligned with project goals and timelines.
* Assist with the development and dissemination of program materials, templates, reports, and resources.
* Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, and meeting schedules to support successful execution of research and measure development activities.

**Qualifications**


* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of three (3\) years of relevant experience that includes administrative and/or project coordination experience.
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet specified timelines.
* Administrative expertise with sophisticated clerical responsibilities and data management.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal skills with proven ability to develop collaborative working relationships internally and externally.
* Experience coordinating meetings, events, or project activities across multiple stakeholder groups.

**Here are some of the preferred experience and skills we are seeking:**


* Bachelor's degree in health sciences, public health, healthcare administration, research, or a related field.
* Experience supporting health sciences, research, quality improvement, measurement, or healthcare\-related projects.
* Experience working with subject matter experts, researchers, healthcare professionals, or external partners.
* Knowledge of basic data tracking, reporting, or research support processes.

**Proficiency Requirement**


* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience working with project management, database, or collaboration systems is a plus.

**Compensation \& Benefits**


The expected pay range will be $20\.51 per hour to $25\.64 per hour. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards \& Benefits to see more details.


* **Compensation** – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
* **Performance and Recognition** – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
* **Benefits** – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well\-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.

jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Help Build the Workplace Behind the Mission**


Come join our team! Homeward Bound helps unsheltered individuals and families in Marin County transform their lives through housing, training, and supportive services.


Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of shelter and housing for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. We offer emergency shelter, short\- and long\-term supportive housing, job training and placement, and wraparound services. Our mission is **Opening Doors to Safety, Dignity, Hope, and Independence**.


We are seeking a **Program Coordinator** \- Puett Place to join our adult housing team and support residents as they build stability and self\-sufficiency. In this role, you’ll work with participants in our newly opened 24\-unit **veteran** **housing** program, which provides affordable housing for adults transitioning out of homelessness. You will help residents maintain their housing, navigate challenges, and move toward greater independence.

**What You'll Do**

* Provide housing\-focused case management to individuals and groups.
* Coordinate care with healthcare, behavioral health, housing, and community partners.
* Support housing stability through advocacy, referrals, crisis intervention, and conflict resolution.
* Address barriers to housing, income, employment, and health using Housing First and trauma\-informed approaches.
* Maintain regular participant engagement to support progress toward housing goals.
* Assist with housing eligibility, leasing, move\-ins, and housing retention.
* Coordinate voucher paperwork and required housing documentation.
* Support basic property management functions, including maintenance requests, rent tracking, tenancy issues, and site monitoring.
* Collaborate with program leadership to improve housing operations and participant outcomes.
* Provide cross\-program support within the team’s housing book as needed
* Maintain client records and data in HMIS, Salesforce, and other required systems.
* Meet program, funder, and agency documentation standards and deadlines.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, human services, or a related field, **or** three (3\) years of experience in housing, residential, or human services.
* Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness or other underserved populations preferred.
* Knowledge of Housing First, harm reduction, trauma\-informed care, mental health, substance use, and community resources.
* Familiarity with public benefits systems (SSI, SSDI, SDI) and housing programs.
* Experience with HMIS, Salesforce, or similar databases, and proficiency with Microsoft Office and cloud\-based applications.
* Strong communication, organization, documentation, and case management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse, fast\-paced environment.
* Commitment to equity, inclusion, confidentiality, and professional standards.
**Preferred**

* Experience working with veterans in case management settings
* Compassionate, organized, and solution\-focused.
* Able to work independently and collaboratively.
* Maintains professional boundaries and adapts to changing priorities.
* Committed to supporting housing stability and ending homelessness.
* Sense of humor encouraged
**Why Join Homeward Bound?**


At Homeward Bound, our employees make a tangible difference every day. We believe supporting our team is essential to supporting our community.


We offer:

* 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 403(b) retirement plan with discretionary employer match
* Two weeks of paid vacation annually
* Employee Assistance Program
* Complimentary lunch at our administrative site
* A collaborative, mission\-driven workplace where your work has lasting impact

jobs.title: People Development Coordinator, New Hire Orientation
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Tesla’s mission is to build a world of amazing abundance. Achieving that at scale means setting every employee up for success from Day 1\. This role coordinates New Hire Orientation to ensure every new hire has a strong, well\-organized first day at Tesla.  

  

We’re looking for someone reliable, consistent, driven, and collaborative. You will own room setup, check\-in, nametags, the new\-hire inbox, attendance tracking, and reporting. You’ll also support organizational development coordination and administration, along with leadership development or NHO projects as the site needs.  

  

The majority of your time will focus on New Hire Orientation operations and inbox support, with the remainder on reporting, start\-list work, and project coordination. The pace is high and the standard is equally high. Priorities shift quickly—you’ll think on your feet, navigate ambiguity, solve problems without waiting for direction, and stay collaborative under pressure.  

**What You'll Do*** Prepare and run New Hire Orientation, including early room setup, check\-in, onboarding tasks, badging and multi\-factor authentication support, nametag preparation, escalations, and staying through dismissal
* Manage start lists, invites, and stakeholder communications: prepare and distribute lists, notify onboarding partners, resolve errors/duplicates, and keep information current
* Monitor the new\-hire inbox, respond to inquiries, open and track tickets with IT or HRIS to resolution, handle no\-show follow\-ups, and coordinate reschedules with Recruiting and HR
* Track attendance, no\-shows, and exceptions accurately; enter data and produce clear reports on key metrics
* On added rotation days, complete post\-session closeout (attendance finalization, completions upload, room reset, supply restocking) and support related follow\-ups such as time clock issues
* Proactively handle issues that arise during orientation and throughout the week—identify next steps, take action, and escalate to the right owner when needed
* Support organizational development coordination and administration, plus leadership development or NHO project work as site needs arise
  

**What You'll Bring*** 1\+ year of experience in program coordination, HR operations, learning operations, event operations, or a related field
* Ability to work fully on\-site; available Friday/Sunday/Monday (plus Tuesday or Thursday on rotation) and able to start as early as 6:00 a.m. on orientation days
* Strong organization and follow\-through and ability to multi\-task
* Comfortable giving and receiving feedback; thinks on feet and solves problems without waiting for direction
* Reliable, consistent, and driven: completes work to standard, improves processes, advances independently, and follows through
* Exempleary communication skills, both written and verbal, and ability to speak in front of large audiences
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel and ability to learn internal tools
#### **Benefits**

  

Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:


* Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
  
  

#### **Expected Compensation**


$28\.00 \- $46\.20/hour \+ cash and stock awards \+ benefits
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.  

  

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.title: Volunteer and Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary** Under the supervision of the Director of Family Support, this position holds responsibility for planning large and small events across Support for Families, coordinating logistics, timelines, vendors, promotion and other event details, and working closely with many different staff teams, community partners, and parent volunteers. This position is also responsible for recruiting, onboarding, and training a cohort of volunteers, and leading them to effectively expand Support for Families' capacity for events and outreach. We're looking for a creative problem\-solver who can juggle a dozen moving pieces at once without dropping any of them, and who builds genuine relationships with volunteers and families from every walk of life. This person is as comfortable behind a spreadsheet as they are on their feet at a busy event, follows through on details without being asked, and never lets a deadline slip. A strong sense of humor, excellent time and project management skills, and a desire to create fun and inclusive events for children with disabilities and their families go a long way in this role.

Core Responsibilities

**Directly plan and/or serve as an internal consultant for events (provide guidance on planning templates, logistics, best practices, vendors, registration, etc.) as well as project management and staffing support to each team as they collaborate to plan events**  Coordinate planning and project management for major agencywide events (Information and Resource Conference, Access to Adventure, Holiday Ice Skating, Adulthood Ahead Transition Fair, SDP Fair(s), Spring Festival(s), SF Half Marathon, etc.)

**Recruit, train, and connect to organization needs at least 25 volunteers**  Maintain agency\-wide outreach calendar to ensure staff all know which teams are doing outreach at what events, and to help identify gaps and key events that might fall through the cracks

**Support other event planning and staffing like FRC events (baseball clinics, coffee hours, Parent Café, field trips, etc.), Gala, Family Voices Health Summit, and SF Kids year\-end event as needed** 

Perform other related duties as assigned or requested Qualifications and Required Skills **2\+ years experience planning family or child\-focused events and/or recruiting and managing volunteers**  Established track record of success in a fast\-paced, teamwork\-oriented environment

**A flexible, detailed, and strategic approach to event management — able to see both the big picture and the details**  Excellent time management skills, with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting deadlines and managing multiple concurrent event timelines without things falling through the cracks

**Exceptional project management skills**  Strong organizational skills and a high degree of attention to detail

**A proactive, self\-directed approach — someone who anticipates needs, flags issues early, and follows through without being asked** 

Clear, confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt tone and message across families, staff, and funders

**Comfort serving as a primary point of contact across multiple internal teams and stakeholders simultaneously** 

Significant experience working with people of varied experiences and diverse backgrounds

**Demonstrated experience recruiting, engaging, and retaining volunteers from diverse cultural, linguistic, and socioeconomic backgrounds** 

Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs

**A good sense of humor and the resilience to bring warmth and perspective to emotionally demanding work** 

**Desired Qualifications \& Skills**  Degree in marketing, events, nonprofit management, business management, public health, social services, or education or a related field, preferred **Knowledge of disability service systems and supports**  Lived experience as a parent/caregiver of a child with special needs and/or as a person with a disability or another historically excluded identity **Experience working with underserved communities, including families of color, families living with unstable housing, and/or monolingual families**  Experience working with families of children with developmental concerns, disabilities, and/or complex medical needs

Work Environment **Hybrid schedule with time in\-office, in\-community, and remote work (subject to change at any time for any reason); this role will likely be 3–4 days a week in office or in community, and 1– 2 days a week from home**  Off\-site duties/events as needed **Occasional evening or weekend hours required to support programs and events Essential Job Functions This role requires the ability to:**  Walk or roll over uneven and rough terrain (e.g., parks and outdoor spaces) for extended periods, including during setup and breakdown of events **Lift and carry boxes and bags of up to 25 lbs, such as bags of food for families and boxes of event supplies**  Sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer **Travel to and between community sites, program locations, and events**  Accurately review, complete, and proofread detailed documents, spreadsheets, and forms, including event timelines and budgets **Communicate clearly and effectively with families, staff, and community partners, both verbally and in writing Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.** 

**How to Apply Email a detailed resume and a well\-written cover letter to jobs@supportforfamilies.org.**

Pay: $31\.25 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

* Describe your experience planning events.
* Describe your experience working with volunteers.
* Describe your experience working with children with disabil

jobs.title: HR & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

**The Operations \& HR Coordinator provides administrative, logistical, and systems support for BHNC's human resources and organizational operations functions. Reporting directly to the HR \& Operations Manager, this position plays an important role in ensuring that HR processes, employee records, office systems, compliance documentation, facilities coordination, and administrative workflows are accurate, organized, timely, and consistently maintained. The Coordinator serves as the primary administrative support to the HR \& Operations Manager and works closely with employees, supervisors, Finance, program staff, vendors, consultants, and other organizational partners. Success in this position requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, follow\-through, discretion, comfort managing multiple deadlines, and the ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.**

**BERNAL HEIGHTS NEIGHBORHOOD CENTER**

**Now celebrating our 49th year as a community\-based, member\-led nonprofit organization, BHNC's mission is to preserve and enhance the ethnic, cultural, and economic diversity of Bernal Heights and surrounding neighborhoods. We accomplish our mission by developing affordable housing throughout San Francisco; providing linguistically and culturally responsive services to our community's most vulnerable adults, seniors, youth, and their families; developing leaders; and organizing and empowering our tenants, clients, members, and allies to advocate for their needs and for the needs of the community.**

**BHNC meets its mission through five key program areas: affordable housing development, youth programs, senior programs, employment development, and community engagement.**

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Human Resources Administration \& Employee Lifecycle**

* **Maintain accurate, confidential, and audit\-ready personnel files, HR records, and employee information in ADP and other HR systems.**
* **Coordinate administrative aspects of recruitment, onboarding, employee changes, performance reviews, training, and offboarding, including scheduling, documentation, background checks, and follow\-up.**
* **Maintain HR calendars and tracking systems for evaluations, certifications, required trainings, benefits, leaves, and other employee\-related deadlines.**
* **Prepare routine HR documentation and reports and follow up with employees and supervisors regarding outstanding requirements.**
* **Provide confidential administrative support for employee relations, investigations, grievances, and performance management matters as directed by the HR \& Operations Manager.**

**Benefits, Leave, Payroll \& Compliance**

* **Support administration of employee benefits, open enrollment, leaves, Workers' Compensation, return\-to\-work processes, and related employee documentation.**
* **Coordinate employee and payroll changes with the HR \& Operations Manager and Finance, maintaining accurate supporting documentation.**
* **Maintain required Federal, California, and San Francisco employment postings, compliance calendars, safety records, and documentation.**
* **Support HR and compliance audits, including personnel, wage\-and\-hour, benefits, Workers' Compensation, OSHA, IIPP, and Workplace Violence Prevention records.**
* **Track deadlines, missing documentation, and potential compliance issues and promptly escalate them to the HR \& Operations Manager.**

**Office \& Facilities Operations**

* **Coordinate day\-to\-day office operations, including supplies, facilities requests, IT and telecommunications needs, equipment, mail, and administrative systems.**
* **Maintain organized operational records, including vendor information, contracts, certificates of insurance, warranties, and other organizational documentation.**
* **Coordinate with vendors and staff to ensure operational and facilities issues are addressed and resolved timely.**
* **Support front desk and other administrative operations as needed.**

**Events \& Organizational Support**

* **Coordinate administrative and logistical aspects of community room rentals, including scheduling, agreements, documentation, and internal coordination.**
* **Provide logistical and administrative support for major organizational activities and events, including Fiesta on the Hill, membership activities, open houses, staff events, and other organizational initiatives.**
* **Coordinate vendors, supplies, schedules, and other event\-related logistics as assigned.**

**Project, Systems \& Workflow Coordination**

* **Use Asana and other organizational systems to manage projects, recurring responsibilities, deadlines, and follow\-up.**
* **Maintain departmental calendars, task lists, checklists, templates, standard operating procedures, and tracking systems.**
* **Provide regular status updates to the HR \& Operations Manager regarding deadlines, outstanding tasks, and unresolved issues.**
* **Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems, recordkeeping, and workflow efficiency.**
* **Complete special projects and other duties as assigned.**

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* **Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.**
* **Demonstrated ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and competing priorities.**
* **Strong follow\-up and follow\-through skills.**
* **Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with discretion.**
* **Sound judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated to management.**
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, IgAN Nephrology, East Bay, CA
jobs.description:
Location: Oakland, United States Job reference: R\-258985 Date posted: 08/27/2026
**Regional Account Manager, IgAN Nephrology, East Bay, CA**


**The territory consists of: Oakland, San Jose, Monterey, and Fresno CA.**


**About the job:**The Regional Account Manager (RAM) position is within our Rare Hematology and Nephrology Franchise, a division of Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease and will focus on the launch of IgAN as a potential new indication. The RAM will be assigned a sales territory focused on academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and other strategic sites of care, focused on nephrology. This individual would be responsible for the growth and expansion of the IgAN indication while supporting appropriate assigned indication opportunities with key nephrology customers.


**Why Join Us?**At Alexion, we’re united by a shared purpose: to transform the lives of people affected by rare diseases. In Neurology, that purpose is personal. We connect deeply with patients and their care teams, and we work together to deliver innovative therapies that make a real difference. Here, your work means more—more impact, more growth, and more connection.


What You’ll DoAs a Regional Account Manager – Rare Nephrology, you’ll build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals across your territory. You’ll represent Alexion’s nephrology indications, helping providers understand our therapies and how they support patients with rare nephrological conditions.


Territory: Must live within the geography


**You will:**• Consistently achieve or exceed sales objectives in assigned territory • Create and maintain strategically targeted account\-specific business plans that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales, diagnostic pathways, referral patterns, and treatment adoption.• Develop and maintain strong, in\-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge across assigned indications, with emphasis on renal disease education and the needs of nephrology customers.• Demonstrate the ability to educate on the clinical approach to relevant disease states, leading to successful differential diagnosis, appropriate testing, and timely treatment of focus patient populations.• Build and maintain productive relationships with nephrologists and other key stakeholders in academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and related sites of care.• Collaborate closely with internal cross\-functional stakeholders, including peer RAM(s), TLL(s), SAL(s), MSL(s), FRM(s), PEM(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, and enterprise partners.• Handle customer questions and objections in a way that is consistent with product indications and sales training methodology, including the ability to compliantly triage inquiries to the appropriate partner.• Understand and demonstrate proper use of products to clinicians in hospital, clinic, and infusion center environments.• Lead the implementation of a patient\-centric partnership model that includes physicians, their staff, patients, clinics, hospitals, and relevant care partners.• Effectively utilize CRM tools to manage territory priorities, track account engagement, document sales activities, and submit required reports accurately and on time; and adopt CRM AI\-embedded tools to prioritize opportunities and optimize call execution• Effectively use AI\-driven insights for territory planning, HCP targeting, and pre\-call strategy; translate analytics into focused customer engagement and account action plans• Execute local promotional activities and programs for the assigned therapeutic areas.• Provide a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.• Proactively interact with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives based on field insights, access trends, and account needs.• Perform work in alignment with and adhering to Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.


**What you bring:**• Bachelor’s degree.• 5 years pharmaceutical sales or equivalent experience (e.g., Biotech or Medical Device), or 5 years of experience in a medical setting.• Proven, documented track record for delivering consistent, top\-tier sales results in institutions, hospital systems, and/or complex specialty markets.• Ability to work independently as well as interdependently in a team\-oriented environment.• Strong clinical acumen, account\-based selling, analytical, and strategic skills to successfully develop accounts.• Demonstrated ability to seek out and qualify leads, profile new accounts, and build durable relationships with relevant healthcare providers and office staff.• Ability to gain consistent access and develop strong, professional relationships for scientific exchange and promotion with healthcare providers in community and academic settings.• Effective verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational abilities.• Must live in the geographic territory or live within 50 miles of the geographic territory border.• Ability to travel within territory on a regular basis, which may include frequent overnight and weekend travel.• Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.• The duties of this role are generally conducted in a field environment. As is typical of a field\-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation, to travel by public transportation, automobile, train, or plane; work comfortably in a clinical setting; use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; problem solve; engage in complex and non\-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; and maintain general availability during standard business hours.


**Preferred qualifications:**• Advanced or master’s degree.• 5 years pharmaceutical sales or equivalent experience in specialty, rare disease, nephrology, or related markets.• Sales experience

jobs.title: Cost Account Manager - Cost Plus Contracts
jobs.description:
**Please review the job details below.**
----------------------------------------

  

Lanteris Space is seeking an experienced Cost Account Manager to support our Cost Plus Civil Space programs for our offices in Palo Alto CA. This role may also be performed remotely within the U.S. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and reporting cost account performance to ensure compliance with contract requirements, internal financial controls, and program objectives. This role requires strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, procurement, scheduling and program management teams.


**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned cost accounts within the Cost Plus program, ensuring accurate tracking of labor, materials, subcontracts, and other direct costs
* Monitor budget\-to\-actual variances and provide timely analysis of cost performance
* Develop and maintain Estimates at Completion (EAC) and Estimates to Complete (ETC)
* Support monthly financial close processes and reconciliation activities
* Identify cost trends, risks, and opportunities for cost savings
* Prepare variance analysis reports and explanations for management review
* Support Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs) and other program reviews
* Ensure compliance with FAR/DFARS regulations and contract requirements for Cost Plus programs
* Prepare accurate and timely financial reports for internal and external stakeholders
* Support government audits (DCAA/DCMA) by providing documentation and cost justification
* Maintain proper cost segregation between contract line items and ensure allowability of costs
* Partner with project leads, engineers, and program managers to forecast resource needs
* Collaborate with procurement on subcontract cost management
* Work with accounting to ensure proper cost allocation and recording
* Participate in program meetings to provide financial insights and recommendations

**Minimum Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field
* 8 years of experience in cost account management, preferably in aerospace/defense
* Experience with Cost\-Plus government contracts (CPFF, CPAF, CPIF) with responsibility for technical, financial, and contractual performance.
* Experience managing program financials, including forecasting, funding management, Estimates at Completion (EACs), staffing, and resource planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or MBA
* Professional certification (CPA, CMA, or EVP certification)
* Knowledge of commercial space architectures, missions, systems, requirements, and acquisition methods required and be able to strategize unique solutions.
* Experience with Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) development and maintenance
* Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)

  

In support of pay transparency at Lanteris Space Systems, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings. The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job\-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.


 The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $107,000\.00 \- $178,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within California is: $111,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 annually.
For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market\-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.  



  

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process.


The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.

  

  

The date of posting can be found on the Lanteris Space Systems Career page at the top of each job posting.

  

  

To apply, submit your application via the Lanteris Space Systems Career page.

  

**Lanteris Space Systems values diversity in the workplace and is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

jobs.title: Account Manager - Northern California/Northern Nevada
jobs.description:
**SAVARIA PATIENT CARE**
Built from a heritage of brands including Span America, Handicare and Silvalea, Savaria Patient Care provides products designed for safe patient handling and positive outcomes. Our research and clinically based product portfolio include therapeutic support surfaces for pressure management and positioning, medical beds, a complete range of innovative ceiling and floor lifts and slings. Savaria Patient Care is a division of Savaria Corporation, a global leader in accessibility solutions.  

Job Posting Title **Account Manager \- Northern California/Northern Nevada** **JOB SUMMARY:**
The Account Manager is assigned a geographic region (Northern California/Northern Nevada) to maintain and increase the sales of medical products, meet individual sales objectives, attend assigned trade and product shows, and work with distributor representatives as well as end users. They will be responsible for selling mostly capital equipment through distributors, dealers as well as servicing and selling direct to facilities in the territory, i.e., long\-term care, rehabilitation centers, hospice, homecare, VAMC and state facilities. The base is $70,000 with an anticipated first year on\-target earnings of $160,0000 and second year of $200,000\+.  

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS:*** Develop an annual territory sales plan and provide quarterly updates to the Region Manager.
* Develop, maintain and expand customer base, follow up on leads and maintain key customer relationships. To accomplish this, the following departments are point\-of\-call: Executive Directors, Director of Nursing, Wound Care nurses, case managers, maintenance, biomed, prosthetics, OT/PT/KT, contracting officers and logistics.
* Meet or exceed sales objectives to achieve the established sales plan.
* Responsible for customer support for all product collateral (samples, literature, etc.)
* Provide in\-service education and training to all customers.
* Transport equipment to and from sales calls and trade shows including but not limited to beds, floor lifts, and surfaces.
* Participate in clinical programs and workshops within your territory as assigned.
* Support the Quality Policy, Quality System, and follow established procedures.
* Attend regional and national sales meetings as scheduled.
* Follow safety rules to protect yourself and company equipment.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.
* Work with all our national, regional, and local distributors.

 **SUPERVISORY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**: N/A  

**COMPETENCIES:*** Should have sold capital equipment sales background.
* Uses resources efficiently and strives to reduce costs as a part of the budgeting process.
* Ability to respond quickly to changing responsibilities and processes.
* Team Oriented
* Effectively communicate with all levels of management
* Solid analytical skills.
* Committed to finding solutions to problems.
* Results\-oriented with a focus on meeting organizational requirements.
* Exhibits sound and accurate judgment.
* Ability to adapt to a wide variety of customer and corporate demands from supporting and diagnosing product function to meeting with c\-suite.
* Supports and upholds the organization’s goals and values.
* Works with integrity.
* Observe safety and security procedures.
* Use a CRM system (SFDC).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook is required.

 **BEHAVIORS:**  

Savaria’s mission is to provide products to improve mobility and access in daily life, so it’s important that all associates embrace this and ensure that they keep our customers at the heart of everything they do, acting in the spirit of our Savaria values all the time:* **Safety** – We are committed to protecting the health and well\-being of customers, the public, and our people.
* **Quality** – We aspire to deliver quality products and services that are right the first time.
* **Customer passion** – What we do makes a difference, and we work with passion to do the best for our customers.
* **Collaboration** – We encourage collaboration to generate ideas and innovation and value clear and open communication to create strong teamwork.
* **Expertise** – Our knowledge and experience have made us industry leaders, and we actively support continuous learning for future growth.

 **LANGUAGE SKILLS:*** Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations. jobs.title: Merchant Sales Account Manager (MSAM)
jobs.description:
**Merchant Sales Account Manager (MSAM)**

**Join Aldelo Pay — Uncapped Commission, Real Growth, No Cold\-Start Chaos**

Are you a driven, self\-motivated sales professional ready to turn your hustle into six figures? Aldelo is looking for a **Merchant Sales Account Manager** to help merchants nationwide save money and run their businesses better — while building a career with uncapped earning potential and real advancement.

This isn't just a sales job. You'll be a trusted advisor to business owners, helping them discover how Aldelo Pay's merchant services, Point of Sale systems, and integrated solutions can boost their bottom line. You'll own the full relationship — from first call to onboarding — backed by a team that has your back every step of the way.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* **Uncapped Earnings:** $65,000 base salary plus residuals and sales commissions — with no cap. Top performers regularly reach six figures or more.
* **Real Impact:** Help merchants achieve measurable savings and operational efficiency — you're not just closing deals, you're solving real problems.
* **Career Growth:** Build deep product expertise, strengthen cross\-team relationships with our Credit and Risk team, and grow your skills as a trusted merchant advisor.
* **Stability \+ Structure:** A consistent Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm schedule and a supportive team environment in our Pleasanton office.
* **Full Benefits Package:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, Medical Leave, and Retirement.

**What You'll Do**

As an MSAM, you'll work directly with end\-user merchants by phone and email, representing Aldelo's products and solutions with professionalism and expertise. You'll assess each merchant's business and POS needs to build a compelling, tailored ROI story — then guide them seamlessly through processing, installation, and onboarding onto Aldelo Express Cloud POS.

Success in this role means staying active and engaged: making 120–150 outbound calls a day, pursuing new opportunities, and nurturing lasting relationships with existing clients.

**What We're Looking For**

* Associate's or bachelor's degree
* Strong computer and phone skills
* Detail\-oriented with excellent verbal and written communication
* Comfortable managing 100\+ outbound calls per day
* Reliable, dependable, and a strong team player
* Goals\-driven, sales\-oriented, and self\-directed
* Merchant sales, general sales, or tele\-sales experience strongly preferred

**Position Details**

**Job Title**

Merchant Sales Account Manager (MSAM)

**Job Type**

Full\-Time

**Location**

Pleasanton, CA (6701 Koll Center Parkway, Suite 150, Pleasanton, CA 94566\)

**Schedule**

Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm

**Base Salary**

$65,000/year depending on experience

**Commission**

Residuals \+ sales commissions, uncapped — reach six figures or more

**Benefits**

Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, Medical Leave, Retirement

**Remote Work**

Not available — daily on\-site commute required

**Ready to Apply?**

Email your resume to **jobs@aldelo.com** with **"MSAM"** in the subject line. We're excited to hear from you!

Pay: $56,710\.85 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Describe your experience in merchant services, payments, POS, or a related B2B sales role.
* What was the highest volume of outbound calls you've sustained in a single day or week in a prior role, and for how long?
* Tell me about a time you built a business case or ROI story to convince a skeptical prospect. What was the outcome?
* Tell me about a time you missed a sales target. What did you do differently afterward?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Pleasanton, CA 94566 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
### **G'day!**

We are ServiceRocket , a global tech\-enabled services company headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Our purpose is to be the single most reliable partner in the acceleration of your growth. At ServiceRocket, we are committed to the development of every Rocketeer and the trust of every customer.


Twenty years on and counting, we’ve got your back.


### **Why is ServiceRocket the place for you**

* A 20\+ year tech services expert of many solutions and partnerships with industry giants.
* Our diverse world of Rocketeers lives by our values with a collaborative mindset resulting in a 4\.7 rating on Glassdoor.
* Our culture rocks! You’ll join a fun\-loving and inclusive work environment that supports your professional growth and personal well\-being.
* We're recognized for our innovation, impact, and outstanding customer support, even earning the Atlassian Partner of the Year 2024–2025 for Co\-Selling Excellence award.

Visit our website to learn more and become a part of our Rocketeer Nation.


### **About the Sales and Success area**

ServiceRocket's Sales \& Success team is the commercial engine of the business as they are focused on finding, growing, and retaining customer relationships. Account Managers own the full customer relationship, from strategic account planning and executive engagement through to renewals, expansions, and partner co\-selling, primarily within the Atlassian ecosystem.


They work as the commercial lead in a cross\-functional "trio" alongside Solution Architects and delivery teams, translating customer needs into profitable software and services solutions. We look for self\-starters with commercial curiosity, MEDPICC discipline, and a hunger to grow a book of business.


### **What you’ll be doing**

* Build and maintain lasting relationships with customers and partners by understanding their focus, anticipating their needs, and solving their problems
* Lead XBRs (real\-time QBRs) for high\-value, high\-touch accounts, focusing on strategic alignment and value demonstration
* Develop strategic problem/solution roadmaps that address current and long\-term customer needs
* Generate leads, manage pipeline, update forecasts, and develop and execute account plans
* Perform prospecting activities such as cold calling and networking
* Close opportunities to achieve sales targets
* Deliver partner software quotes and orders, ensuring eligible deals are registered with the appropriate partner program incentives
* Co\-sell with partners by jointly creating services and software solutions that address customer needs
* Follow up with customers regularly to ensure needs are being met and to identify opportunities
* Maintain CRM and account plans for customers and prospects (HubSpot and NetSuite)
* Coordinate internal and external resources — including Licensing, Services, Solution Architecture, RevOps, Marketing, Finance, and Legal — to improve customers' experience
* Host product demonstrations, webinars, and other online events to educate customers and prospects
* Illustrate the value of ServiceRocket's products and services to create growth opportunities
* Stay current with ServiceRocket's offerings and industry trends
### **What you bring to the table ‍**

* 7\+ years of experience in an account management or sales role
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding targets
* MEDPICC discipline and ability to qualify, progress, and forecast opportunities with clear evidence
* Experience managing commercial conversations with multiple stakeholders — champions, economic buyers, procurement, and executive sponsors
* Deep knowledge of Atlassian's product suite and strong understanding of the enterprise software landscape
* Advanced skills in full\-cycle sales, strategic planning, negotiation, and stakeholder management
* Proven ability to work autonomously and grow a book of business
* Strong communication skills and executive presence — you Talk Straight and build trust quickly
* Experience with CRM discipline and deal documentation; HubSpot and NetSuite experience preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field

### **What We Look For in Sales Rocketeers ✨**

This role is a key member of our sales team, focused on finding and driving both short and long\-term opportunities. You ideally have experience in solution selling, using products such as Atlassian to drive transformational services solutions to customers. Beyond the role requirements, our Sales leadership looks for:
* **Self\-starters** who take initiative, follow through, and own their pipeline without waiting to be directed
* **Hungry and resilient** individuals motivated by goals, comfortable with ambiguity, and proactive about creating opportunities
* **Commercial curiosity** — a genuine interest in understanding customer problems and connecting those needs to ServiceRocket solutions
* **Collaborative sellers** who can work across Customer Success, Solution Engineers, Licensing, Services, and partner teams to create customer outcomes
* **Software sales interest or experience** — SaaS, enterprise software, or Atlassian ecosystem experience is highly preferred but not mandatory when strong sales fundamentals are present
* **Process discipline** — CRM hygiene, qualification frameworks, and forecast accuracy matter here
### **Your leaders**

Kharisma is a volleyball enthusiast, an animal rescue advocate, and our fearless sales leader. With 20\+ years of go\-to\-market leadership, she leads our Global Sales team across four continents with sharp instincts, execution discipline, and a genuine belief in collaborative partnerships. With her and Rob, our founder and CEO, you'll co\-sell with world\-class partners, grow high\-value customer relationships, and sharpen your craft in a team that leads through delighting the customer!  

  

The expectation of office attendance for this hybrid role is 2 times a week at our Palo Alto office.
### **Perks ✨**

* **Share the fruit program** **:** when we grow

jobs.title: Outside Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:** 

This position is to sell Shimadzu Medical Systems USA California Branch product line and services. Customers may include businesses, governmental organizations, and individuals. Sales executives approach potential customers with the aim of winning new business, as well as maintaining good relationships with clients while achieving maximum profitability and growth in line with the company mission and values.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

1\. Assists in the development and implementation of marketing plans as needed.

* Listening to customer needs and presenting appropriate solutions to make a sale.
* Maintaining and developing relationships with existing customers in person and via telephone calls and emails.
* Calling to arrange meetings with ALL customers in assigned territories for current and potential new business on all product lines; Contact with each customer should be a minimum of once per year.
* Timely responding to incoming email and phone enquiries.
* Acting as a contact between a company and its existing and potential markets.
* Negotiating the terms of an agreement and closing sales.
* Gathering market and customer information.
* Representing their company at trade exhibitions, events and demonstrations.
* Challenging any objections with a view to getting the customer to buy.
* Creating detailed proposal documents, often as part of a formal bidding process which is largely dictated by the prospective customer.
* Reviewing your own sales performance, aiming to meet or exceed targets.
* Gaining a clear understanding of customers' businesses and requirements.
* Making accurate, rapid cost calculations and providing customers with quotations.
* Feeding future buying trends back to employers.
* Attending team meetings and sharing best practices with colleagues.

17\. Provides timely feedback to sales manager regarding performance.

18\. Provides timely, accurate, competitive pricing on all completed prospect applications submitted for pricing and approval, while striving to maintain maximum profit margin.

19\. Maintains accurate records of all pricings, sales, and activity reports.

20\. Creates and conducts proposal presentations.

21\. Controls expenses to meet budget guidelines.

22\. Adheres to all company policies, procedures and business ethics codes and ensures that they are communicated and implemented within the team.

23\. Meets product mix goals set by senior management.

24\. Attending sales meetings or gatherings representing SMS gathering new information on products and marketplace and sharing best practice with colleagues. Responsible for educating sales staff on any new information or marketplace changes.

25\. Maintains real\-time data in sales force system, including an accurate 30/60/90 monthly forecast. Will meet with NDS monthly to review forecast.

26\. Sells service contract at POS (Point of Sales) of equipment.

27\. Develops strategic partnership with target key accounts and IDNs in the territory for both products and services revenue increase, including the partnership contract negotiation.

**Internal / External Cooperation**

1\. Develops customer relationships to be used as show sites or reference sites.

2\. Maintains contact with all clients in the market area to ensure high levels of client satisfaction.

3\. Demonstrates ability to interact and cooperate with all company employees.

4\. Demonstrates behaviors consistent with the Company’s Mission and Values in all interactions with customers, co\-workers and suppliers.

5\. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships based on Trust, Respect, and Cooperation with managers, co\-workers, customers and vendors.

6\. Complies with all customer and company policies, procedures and safety standards

7\. Performs all duties in a professional and courteous manner, respectful customer’s needs and patient privacy.

**Skills, Experience, and Job Requirements:**

1\. High School diploma or GED required bachelor’s degree preferred

2\. 5 years business to business outside sales experience preferably in medical imaging capital equipment sales

3\. Entrepreneurial attitude

4\. Proven track record of successfully closing new business

5\. Excellent negotiation \& closing skills

6\. Willingness to travel up to 40\-50% (at least once a week)

7\. Valid driver’s license and is insurable.

8\. Advanced computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Windows applications.

9\. Excellent verbal and written English skills.

10\. Ability to synthesize complex issues and communicate in simple messages

11\. Good organization skills, applies high level of attention to detail and accuracy.

12\. Quality and customer service driven to consistently meet/exceed INTERNAL or EXTERNAL customer expectations.

13\. Team player who is willing to go above and beyond to help others.

14\. Good time management skills, can work independently with minimal supervision.

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
