jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Title:****A****ccount Manager \- Commercial Lines**  

**Hybrid Preferred:**Southern California (Aliso Viejo, Los Angeles County, Ontario, San Diego, or Santa Barbara)  

**Remote:** California residents  

**Book Focus:**Generalist and/or Construction \| **Required:** active property \& casualty (P\&C) license  

  

*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50\-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on\-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction\-free workspace.**Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours.**To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

**About the Role****:** Manage an assigned book of business, ensuring account retention and supporting new business. Coordinate day\-to\-day administrative and customer service activities, resolving complex issues, and ensuring no errors or omissions.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Competence**: Maintain technical competence and industry expertise.
* **Team Leadership**: Direct daily activities of the account management team.
* **Customer Service**: Handle customer service requests, policy administration, billing, claims, and coverage analysis.
* **Policy Management**: Manage policy expirations and renewals.
* **Renewal Process**: Conduct client research, prepare submissions, negotiate coverages, and present proposals.
* **Accounts Receivable**: Monitor reports and take action on delinquent accounts, collecting outstanding balances.
* **System Maintenance**: Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
* **Activity Monitoring:** Monitor and maintain activity/suspense to ensure timely completion.
* **Communication:** Maintain frequent, transparent communication with the account team regarding workload status and any issues.
* **Service Excellence:** Deliver excellent service, proactively anticipate needs, and respond quickly to service requests.
* **Policy Compliance:** Stay updated on company policies and procedures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Seek and adopt best practices to improve individual and team performance.
* **Champion IOA Values:** Demonstrate integrity and leadership.
  

  

**Ideal Candidate****Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of account management experience, or 5\+ years in the insurance industry
* Thorough knowledge of insurance brokerage and client needs
* Required active property \& casualty (P\&C) licensing; professional designation (CIC or equivalent) preferred
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional customer service, communication, multitasking, and organizational skills
* Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
* High School Diploma (or equivalent)
  

  

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salaries and bonus potential
* Company\-paid health insurance
* Paid holidays, vacations, and sick time
* 401K with employer match
* Professional growth and career progression opportunities
* Respectful culture and work/family life balance
* Community service commitment
* Supportive teammates and a rewarding work environment
  

  

**What to Expect****(Application Process)****:**

* 30\-Minute Phone Screen, Online Assessments, and Interview(s)
**Salary Range**


The expected pay range for this position is $80,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 annually depending on experience, relevant skills, and geographic location.


Insurance Office of America is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



The Enterprise Ad Sales Team is responsible for the marketing vision, development and growth of our largest advertising partnerships. This team was recently formed, and is seeking additional founding team members to build an industry\-leading ads and promotions business across DoorDash's core categories, starting with enterprise restaurant and consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands. The growing DoorDash ads business will quickly become the single best place for merchants and brands to market to local customers, in an ecosystem that benefits all parties.



You'll leverage AI\-powered insights, data\-driven signals, and emerging tools to shape strategy, inform decision\-making, identify opportunities, and drive growth across complex, enterprise\-level engagements. By integrating AI and data\-enabled analysis into day\-to\-day workflows, you'll improve prioritization, execution, and business impact while partnering cross\-functionally to translate evolving platform and AI capabilities into clear, tangible value for partners and the business.


**About the Role**
------------------



The Account Manager, CPG will steer the company's efforts in adopting and partnering with major CPGs across our grocery, convenience, restaurant and retail markets. Digital grocery and convenience is expanding, and DoorDash is making meaningful strides to become a leader in this sector. You will build partnerships that create tangible value for both DoorDash and advertisers. In this role, you will manage the ads strategy across a focused portfolio of accounts, and drive adoption of our growing ads and promotions offering. You will also work cross\-functionally with account executives, marketing, analytics, and product to innovate on our future approach and solutions. You will report into a CPG Industry Manager in our Enterprise Sales \& Business Development organization.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Be part of the growing DoorDash Ads \& Promos team
* Lead end\-to\-end marketing conversations across a portfolio of consumer packaged goods (CPG) advertisers
* Oversee the strategy for engaging with and selling to our largest partners
* Steer the development, adoption and scaling of CPG revenue
* Build a marketing calendar with CPG partners in your book of business
* Develop long\-term business plans alongside our partners for their multi\-channel customer strategies
* Maintain pitch decks and sales content to help produce new business opportunities
* Create marketing campaigns; own post\-campaign reporting
* Work with partners across DoorDash to align companywide resources to help build\-out our partners' digital businesses

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have 3\-6 years of cross\-functional operational experience

Impact Motivated * \- You have a natural desire to improve the overall business

Curious * \- You love digging into low levels of detail to extract insights

Strategic * \- You love to find the win\-win in novel agreement structures to grow business with partners

Diverse * \- You are happy juggling many priorities concurrently
* Bachelor's degree required, MBA or Masters Degree a plus
* Prior investment banking, consulting or equity research experience
* Business Development and Partnerships experience
* Experience with Analytics and Presentation tools
* You have proficiency in analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Snowflake, Sigma, etc.)
* Experience leveraging data, AI\-informed insights, and emerging AI tools to drive strategic decisions, enhance productivity, and improve outcomes in complex business environments.
* Strong ability to interpret AI\-generated insights, synthesize them into clear, actionable recommendations and executive\-level narratives, and influence stakeholders.
* Baseline fluency in AI concepts, with a willingness to continuously learn and adopt new technologies as AI capabilities become increasingly embedded in workflows, products, and customer interactions.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

* Minimum high school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum three (3\) – five (5\) years of professional\-level experience required. Prior experience in the security industry, law enforcement and/or military required

jobs.title: Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
**About Adapt**


Every company will have a central company agent. Adapt is the platform for building, running, and governing it. We connect the models a company chooses to its systems, data, people, and workflows. With persistent memory, secure compute, deep integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise controls, Adapt helps the agent understand real context, complete real work, and improve over time.  

We believe this infrastructure should be open, portable, secure, and controlled by the organizations that depend on it. Models will change. What a company builds with Adapt stays theirs. Join us in building the platform that will define how companies work with AI. **About the role**


We are hiring the first dedicated owner of Revenue Operations to build one trusted revenue system from first signal through expansion. You will own the system\-of\-record architecture, data definitions, automation, and operating cadence that connect Marketing, Sales, pilots, product usage, billing, and customer growth.


The role centers on the end\-to\-end user funnel, HubSpot and data foundations, routing and ownership, reliable forecasting, and a small set of high\-value automations. You will be an early and demanding user of Adapt, bringing AI into the revenue team’s daily workflows and turning the strongest patterns into governed, repeatable systems.

 **What you will own**

* Full funnel and CRM architecture. Maintain clear lifecycle, qualification, opportunity, deployment, and expansion definitions, plus the CRM objects, properties, associations, permissions, and workflows that support them.
* Routing and handoffs. Design and enforce fit, intent, assignment, response\-time, qualification, and closed\-won handoff rules.
* Pipeline and forecasting. Run opportunity hygiene, forecasting, pipeline inspection, and decision\-ready reporting that revenue leadership can trust.
* Cross\-system context. Connect marketing engagement, sales activity, product usage, billing, and customer signals into useful account and opportunity context using analytics, SQL, APIs, and integrations.
* Automation and governance. Build auditable workflows and lightweight internal tools that remove repetitive work while preserving ownership, permissions, and human review.

 **What success looks like**

* The company operates from one agreed funnel, one active sales pipeline, and trusted definitions.
* Routing, opportunity data, forecast reporting, and customer handoffs are reliable enough to support daily and weekly decisions.
* A small number of trusted AI\-assisted revenue workflows are documented, adopted, and automated, returning time to customer\-facing teams while preserving ownership and human review.
* A revenue operating system where no potential customer signal or lead is left behind.

 **What we are looking for**

* 4\+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or go\-to\-market systems
* Deep experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM platform, including architecture, workflows, permissions, reporting, and data quality
* Strong analytical ability using SQL, spreadsheets, BI, or product analytics tools
* Comfort with APIs, integrations, workflow automation, and lightweight internal\-tool development

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Adapt**


Every company will have a central company agent. Adapt is the platform for building, running, and governing it. We connect the models a company chooses to its systems, data, people, and workflows. With persistent memory, secure compute, deep integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise controls, Adapt helps the agent understand real context, complete real work, and improve over time.  

We believe this infrastructure should be open, portable, secure, and controlled by the organizations that depend on it. Models will change. What a company builds with Adapt stays theirs. Join us in building the platform that will define how companies work with AI. **About the role**


We are hiring an early Business Development Representative to create high\-quality sales opportunities with companies that can become great Adapt customers. You will combine account research, product and market signals, thoughtful outreach, and technical curiosity to open the right conversations.


You will find companies with a real reason to care about Adapt and earn the first serious conversation. That means researching accounts, reading product and market signals, writing outreach that shows judgment, and learning enough to identify a credible problem, champion, and next step. Your work is judged by whether your Account Executive accepts the opportunity and it advances, not by email volume or meetings booked. You own the journey from target\-account research through a well\-qualified handoff; the Account Executive owns deeper discovery and the opportunity after acceptance.


You will use AI deeply for research, signal detection, personalization, and experimentation without treating automation as a substitute for judgment or empathy.

 **What you will own**

* Account research and prioritization. Understand a company's business, team, systems, AI posture, likely workflows, relevant events, and buying committee before reaching out.
* Signal\-led outreach. Use product activity, website intent, hiring, funding, relationships, and market events to prioritize relevant outreach across email, LinkedIn, communities, and events.
* Early qualification. Establish the trigger, problem, likely use case, account fit, initial champion, and next step before requesting sales acceptance.
* Handoff quality. Give the Account Executive clear context on why the account engaged, what matters, who is involved, and what has already been learned.
* Experimentation and feedback. Test research methods, AI\-assisted workflows, messages, channels, and account plays while returning objections and market patterns to Sales, Marketing, and Product.

 **What success looks like**

* You meet the agreed ramp target for sales\-accepted opportunities and sourced qualified pipeline.
* Your handoffs convert because they contain useful account, stakeholder, problem, and timing context.
* You build repeatable, AI\-assisted research and outbound workflows that improve relevance, learning speed, and accepted opportunities, and you can explain what signals, audiences, and messages are working.

 **What we are looking for**

* 1\+ years in business development, sales development, recruiting, customer\-facing work, or another high\-accountability professional role
* Strong concise writing and evidence that you can earn attention through thoughtful, personalized outreach
* Curiosity about AI, developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, and how companies operate
* An AI\-native operating mindset: you are excited to test new tools, redesign your workflows, and continually improve how high\-quality opportunities are created
* Organization, follow\-through, resilience, and high standards for CRM data
* Experience selling or recruiting technical audiences
* Experience building research, enrichment, or outbound automations

 **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation strategy including large equity grants for early hires at an early stage in the company's journey
* Inclusive healthcare packages (medical, dental, vision)
* Frontier AI access: Claude Code, OpenAI, Cursor, Codex, and most importantly unlimited internal use of Adapt itself

jobs.description:
Mosaic is the leading North American Integrated Agency, specializing in Experiential Marketing, Sales and Merchandising. At Mosaic, we are never satisfied with the status quo and are in constant search for new ideas and new ways to help our clients build their brands, amidst the evolving dynamic of empowered consumers leveraging new technologies.


Mosaic is currently seeking a highly driven Territory Sales Representative (Full Time) primarily responsible for managing retail stores in a dedicated geographical territory. The TSR will cultivate relationships with retail partners and field leadership and collaborate to drive strategic initiatives for increased sales and market share of brand products.


The qualified individual must possess a strong passion for success, an abundance of energy, committed to delivering superior service and performance, a team player excited to learn and grow as a member of the Mosaic team. Additionally, the candidate must be able to comfortably explain appliance benefits and technology, be able to educate consumers and sales associates, make product recommendations, and build strong relationships in the stores to ultimately drive an increase in sales of Whirlpool products.


Salary $70,000 Plus Bonus Potential

* Responsible for a geographic territory and supporting national accounts and key independent trade customers both in person as well as virtually to build relationships and ensure sales targets are achieved, all while identifying and analyzing performance trends.
* Build and maintain essential relationships with trade customers through conducting group meetings, incentives, lunch \& learns, and other strategic activities to help drive sales.
* While not directly responsible for maintaining the physical presence of products on display and managing plan\-o\-gram product placement, building relationships with Mosaic and Display Execution teams and store merchandise and management teams is critical to the overall success of the program.
* Deliver presentations where needed to educate retail, direct and business teams on clients' key product differentiators, messages, promotions, etc.
* Gather competitive intelligence and report on specific competitive tactics including price moves, new products and merchandising materials;
* Maintain working knowledge of all products to be a subject matter expert and direct questions from retail associates related to product issues, allocation and inventory challenges to clients' field sales team.
* As requested, attend and execute at marketing events, customer rallies, product launch activities to educate and train on clients' products key features and service offerings.
* Miscellaneous duties as assigned.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business preferred
* 1 \- 3 years of retail sales and/or training experience
* Experience with home appliance, specific to either retail, direct, business and/or national retail
* Must be tech savvy with enthusiasm for home improvement!
 **Knowledge, Skill and Ability Requirements:**

* Exhibit an energetic and enthusiastic attitude and tremendous interpersonal communication skills
* Communicate effectively in group presentations and demonstrations
* Ability to coordinate and lead formal / informal training events on product features and benefits within store, market and virtually.
* Independent and motivated team player
* Ability to work full\-time, Monday\-Friday. Some schedule shifts required, including select weekends and promotional holidays.
* Ability to lift at least 50lbs
* Must reside in a centrally\-located approved area for the assigned territory
* Reliable transportation with valid driver's license
* Strong working knowledge of Google G Suite preferred
* Ability to utilize or acquire a cellular device approved by Whirlpool corporation for business communications.
 **Along with competitive pay, we offer a comprehensive benefits program. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. This role may be eligible for the following:**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug and Telehealth
* Tax Savings through Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare and Dependent Care) and Health Savings Account
* Company Paid Basic \& Voluntary Life Insurance
* 401(k) Plan with Company Match
* Legal Insurance
* Company Paid Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Employee Discount Program
* Tuition Reimbursement *(Degree and Professional Certification Programs)*
* Bonus Opportunities \+ Technology Reimbursement
* Access to Use Approved AI Tools
* Excellent Recognition Programs
* Committed to Development with Dedicating a Day for this Purpose Quarterly and Providing Programs for Leadership Development and Management Essentials
* Actively Promotes from Within
* Represent a Company Dedicated to a Sustainable Future

As part of the Acosta Group, Mosaic is one of the original marketing agencies who specialize in interactions, experience isn’t just what we have, it's what we create. jobs.title: Strategic Accounts Manager (Client Services)
jobs.description:
Linqia is an innovative start\-up in the growing influencer marketing industry. Located in downtown San Francisco, you'll be working with others who are passionate about marketing in a fun, fast\-paced and data\-driven environment.



At Linqia, we deliver guaranteed influencer marketing results for our clients, by working with some of the world's largest brands including Danonne, AB InBev, Kimberly\-Clark, Unilever, and Walmart. Our AI\-driven platform and team of experts are leading the transformation of influencer marketing into a scalable media channel. The Linqia platform also serves as a social content lab, where marketers can organically test and amplify the best performing influencer content to drive greater ROI from their paid, owned and earned media.



We value intelligence, recognize talent and have instilled a culture that supports career development and growth for our employees. We thrive on innovation and accountability, with a customer first attitude that adds true value to everything we touch. Our team members are smart, hard\-working, have integrity and love to have fun as we play to win.


### **The Role:**



The Strategic Accounts Manager is a critical client partner role demonstrating leadership, strategic direction, accountability, business acumen, and vision for Linqia's portfolio of enterprise brand clients. The Strategic Accounts Manager effectively leverages experience, knowledge, and skills to drive innovative thinking while balancing client, company, and team needs. The role provides oversight and approval of the development of higher arching media/influencer objectives and strategies, as well as the related ideation to support such goals. Ensuring that proper tools and processes are effectively applied to planning and buying activities, with the goal of optimizing deliverables and providing a solid rationale to recommendations.



This position will be responsible for select client accounts, managing the relationship between Media Agency, Creative Agency and Brand. The primary goal for this role is to provide excellent customer experiences and repeat business. You will lead and provide oversight for internal teams working on your programs. The role acts as the steward for both Linqia and the client, establishing transparency and clear communication from pre\-IO to launch.



The Strategic Accounts Manager reports into Linqia's Director of Strategic Accounts.


### **What You'll Do:**


* Manage the oversight of a client's campaign with superior customer service while maximizing business opportunities, growth, and efficiency
* Responsible for meeting business KPI's and development within signed IO's
* Owner of the Client Experience and responsible for exceeding client expectations and creating long term partnerships.
* Lead strategic channel planning activities associated with assigned campaigns in partnership with creative, brand success, sales, and media investment
* Establish and grow a strong relationship with multiple senior client stakeholders through a demonstration of client industry and influencer knowledge
* Work with internal partners to gauge campaign performance and KPI's to determine the extent to which the original objectives and strategies were met
* Proactively keep abreast of industry trends and share knowledge with the team
* Work closely with internal partners to optimize any revenue opportunities with particular clients

### **Qualifications:**


* 5\+ years of client management and media (or influencer) experience within agencies
* Driven by delighting customers, customer satisfaction drives your work
* Passion for the social media space. Enjoy learning new social media platforms or understanding how people use these platforms to communicate as well as how advertising and influencers use social media platforms
* Entrepreneurial, self\-motivator who isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves and solve problems, as well as determining your own deadlines, benchmarks, and goals
* Proven track record of client and team success
* Experience and comfort with high\-level client communications
* Bachelor's degree, MBA is preferred
* Must be within commuting distance of Linqia's SF office (employees are required to come into the office twice a week)

  



This position description is intended to describe the duties most frequently performed by an individual in this position. Linqia is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ\+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.


Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes or candidates through this Web site or directly to employees. Linqia does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes and will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with us.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - San Francisco
jobs.description:
Sales · Full\-time · San Francisco

  

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

### **About the role**


As a Sales Development Representative at Cursor, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. You'll work across the full range of our commercial segments, from fast\-moving startups to mid\-market engineering organizations, identifying the right buyers and creating the conditions for meaningful sales conversations.


This isn't a role for someone who waits for leads to come in. You'll build pipeline from scratch, learn how great engineering teams think, and develop a deep understanding of how Cursor transforms developer productivity. It's the fastest way to learn enterprise sales at one of the most exciting companies in AI.

 **What you'll do**

* Generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team through high\-volume outbound prospecting, including cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and creative multi\-channel sequences
* Research target accounts and map stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Leadership to identify the right entry points
* Conduct discovery conversations that go beyond surface\-level qualification, understand how development teams work, what's slowing them down, and where Cursor fits
* Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, hand off opportunities cleanly, and stay looped in as deals progress
* Hit and exceed weekly activity targets and monthly qualified meeting goals
* Represent Cursor's brand and product with conviction; you'll be many prospects' first impression of the company
* Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing
* Help build the playbook. As an early SDR, your patterns and learnings will shape how this function scales

 **You may be a fit if**

* You have 1–2 years of experience in a sales, customer\-facing, or business development role. SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company is a strong plus
* You're a relentless self\-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads
* You write and speak with clarity. You can explain a complex product simply and tailor your message to a technical audience
* You're curious about how software gets built and excited by the idea that AI is fundamentally changing the craft
* You're organized and data\-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly
* You have thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast
* You want to grow into an Account Executive role and are willing to put in the reps to get there

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------


Hedge is building an AI\-native specialty insurance company. We help independent retail insurance agencies place difficult commercial risks faster and with better market access.


As a Business Development Representative, you will open new agency relationships and help turn them into durable submission flow. You will work directly with the founders, learn commercial insurance from the inside, and help build the playbook that future revenue teams will use.

  

**COMPENSATION AND UPSIDE**
---------------------------

**$200,000 target OTE at an $80,000 base salary.**

* **Base salary:** $60,000 to $100,000, depending on experience
* **Target cash compensation:** $180,000 to $220,000 across that base range
* **Variable plan:** sourced bound\-revenue incentive plus $50 for each held, qualified meeting, with meeting pay capped at $15,000 per year
* **Revenue upside:** uncapped, with accelerators above quota
* **Equity:** intended 0\.10% initial grant plus a 0\.05% performance grant, subject to board approval and final grant documentation
* **Annual production target:** $2\.5 million of sourced bound new premium


OTE means on\-target earnings. It assumes the role achieves its annual performance targets and is not guaranteed compensation.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
---------------------

* Research and prioritize independent retail insurance agencies and commercial producers
* Build new relationships through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, conferences, and creative outbound
* Learn where an agency's commercial accounts are getting stuck and identify where Hedge can help
* Qualify agencies based on business mix, submission potential, decision\-making authority, and fit
* Earn held meetings with agency owners, producers, practice leaders, and operations executives
* Create complete handoffs with clear context, next steps, and CRM records
* Test messaging, targeting, sequences, call scripts, and follow\-up cadences
* Track which conversations become active agencies, submissions, and bound premium
* Use AI, data, and automation to make prospect research and follow\-up faster without making the outreach generic
* Help recruit and coach future BDRs as the team grows

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------


In your first 30 days, you will learn Hedge's target agency profile, appetite, and brokerage workflow; build an initial account list; and begin live outreach.


By 60 days, you will run a consistent multichannel prospecting rhythm, book qualified meetings, and show that your targeting and message improve from real conversations.


By 90 days, you will be producing repeatable qualified pipeline, maintaining a clean CRM, and showing a credible path toward the annual sourced\-premium target.

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

* Evidence that you can create opportunities, not just complete activities
* Comfort spending meaningful time on the phone
* Clear, concise writing and professional follow\-through
* Strong research, organization, and attention to detail
* Resilience, curiosity, and comfort receiving direct feedback
* Interest in building a sales system rather than inheriting a finished playbook
* Experience with a CRM, sales\-engagement platform, recruiting, agency sales, or outbound sales is helpful
* Insurance experience is useful but not required

  

**WORKING AT HEDGE**
--------------------


This is a full\-time, in\-office role in San Francisco. We work six days a week as a small, high\-urgency founding team. Hedge provides health benefits, direct coaching from the founders, and a path toward Account Executive, brokerage distribution, or revenue leadership.

  

**HOW WE HIRE**
---------------

* A 30\-minute founder conversation about your background, goals, and evidence of performance.
* A live prospecting exercise using a hypothetical independent insurance agency. There is no take\-home assignment.
* A short cold\-call simulation focused on preparation, clarity, curiosity, and objection handling.
* A final founder conversation covering the compensation plan, equity, working style, and first 90 days.


When there is strong mutual fit, our goal is to move from the first conversation to an offer in approximately five days.


Compensation Range: $60K \- $100K

jobs.title: High Rise Assistant Community Manager - Multifamily
jobs.description:
Overview:

When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Our legacy is rooted in innovation and excellence, earning us a spot on Fast Company’s esteemed annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, as well as recognition as one of U.S. News \& World Report’s Best Companies to Work For in 2024\. Discover endless opportunities to grow and make your mark at Hines.
Responsibilities:

We’re creating places people are proud to call home and supporting teams who take pride in delivering hospitality\-focused experiences every day all while building lasting, meaningful careers along the way. Backed by Hines, a global real estate investment, development, and property management firm, Hines Living is one of the firm’s highest\-conviction growth priorities, expanding rapidly across North America. Come grow with us!  

As an Assistant Community Manager \- Multifamily with Hines, you will be responsible for supporting and assisting the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close\-out and financial reports. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables
* Reviews resident files and accounting records, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue
* Adheres to Hines’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased
* Processes resident move\-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues
* Acts as the on\-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, and coordinating maintenance and make\-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed


Qualifications:

Minimum Requirements include:  

* High school education or equivalent from accredited institution
* Two or more years prior experience in property management or in a related industry preferred
* Experience with property management software preferred; Entrada experience a plus
* Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office
* Knowledge of basic accounting practices
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Work indoors approximately 95% of the time and outdoors 5% of the time
* Use olfactory, auditory, and visual senses to inspect building and detect emergency alarms
* On occasion, perform physical inspections of the property which may include climbing up and down stairs or accessing restrictive openings
* Ability to lift up to 25lbs
* Though occurrences are rare, be accessible 24 hours a day in case of an emergency and perform on\-site operations management during natural disasters
* Transfer properties and work overtime as business needs deem appropriate
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including weekends and holidays
* Compensation: $31\.25 \- $40


Closing:

At Hines, we strive for excellence as a leading global real estate investment manager, driven by our by our belief that real estate is fundamentally about people. Our diverse portfolio spans $93\.2 billion¹ of assets across such property types as living, office, retail, mixed\-use, logistics and life science projects – all designed to enhance value, connection and inspiration. Our strategic approach integrates local expertise with global knowledge, taking calculated risks aligned with our convictions to exceed expectations and tailor solutions to our clients' needs.  

While our projects are renowned for enhancing cities and pioneering sustainable practices, we recognize that the true driving force behind Hines' success is our 5,000 dedicated employees in 30 countries who draw on our 65\-year history to build the world forward. This is why we prioritize investing in our people, offering comprehensive training, competitive compensation, robust benefits and generous vacation packages. By centering our focus on the growth and wellbeing of our team, we cultivate an inclusive environment where everyone, including our clients, can thrive.  

Hines is proud to be named to Fast Company’s prestigious annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2024\. ¹Includes both the global Hines organization and RIA AUM as of December 31, 2023\. *We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity.* *No calls or emails from third parties at this time please.*

jobs.description:
**Overview**


Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.


The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Project Coordinator in our Quality, Outcome Research, \& Analytics (QORA) department!


This is a full\-time, benefits\-eligible, grant\-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire April 1, 2027 with the possibility of extension.


This position can be home\-based.


The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work\-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award\-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.


\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work\-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of health sciences research and measure development initiatives through project coordination, administrative support, stakeholder engagement, and program operations. * Support virtual meeting logistics and technology setup.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for project participants, subject matter experts, and external partners, coordinating communications, responding to inquiries, and assisting with onboarding activities.
* Prepare and maintain project documentation, status reports, meeting summaries, dashboards, stakeholder updates, and other materials aligned with project goals and timelines.
* Assist with the development and dissemination of program materials, templates, reports, and resources.
* Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, and meeting schedules to support successful execution of research and measure development activities.

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of three (3\) years of relevant experience that includes administrative and/or project coordination experience.
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet specified timelines.
* Administrative expertise with sophisticated clerical responsibilities and data management.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal skills with proven ability to develop collaborative working relationships internally and externally.
* Experience coordinating meetings, events, or project activities across multiple stakeholder groups.

* Experience supporting health sciences, research, quality improvement, measurement, or healthcare\-related projects.
* Experience working with subject matter experts, researchers, healthcare professionals, or external partners.
* Knowledge of basic data tracking, reporting, or research support processes.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint. Experience working with project management, database, or collaboration systems is a plus.

jobs.title: ASAP Engagement Coordinator (Academic ASAP Program Coordinator)
jobs.description:
ASAP Engagement Coordinator (Academic ASAP Program Coordinator)


**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low\-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017\) and the Brookings Institution (2020\).Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.


Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps motivated community college students earn degrees as quickly as possible, with a goal of graduating at least 50% of students within three years. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full\-time study, mandatory tutoring, and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid\-eligible students and free use of textbooks and monthly Transportation support for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP About ASAP Labor \& Employment Law


Reporting to the ASAP Assistant Director for Collaborative Strategy, the engagement coordinator will develop and manage broad student engagement efforts. They will work closely with campus student support areas on initiatives and interventions that support and promote student success. The coordinator provides operational and analytical support related to ASAP program needs. They perform duties including but not limited to the following:


* Monitors and maintains student enrollment and information databases; collects and maintains statistical data, and prepares reports and surveys using student information and enrollment data;
* Collects information to evaluate program/event success and reports results;
* Serves as liaison to various College offices to ensure smooth operations and verification of student information;
* Creates and distributes marketing and promotional and event materials for ASAP programming;
* Assists with the coordination and execution of student activities, workshops, meetings and special events and develops engagement strategies to support student success and assist the program with meeting retention goals and benchmarks;
* Collaborates with ASAP advisors to provide supports to students on academic probation;
* Connects new and continuing ASAP students to campus resources, co\-curricular, and engagement opportunities;
* Develops and facilitates student success workshops on various topics, for example: time management, test anxiety, college transition, co\-curricular involvement, and experiential learning, etc;
* Collaborates with Academic Program Specialist, Engagement Specialist, and Career Specialist to support special initiatives (e.g. STEM; Foster Care Initiative; Research Scholars);
* Provides mentoring and guidance to support to a small cohort of students as needed and has flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


Bachelor's degree required.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Experience in higher education or working with college students strongly preferred
* Strong understanding of the educational needs and challenges facing students from diverse urban backgrounds
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team as well as independently with minimal supervision
* Experience developing, organizing and delivering presentations to students and staff
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Experience providing coaching and mentoring
* Experience with MS office (word, excel)
* Demonstrated knowledge of equitable and inclusive practices to support and engage students


**CUNY TITLE OVERVIEW**


Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP) helps students earn their college degree as quickly as possible by removing the financial, academic, and personal obstacles that many students confront. Key ASAP program features include a consolidated block schedule, cohorts by major, required full\-time study and comprehensive advisement and career development services. Financial incentives include tuition waivers for financial aid eligible students, yearly textbook vouchers, and MetroCards for all students. Further information is available at www.cuny.edu/ASAP.


The ASAP Program Coordinator provides basic operational and analytical support related to a College's ASAP program.


* Monitors and maintains student enrollment and information databases; collects and maintains statistical data
* Prepares reports and surveys using student information and enrollment data
* Collects information to evaluate program/event success and reports results
* Serves as liaison to various College offices to ensure smooth operations and verification of student information
* Creates and distributes marketing and promotional and event materials for ASAP programming
* Assists with the coordination and execution of student activities, workshops, meetings and special events
* Performs related duties as assigned

Assistant to HEO

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (part-time)
jobs.description:
At InterExchange, we are on a mission to promote meaningful intercultural connections through experiential international exchange programs. Our Career Training USA program promotes professional development and cross\-cultural collaboration by helping a diverse group of participants intern or train with U.S. businesses. If you are enthusiastic about supporting work\-based learning and are a flexible and diplomatic team player who is ready to learn all aspects of this unique exchange program, we want you to join us!
As our new Program Coordinator, you will be the initial point of contact for prospective interns and trainees and their U.S. host employers, educating them about the program and visa sponsorship process. You will coach participants and hosts throughout the application process and take ownership over application decisions. While participants are in\-country, you will offer assistance and direct them and their hosts to resources to ensure they have a successful experience. Finally, you will also collaborate with colleagues on the team and across the organization to ensure our participants are happy and safe and that our program doesn’t just adhere to regulations but also provides life\-changing cultural exchange experiences.


**What you'll do:*** Provide excellent customer service to prospective applicants and host organizations who inquire about the program and use your expertise to provide timely and helpful information
* Advise and assist applicants and hosts throughout the visa sponsorship application process, while encouraging best practices to ensure success and satisfaction
* Review applications and screen and interview participants and hosts to assess their eligibility for the Career Training USA program, per Department of State regulations
* Guide participants and hosts throughout the in\-country program, answering questions and highlighting resources for having an exceptional experience in the U.S.




**Who you are:*** An enthusiastic self\-starter who enjoys working with people of diverse nationalities and cultures
* A detail\-oriented individual who has proven strategies for time\-management and prioritization
* A problem\-solver who can approach issues with compassion and cultural sensitivity
* A decision\-maker who is comfortable guiding others through ambiguous or evolving situations




**Your Qualifications Include:*** Demonstrated experience in administrative and/or customer service roles, either through work or internships
* Strong motivation to proactively identify opportunities and address potential challenges
* Ability to express ideas clearly and concisely in verbal and written form, adapting to different internal/external audiences
* Strong attention to detail, with accuracy and consistency of work, balanced with effective time management
* Proficiency in productivity applications, i.e., Microsoft/Google Suites, with a willingness to learn our proprietary software and internal communications tools




**Compensation:**
$30 \- 35 / hour,based on your level of experience


**Schedule \& Hours:**This is a part\-time role, at 20–21 hours per week, with flexibility in how your hours are structured. The preferred schedule options are:* 4 hours / day, 5 days / week (Mon \& Fri onsite, Tue \- Thu remote)
* 7 hours / day, 3 days / week (fully onsite)


Hours are scheduled Monday through Friday, between 9:30 AM and 5:30 PM, with flexible start and end times available within that window.


**Location:**
You’ll be based in our downtown Manhattan office at least Tuesday through Thursday, and additional days may be worked remotely as needed


**Start Date:**Preferably as soon as October 1, 2026, depending on your availability.


**Travel:** None
### **How to Apply**

### **Complete our online application and upload your resume**




**Benefits \& Perks of Employment at InterExchange*** Affordable, quality medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k retirement plan with safe harbor employer contribution
* Generous paid time off and health time off package
* Employer\-sponsored life insurance
* Flex\-time options
* Professional Development \& Educational Assistance Program
* Pre\-tax FSA for medical and/or dependent care expenses
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Supplemental insurance plans
* Pet Insurance Discount




### **About Us**


InterExchange is a private, nonprofit organization with over 50 years of experience in international cultural exchange. We are dedicated to promoting international understanding through development and implementation of affordable intercultural and life experiential work/training opportunities. By participating in InterExchange programs both in the U.S. and abroad, tens of thousands of young people and their hosts have gained insight into other cultures. InterExchange is designated by the U.S. Department of State to sponsor several J\-1 Visa exchange programs including Au Pair USA, Work \& Travel USA, Camp USA, and Career Training USA. Program participants are placed in the U.S. and abroad by InterExchange in collaboration with international cooperating agencies and government agencies. jobs.description:
**JCCA** is seeking a **Program Coordinator** to manage the day\-day of the **Arches Mentoring Program**, a transformative mentoring program serving young adults on probation. Arches connects young adults with trained community mentors through intensive one\-on\-one and group mentoring, using an evidence\-informed **Interactive Journaling** model to support positive development, strengthen life skills, and promote successful outcomes.


The Program Coordinator will play a key leadership role in the day\-to\-day operation of the program, including recruiting and supervising mentors, coordinating referrals and services, supporting program participants, building community partnerships, and ensuring program quality and contract requirements are met.


The ideal candidate is a creative, energetic, and organized professional who is passionate about working with young adults and has demonstrated success engaging and supporting youth with complex needs.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Recruit, hire, train, and supervise mentors for the Arches program.
* Provide ongoing coaching, guidance, and professional development feedback to mentors.
* Provide 24/7 program support and backup to mentors, including responding to emergency situations involving program participants as needed.
* Complete required **Interactive Journaling** training and other program\-required training.
* Ensure high\-quality and consistent implementation of the Arches Interactive Journaling curriculum.
* Coordinate, process, and assign referrals to the program.
* Schedule and conduct formal Arches orientations for new participants in collaboration with program mentors.
* Provide weekly individual and group supervision to program mentors.
* Ensure mentors provide intensive, comprehensive support to assigned participants across areas including education, employment/vocation, social development, recreation, medical needs, and mental health.
* Maintain regular communication with assigned Probation Officers and other collateral contacts regarding participant progress and service plans.
* Ensure intake assessments, progress notes, reports, and participant records are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with JCCA and Department of Probation standards.
* Monitor participant progress and ensure program outcomes and contract deliverables are achieved within required timeframes.
* Collect, track, analyze, and report program data and outcomes as required internally and externally.
* Conduct program evaluation and monitoring activities to promote quality, fidelity, and program effectiveness.
* Participate in regular supervision with the Arches Program Director.
* Plan and coordinate participant engagement and incentive activities, including graduation celebrations, recreational activities, and group events.
* Develop and maintain a Community Advisory Board and produce a monthly program newsletter.
* Participate in community outreach activities to educate the community about Arches, establish partnerships, and cultivate referrals.
* Represent the Arches Program at community meetings, events, and other public forums.
* Attend required trainings, technical assistance sessions, and professional development activities identified by JCCA or the Department of Probation.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with five years of relevant program experience; Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) or a comparable degree preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working creatively and effectively with challenging youth or young adults.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build positive relationships with youth, mentors, families, Probation Officers, and community partners.
* Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with a multidisciplinary team.
* Strong documentation, data tracking, and reporting skills.
* Ability to respond effectively to crisis situations and provide support in a fast\-paced program environment.
* Previous personal or professional experience working with the Department of Probation or experience working with justice\-involved youth or young adults.
* Experience supervising staff, mentors, volunteers, or other direct\-service professionals.
* Experience with mentoring, youth development, community\-based programming, or restorative/behavioral interventions.

### **Why Join JCCA?**


At JCCA, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of young people while working alongside professionals who are committed to strengthening families and communities. The Arches Program offers an opportunity to combine **program leadership, staff development, community engagement, and direct impact with young adults**.

**Salary:** $66,300 annually

jobs.description:
About Masa
  
Masa partners with Mexican and Latino children, youth, and families in the South Bronx to develop strong learners and leaders who fully contribute to the broader community. We envision a community that is civically engaged, empowered, and educated.
  
Masa’s community\-led, integrated model engages the entire family, grounded in a deep commitment to strengthening literacy, leadership, and power for Mexican, Central American, and Indigenous People. Masa fosters a culturally responsive learning community in which families engage with direct service and advocacy programs to dismantle barriers to success.

The Bilingual Immigration Program Specialist reports to the Programs Manager and will provide administrative and programmatic support to Masa’s Pro Se Plus Project \& the Welcome New York initiative. This role will focus on conducting program outreach, providing limited individual case management and referrals, including immigration and social services referrals, conducting immigration legal screenings, coordinating and providing Pro Se application assistance with the support of immigration attorneys, and providing community education and Know Your Rights Presentations.

Prior experience in providing immigration support services is highly desirable.
  
This is a full\-time position that will run through June 30th, 2027, with possibility of extension contingent on funding.

General

* Engagement: Ability to engage residents in their homes when hoarding behaviors and ADL challenges are present, balancing safety requirements with dignity, autonomy, and trust\-building.

Administrative Coordinator \- International Student Services


**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens, LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low\-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017\) and the Brookings Institution (2020\). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.

**Who are we?**


City Harvest is New York’s first and largest food rescue organization and a fast\-paced, high\-performing nonprofit dedicated to helping feed millions of New Yorkers who struggle to put meals on their tables. During our more than 40 years serving New Yorkers in need, we have rescued more than one billion pounds of fresh, nutritious food and delivered it free of charge to hundreds of food pantries, soup kitchens, community partners, and our own Mobile Markets across the five boroughs. This year, we will rescue and distribute more than 100 million pounds of nutritious food to our neighbors in need. City Harvest works alongside our community partners to boost community capacity, expand nutrition education, and strengthen local food systems. Since our founding in 1982, City Harvest has always been there to feed our city one day, one meal, and one New Yorker at a time while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and excellence to maximize our impact across New York City.

**Who are you?**


You are a team player and a highly motivated self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. You have a passion for logistics, data, and continuous improvement, and you’re eager to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to keep our operations running smoothly. Experience with routing, dispatching, and performance management is a plus. You focus on details while keeping an eye on the big picture, and you see challenges as opportunities to improve how we serve New Yorkers.

**Job Description:**


The Logistics Coordinator plays a critical role in City Harvest’s daily operations by managing routing, dispatch, and data analysis that drive key organizational outcomes. This person supports the planning, scheduling, and monitoring of routes while helping identify and implement improvements to increase on\-time performance, reduce undeliverables, and enhance capacity utilization. The role collaborates closely with Transportation, Network Relations, Supply Chain NY, Warehouse, and Business Intelligence teams to ensure smooth execution.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Support day\-to\-day planning, routing, and logistics operations for City Harvest’s network.
* Provide real\-time updates and act as a key point of contact for routing changes, callouts, and urgent adjustments.
* Analyze operational data in Field Service, Samsara, and Power BI to identify trends and recommend process improvements.
* Assist in creating and maintaining routing documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Contribute to the achievement of departmental KPIs, including on\-time performance, capacity utilization, and delivery success rates.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with other departments to address logistics issues and ensure smooth coordination of deliveries and pickups.
* Support seasonal routing efforts (e.g., holiday proteins, large rescues, special events) and manage high\-volume irregular stop requests.
* Contribute to data accuracy by reconciling route completion data and processing undeliverables with detailed notes.
* Communicate effectively across teams to keep stakeholders informed on key operational updates and issues.

**Skills \& Experience**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, Samsara, and Excel; familiarity with Power BI.
* Ability to adapt quickly and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Attention to detail, accuracy in documentation, and commitment to continuous improvement

**Why work at City Harvest?**


There are many fantastic reasons to choose a career with City Harvest. In addition to fighting food insecurity in New York, City Harvest offers the following Benefits and Rewards:

* Competitive market salaries
* Generous time off
* Full benefits (medical, dental, vision) \- employer contributions towards premiums
* Pet Insurance
* 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer\-matching
* Free Mental Health Services with Better Help
* Commuter Benefits
* Employer\-provided life insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Discounted staff perks (e.g. movie tickets, gym memberships, cellular plans)


At City Harvest, we enjoy working in a team\-based environment and value the benefits of a diversified workplace. City Harvest is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Solutions Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
The Solutions Marketing Associate helps Sales create more quality client conversations while delivering fast, polished support for everyday opportunities. This role sits closest to the front end of the sales funnel: helping sellers identify the right accounts, do their homework, personalize outreach, and turn established marketing materials into relevant client\-facing presentations.


For standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, the Associate uses existing positioning, narratives, templates, research, case studies, and proof points to efficiently build tailored sales materials without recreating strategy from scratch. At the prospecting stage, the Associate gives sellers the account intelligence and lead development support they need to earn more meetings.


This role builds the intelligence and inputs behind outreach but does not conduct cold calling, prospecting outreach, or appointment setting.


The north star is twofold: help Sales get into more of the right conversations, and help them show up to those conversations prepared.


**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Prospecting \& Meeting Generation Support**

* Identify and research target accounts that fit priority audiences, verticals, solutions, or seller territories.
* Build and maintain actionable lead and account lists with the context sellers need to prioritize outreach.
* Research target companies, key contacts, recent business developments, marketing activity, competitive context, and relevant signals that can create a reason to engage.
* Prepare concise account briefs and outreach inputs that help sellers personalize emails, calls, and meeting requests.
* Connect prospect needs and business signals to relevant Digital Remedy capabilities, proof points, content, and conversation starters.
* Partner with Sales on focused prospecting initiatives and campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings.
* Track which research, prospecting themes, and materials are helping sellers open doors and use those learnings to improve future support.

### **Sales Presentations \& Everyday Opportunity Support**

* Support standard and smaller opportunities, typically $100K or less, by tailoring existing presentations and materials to the customer and opportunity.
* Build polished client\-facing decks using established templates, positioning, solution narratives, case studies, research, and proof points.
* Quickly identify the most relevant existing materials instead of rebuilding presentations from scratch.
* Perform light account, category, audience, or competitive research when needed to make an established story more relevant.
* Ensure materials are accurate, on\-brand, easy for sellers to present, and aligned with established messaging.
* Escalate opportunities that require original research, custom strategy, or a new problem\-led narrative to the Solutions Marketing Analyst or Manager.

### **Sales Alignment \& Enablement**

* Serve as a highly responsive day\-to\-day partner to Sales, understanding seller priorities, pipeline needs, and recurring friction points.
* Help sellers navigate available materials, case studies, research, and solution stories so they can self\-serve effectively when appropriate.
* Capture recurring requests and content gaps and share them with the Solutions Marketing Manager and Product \& Enablement team.
* Support broader sales and marketing initiatives that create demand, improve seller preparedness, or accelerate opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Sellers have a consistent pipeline of well\-researched accounts and stronger reasons to reach out.
* Prospecting support contributes to more qualified meetings and new sales conversations.
* Smaller and standard opportunities receive fast, polished, relevant presentation support without unnecessary custom development.
* Sales spends less time searching for materials and researching accounts and more time engaging customers.
* The Associate knows when to activate existing materials and when an opportunity should be escalated for deeper strategic support.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1\-3 years of experience in sales development, sales support, marketing, research, enablement, account planning, or a coordinator/associate role.
* Strong research instincts and genuine curiosity about companies, industries, buyers, and business challenges.
* Strong PowerPoint or Google Slides skills and good visual judgment.
* Ability to turn research into concise, usable seller talking points and outreach inputs.
* Excellent organization and ability to manage multiple fast\-turn requests.
* A proactive, service\-oriented mindset paired with the confidence to ask questions and recommend a better path when needed.
* Familiarity with CRM, prospecting, sales intelligence, and research tools is a plus.
* Interest in developing toward solutions marketing, insights, strategy, or sales enablement.

*Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H\-1B visa, OPT\-STEM employment, etc.*

---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences

**We Are:**


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's comprehensive technology learning and training service, built on a $1 billion investment to help the world's leading organizations reskill and upskill their workforces for the AI economy. Launched in March 2024, LearnVantage brings together three industry\-leading training organizations — Udacity (AI, data science, and digital skills), Award Solutions (advanced wireless, 5G, and network technologies), and Ascendient Learning (instructor\-led IT training and vendor\-authorized certifications) — into a single, AI\-powered platform that delivers personalized, outcomes\-driven workforce transformation at enterprise scale.


We sit at the intersection of Accenture's deepest client relationships and the most urgent workforce challenge in the market: helping global enterprises close the AI skills gap at speed and at scale. With Accenture's trust, reach, and account access as our foundation, LearnVantage is positioned to become the defining workforce reinvention partner for the world's most important organizations.

**You Are:**


A strategic, relationship\-driven enterprise seller who knows how to navigate large, complex organizations — both externally with clients and internally within Accenture. You are equally comfortable sitting in an account planning session with a Managing Director as you are presenting a workforce reinvention business case to a client's CHRO. You understand how Accenture operates, how Diamond Account teams think, and how to position LearnVantage as a natural, high\-value extension of the work Accenture is already doing.


You are not a lone wolf. You are a collaborator, an orchestrator, and a trusted partner to the Accenture account teams you work alongside. * Manage LearnVantage pipeline across all assigned Accenture accounts with disciplined CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and regular visibility for both LearnVantage and Accenture leadership
* Convert Accenture\-introduced opportunities into closed, contracted LearnVantage engagements and expand those engagements over time into multi\-year, multi\-solution workforce partnerships
* Serve as the voice of the client and the CAL back to LearnVantage's product, curriculum, and go\-to\-market teams — surfacing emerging skill gaps, deal structure needs, and market opportunities that improve LearnVantage's relevance within the Accenture ecosystem


Travel to client sites and Accenture offices as required to support strategic account pursuits; travel estimated at 30–50% depending on assigned accounts

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, account management, sales leadership, or new logo acquisition in a consulting, technology, or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated track record of originating and closing significant net new business in mid\-market or multi\-subsidiary environments, preferably $500K\+ ARR deals or more
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Salary range:** $85,000 \- $90,000 **Position Summary:**  

The purpose of this position is to service territory customers through a concentrated focus and compliance with NYK marketing strategies. To strive to achieve/surpass pre\-determined targets and to maintain relationships with customers towards creating long\-lasting relationships.
Responsibilities:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Travel and develop personal and professional relationships particularly with High/Heavy and Automotive.
* Preplan sales itineraries and calendar significant events in the territory.
* Work in coordination with Trade and Customer Service to ensure that the account base is serviced in a manner which will result in customer satisfaction.
* Develop sales strategy for region to achieve budgeted revenues.
* Conduct satisfaction surveys in coordination with customer service team on a regular basis to identify strengths and weaknesses for further improvement of service to customers.
* Prepare sales reports and sign off on their accuracy before submitting them.
* Develop and communicate information regarding the competitive landscape including any changes in competitor services or related issues.
* Establish a referral network with local businesses and find ways to maximize value from those connections.
* Engage with the accounts receivable team to ensure collections in an agreed timeline.
* Apply company values (Integrity, Innovation and Intensity) in all relationships.
* Compliance with performance criteria as set forth by the trade team.
* Completion of annual goals, targets and projects outlined in annual review.
* Maintain and enhance quality relations with customers within outlined areas of responsibility.
* Portray a positive team approach internally.
* Take responsibility for relations with colleagues and customers.
* Respect the differences of others and treat others with respect.
* Remain open and encourage new ideas while ensuring we respect the principles of our corporate identity.
* Seek internal NYK group synergies and propose recommendations with mutual benefits for both the group and the customer.
* Improve upon skills requiring attention outlined in the employee performance appraisal and self\-evaluation.
* Continually seek out ways to better the service product offered to customers.
* Continue professional development in the area of business management.
* Ability to work in a multi\-tasked environment.


Qualifications:
**1\. SPECIAL SKILLS*** Social skills necessary to interact effectively with outside customers as well as NYK internal necessary
* Diligent approach to obtaining more profitable business
* Knowledge of pricing and service contracting
* Ability to effectively complete tasks within budget constraints
* Excellent analytical/problem solving skills
* Excellent planning and organizational skills
* Key customer relationships required
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

**2\. PREFERRED EDUCATION*** Bachelor's degree required

**3\. WORK EXPERIENCE*** Minimum of 5 years of related experience

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.* **Benefits****NYK offers a generous Employee Benefits Package including:*** Medical, Dental, and Vision
* 401k with a company match and Pension Plan
* Flexible Spending Accounts, Life Insurance, Tuition Assistance Program, Vacation, and much more.

*Any and all benefits offered are subject to the eligibility requirements, terms, and provisions set forth in the respective policies and plan documents, which you may request from Human Resources.* **About NYK Group Americas Inc.**
