jobs.title: Digital Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
**About Radial**

Radial is building the future of **brain medicine** — fast, effective, evidence\-based treatment for depression, PTSD, anxiety, and more. We deliver TMS, Spravato, and ketamine therapy across nearly 30 clinics coast to coast, and we're growing quickly.

Our mission is simple: help people get better, faster. Most of our patients come to us after years of things not working. That raises the bar on everything we do, including how we show up online and in the communities our clinics sit in.

**The Role**

We're hiring a Digital Marketing Associate to support our team and keep the marketing engine running.

On any given week that means writing and shipping social content, getting swag and print materials to a clinic before an event, updating a location page, coordinating a photo shoot, chasing a vendor invoice, and fixing the three small things nobody else noticed. It's a lot of surface area across a lot of clinics, and the person who's good at this is the person the whole team ends up relying on.

This is an execution role, and we mean that as a compliment. You won't get a rigid checklist, so being organized, reliable, and genuinely proactive matters far more here than deep experience with any one tool. It's a strong fit for someone who wants to learn fast, do real work that's visible across the company, and grow with a network that's scaling.

**What You’ll Own**

**1\. Listings, reputation, \& website support**

* Keep location pages \& Google Business profiles current.
* Create and maintain clinician profiles on our website \+ directories like Psychology Today, Zocdoc, etc.
* Help keep patient reviews responded to within our guidelines, escalating anything clinical or sensitive right away.
* Support blog, SEO, and landing page updates.

**2\. Content \& social media**

* Run Radial's corporate social accounts day to day–build and maintain the content calendar, write and schedule posts, and engage with the audience across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
* Make simple, on\-brand content yourself—short\-form video, graphics, carousels—pulling raw material from clinics, clinicians, and company news.
* Report on what's performing and adjust.

**3\. Field marketing, events, and materials**

* Source, order, and ship branded swag and print materials to clinics, managing vendors, invoicing, and budget along the way.
* Support logistics for local community and referral events: registration pages, materials, shipping, vendor coordination.
* Coordinate photo and video shoots at clinics—scheduling, shot lists, vendors—and maintain the marketing asset library (headshots, clinic photos, brand assets, collateral).

**4\. Marketing ops**

* Manage marketing invoicing and vendor payments.
* Help keep projects moving across internal teams, agencies, field marketers, and outside partners.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **2\+ years** of marketing, communications, operations, or agency experience.
* **Hands\-on social experience.** You can plan a calendar, write in a brand voice, and make simple content yourself (CapCut, Canva, or similar).
* **Exceptionally organized.** You track a lot of small things across a lot of locations without dropping any of them.
* **You write clearly and like a human**, especially about sensitive subjects.
* **Good taste and judgment.** You can tell the difference between what reads as credible and what reads as filler.
* **Proactive.** You take something ambiguous, figure out what needs to happen, and get it across the line without being asked twice.
* **You understand that healthcare marketing carries real responsibility**—trust, care, and never sharing patient information.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with a multi\-location brand or clinic business.
* Basic video editing or design chops.
* Familiarity with Yext, Google Business Profile, or provider directories.
* Healthcare, wellness, or community marketing background.

**Compensation and benefits**

The salary range for this role is **$70,000 – $80,000**, depending on experience. We also offer medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k), and paid time off.

**Equal opportunity**

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected status. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
About the role
You'll own a set of named accounts and prospect into them full time. That starts with research: what security tools an account runs, what's changed recently, where they're likely feeling pain. From there you write outreach specific enough that the person on the other end can tell you did the work.


You'll get real support doing this. AI\-augmented research tools to speed up account prep, a coaching system that reviews your emails before they go out, Nooks for power dialing, and a messaging framework based on how enterprise security teams actually talk, not a generic sequence library. That said, none of it replaces the work. We're looking for someone hungry, who shows up wanting to outwork the rep at the next desk and treats a "no" as a reason to try a different angle, not a reason to slow down.


What you'll do* Learn the space. You'll pick up real fluency in SIEM modernization, detection engineering, and the data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) that security teams run on. You don't need a technical background coming in, but you'll need to keep up in a conversation with someone who has one.
* Run outbound into named accounts. No spray and pray. You'll work a defined territory, research each account's environment and recent trigger events, and tailor your outreach accordingly.
* Write emails people actually read. Every draft gets reviewed before it ships. You'll learn to lead with outcomes and write to a person instead of a title.
* Build pipeline. Mix of outbound prospecting and inbound follow\-up. You'll use intent data, CRM signals, and your own research to figure out which accounts to prioritize, and you'll know exactly where your numbers stand at any point in the quarter.
* Get coached, and use it. Feedback here comes with the reasoning behind it, not just a correction. Reps who take this seriously tend to leave with sharper writing, positioning, and selling skills than most SDR seats teach.


Who does well here* Grit. You'll hear a lot of "not right now." The reps who do well treat that as information and keep working the account instead of taking it personally.
* Self\-starter. You'll own your territory and your account plans. If you need someone checking in on you daily, this isn't the right seat.
* Coachable. Grit without coachability is just stubbornness. The best people on this team ask why, then apply the feedback the same day.
* Curious about the tech. You don't need a security background. But if a prospect mentions a SIEM or detection engineering and you actually want to know what that means, you'll fit in well here.
* Some sales experience. 1 to 2 years as an SDR, BDR, or similar customer\-facing role, ideally at a growth\-stage company or in cybersecurity or enterprise tech. You've made calls, run sequences, and know what a real pipeline number looks like.


Why Anvilogic
Anvilogic is the Agentic SecOps platform. It helps security teams onboard their data, search across it, deploy detections, and run investigations on the infrastructure they already have, without ripping anything out. We're backed by Point72 Ventures and Foundation Capital, and closed a $45M Series C.


We built our own SDR program instead of buying an off\-the\-shelf playbook: real voice standards, AI\-augmented research, and coaching built into the day\-to\-day workflow. You come out having learned a methodology, not a script you'll forget in a year.


Most security teams you'll talk to are dealing with rising SIEM costs and detection coverage that hasn't kept up with their data. That's a real problem, and you'll be walking in with something that actually addresses it.


Anvilogic was founded in 2019 by security veterans and data scientists from Fortune 500 companies, and that practitioner mindset shows up on the SDR floor too. The manager running this team was an SDR here before being promoted into the role, so there's real growth opportunity for people who put in the work. Day to day, it's also a good group to work with: people who take the job seriously but don't take themselves too seriously.

***Anvilogic is a Palo Alto\-based cybersecurity company founded in 2019 by security veterans and data scientists from Fortune 500 companies. Our mission: help every SOC team detect threats at the level of the best, regardless of which data platform they run.***

 **Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree
* 1 to 2 years of experience in an SDR, BDR, or similar customer\-facing sales role
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and sales engagement platforms
* Strong written communication
* US\-based
* Curiosity about cybersecurity and enterprise technology

  

**Benefits**  

* Equity in a high\-growth, Series C cybersecurity company
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Monthly stipend for home internet and cell phone
* Growth opportunities for top performers, including paths into an AE role

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR \& IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

  

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third\-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

This is a high\-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  

It is a focused top\-of\-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full\-cycle sales role.

  

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long\-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in\-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection\-handling, and territory\-management skills before furthering their sales career.

 ***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in New York City, NY)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high\-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high\-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow\-ups, account research, and multi\-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high\-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow\-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability \- you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative \- you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high\-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team\-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer\-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

 **What success looks like**
In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.  

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.  

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.  

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling \- whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go\-to\-market role. **Why join Rippling*** You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies \- not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more

You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data

* Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, freight, or a related operations role preferred.

* The Project Coordinator will support the Enterprise Commercial Head – Pre\-Launch Programs by coordinating activities and facilitating communication across multiple strategic pre\-launch initiatives. This is an entry\-level, coordination\-focused role centered on organization, follow\-up, communication, alignment, and visibility across diverse stakeholders, functions, geographies, and time zones.
* The Project Coordinator will serve as a key coordination and communication point, ensuring that information is gathered, organized, communicated, and followed through efficiently and accurately.
* The role will support the Project Manager and business/functional stakeholders by keeping activities, dependencies, milestones, risks, issues, and action items visible and properly tracked.
* This is a Level 1 / entry\-level role. Ownership and execution of project content remain with the respective business and functional stakeholders.
* The Project Coordinator is not expected to independently lead complex projects but rather to provide strong coordination, communication, organization, and follow\-through support.

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Coordinate activities, dependencies, and follow\-ups across multiple strategic pre\-launch programs and cross\-functional stakeholder groups.
* Serve as a central coordination point to help move information efficiently between stakeholders, teams, and functions.
* Facilitate clear and timely communication between teams and maintain alignment across stakeholders, levels, functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Collect, organize, and communicate project information in a clear, accurate, and timely manner.
* Monitor project progress, milestones, deliverables, action items, risks, and issues, ensuring appropriate follow\-up.
* Maintain trackers, status updates, meeting notes, action items, and other coordination\-related documentation.
* Support structured reporting, governance activities, and timely escalation of outstanding items when required.
* Follow up with stakeholders and vendors to ensure commitments, requests, and action items are progressing as expected.
* Help identify dependencies, gaps, or outstanding information and communicate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support meetings through agenda coordination, note\-taking, action\-item tracking, and follow\-up.
* Support the use of digital tools, automation, AI\-enabled ways of working, and Microsoft Loop to improve efficiency, visibility, communication, and follow\-through.
* Adapt communication and coordination approaches when working across different functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Provide general coordination support to the Project Manager and Enterprise Commercial Head as needed.

**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or recently completed bachelor's degree, preferably in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Business, Healthcare, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of professional experience, including candidates who are recent college/university graduates.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to communicate information clearly and efficiently between multiple stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to keep track of multiple activities and deadlines.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Comfortable working with Microsoft Office and common collaboration/digital tools.
* Ability to learn and understand pharmaceutical/life sciences terminology and business concepts.
* Ability to work effectively across different teams, geographies, and time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Previous internship, academic, or professional experience within the pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or related industry.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical commercial or pre\-launch environments.
* Experience supporting projects, programs, teams, or cross\-functional initiatives.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Loop or similar collaboration and project\-tracking tools.
* Interest in using automation and AI\-enabled tools to improve coordination and productivity.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**


* The ideal candidate is a highly organized, communicative, and proactive recent graduate or early\-career professional who enjoys coordinating people and information.
* They should be comfortable following up with different stakeholders, keeping information organized, identifying what is still outstanding, and making sure the right information reaches the right person at the right time.
* A pharmaceutical or life sciences background is highly desirable because the role will involve working with a client in the pharmaceutical industry and understanding industry\-specific terminology and context.
* However, the role is intentionally designed for a junior candidate, and extensive pharmaceutical or project management experience is not required.
* The successful candidate should be viewed as a strong Project Coordinator / Project Management support resource, rather than an experienced Project Manager.

jobs.description:
Novelis is one of the world leaders in aluminum recycling and rolling and a leading sustainable aluminum solutions provider. Driven by our purpose of shaping a sustainable world together, we work alongside our customers to provide innovative solutions to the aerospace, automotive, beverage packaging and specialty markets. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Novelis has approximately 13,000 employees in 32 operating facilities on 4 continents. **Position Overview**


The Novelis North America Procurement team is seeking a Procurement Project Coordinator (Contract) for a Supplier Request for Information and Quotation project, named "R2R." This role will report to the MRO Category Manager and support request\-for\-quote and request\-for\-information activities for Maintenance, Repair and Operations materials across approximately 400 suppliers and about $80M USD in annual spend. The person in this role will help build and maintain an accurate, fully functional North America Spend Cube that enables spend optimization and supports business objectives, cost savings, and operational efficiency objectives.
**\*This is a contract position with an anticipated assignment timeframe of October 5, 2026 through January 11, 2027\.\*****Responsibilities**

* Supplier Data Preparation: Extract supplier spend history data and populate standard request\-for\-quote templates for supplier outreach.
* Supplier Contact Management: Identify and confirm supplier contacts when not already available, then coordinate outreach through Smartsheet and related project tools.
* Request Management: Transmit supplier requests, manage supplier questions, receive responses, and help process responses through the Portal RFQ Analyzer or Excel analysis tools.
* Analysis and Follow\-up: Review results with the Category Manager and execute follow\-up actions with suppliers as directed.
* Coupa eSourcing Support: Populate standard request\-for\-quote templates in Coupa eSourcing, transmit requests, track responses, and complete analysis in Excel.
* Supplier Award Support: Export Supplier Award Summary and Pipeline Savings Entry reports once request\-for\-quote data is finalized.
* Supplier Documentation: Prepare supplier letter agreement templates, merge supplier letter agreements with supplier award summaries into a single PDF, and transmit documents to suppliers for signature.
* Document and Savings Tracking: Monitor signed supplier returns, upload returned PDFs into Icertis, and complete procurement pipeline savings entries in Smartsheet based on pipeline savings reports.
* Pricing Upload Support: Upload pricing, or provide data for price fixing, in ERP systems including SAP, Oracle, Coupa, and MFG Pro.
* Project Participation: Participate in project\-related meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

**Data Tools Utilized**

* R2R Portal, virtual data repository
* Smartsheet, supplier database and supplier contact database
* Excel, Outlook, Word, Adobe, Copilot, and Power BI
* Icertis, repository for uploaded documents
* SAP, Oracle, Coupa, and MFG Pro for pricing support

**Key Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking: Collect, validate, organize, and analyze large data sets with a focus on accuracy and quality.
* Communication: Interact professionally with internal stakeholders and external suppliers by email, virtual meetings, and telephone.
* Organization: Manage multiple tasks, priorities, deadlines, timelines, and deliverables while tracking progress and following up on action items.
* Attention to Detail: Maintain a high degree of accuracy when working with supplier data, pricing files, templates, and project documentation.
* Problem Solving: Demonstrate curiosity, identify improvement opportunities, and challenge existing processes when appropriate.
* Collaboration: Work independently while staying aligned with the Category Manager, project stakeholders, suppliers, and the broader Procurement team.
* Customer Service Mindset: Support suppliers and internal partners with professionalism, responsiveness, and follow\-through.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Demonstrated knowledge of procurement, sourcing, supply chain, finance, or general business principles.
* Understanding of how organizations purchase goods and manage supplier relationships.
* Experience supporting or participating in sourcing or related business projects.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collect, validate, organize, and analyze large data sets.
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.
* Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, data cleansing, sorting and filtering, charts, and formulas.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.
* Experience supporting projects with stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
* Demonstrated ability to track progress and follow up on action items.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, Operations Management, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Experience using Smartsheet for project tracking, workflow management, and reporting.
* Experience using Power BI, Alteryx, or similar analytics tools.
* Demonstrated curiosity, problem\-solving ability, and willingness to identify improvement opportunities.

jobs.title: Special Events & Marketing Coordinator- CVB
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY



This position is responsible for supporting the marketing, tourism promotion, and community engagement efforts of Visit Peachtree City through strategic social media management, website maintenance and enhancement, event coordination, and marketing support services. The Special Events \& Marketing Coordinator serves as a key contributor to the organization’s public presence by creating engaging digital content, assisting with promotional campaigns, supporting tourism and sales initiatives, and coordinating logistics for community and tourism\-related events hosted by Visit Peachtree City.



ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* Manages and maintains Visit Peachtree City’s social media platforms through content creation, scheduling, engagement monitoring, photography/video coordination, and audience interaction.


* Assists in developing and implementing strategic marketing campaigns to promote tourism, events, local businesses, and community initiatives.


* Updates, enhances, and maintains the Visit Peachtree City website, ensuring content remains current, visually engaging, accurate, and user\-friendly.


* Creates digital and print marketing materials including social media graphics, flyers, newsletters, presentations, advertisements, and promotional content.


* Coordinates logistics and operational support for Visit Peachtree City hosted events, festivals, tourism activations, ribbon cuttings, and community engagement initiatives.


* Assists with vendor coordination, sponsorship fulfillment, event setup and breakdown, volunteer coordination, and on\-site event management.


* Supports the Marketing \& Sales Manager with tourism sales initiatives, promotional partnerships, visitor engagement strategies, and special projects.


* Captures and organizes photography and video content for use across marketing platforms, social media, and promotional campaigns.


* Monitors tourism, hospitality, and social media trends to identify opportunities to increase engagement and destination visibility.


* Assists in maintaining marketing calendars, event schedules, campaign timelines, and organizational promotional materials.


* Works collaboratively with local businesses, hotels, restaurants, attractions, and community partners to promote tourism\-related opportunities and events.


* Responds to visitor inquiries through social media, website channels, email communication, and in\-person interactions at tourism and community events.


* Assists in tracking marketing analytics and social media performance metrics to evaluate campaign effectiveness and audience engagement.


* Represents Visit Peachtree City at community meetings, tourism events, trade shows, networking functions, and promotional activities as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION


* Knowledge of social media platforms, digital marketing trends, and content management strategies.


* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create engaging marketing content.


* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and event logistics simultaneously.


* Knowledge of website management platforms and basic website editing principles preferred.


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with graphic design and social media scheduling tools preferred.


* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with team members and community partners.

The Marketing Manager assigns work in terms of general instructions.

jobs.title: Service Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:  


Andy’s Pool Service is looking for a highly organized, customer\-focused Service Operations Coordinator to help keep our residential and commercial service operations running smoothly.  


This role serves as a key connection between our customers, service technicians, and internal teams. The Service Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating technician schedules, monitoring daily service workflows, assisting with customer needs, maintaining inventory, and ensuring important information and follow\-ups don’t fall through the cracks.  


The ideal candidate is a strong communicator and problem\-solver who enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment, can confidently manage changing priorities, and takes ownership of seeing tasks through to completion.  


What You’ll Do  


Service Operations \& Scheduling  


Coordinate daily and weekly schedules for residential service technicians.  
Monitor service workflows and adjust schedules based on changing operational needs.  
Track open service requests and follow up to help ensure timely completion.  
Communicate schedule changes, service needs, and important customer information to technicians.  
Work closely with other departments to support efficient operations and strong communication.  


Customer Service  


Provide professional and responsive support to customers regarding service\-related questions and concerns.  
Assist with resolving customer concerns and escalate complex issues when appropriate.  
Coordinate with technicians and internal teams to gather information and provide customers with timely updates.  
Build positive customer relationships through clear communication and consistent follow\-through.  
Help ensure outstanding customer issues are followed through to resolution.  


Inventory Management  


Monitor inventory levels and maintain accurate inventory records.  
Identify inventory needs, shortages, and discrepancies.  
Coordinate inventory needs with the appropriate team members.  
Support inventory control processes and overall organization.  


Operational Support  


Maintain accurate service records and operational documentation.  
Identify opportunities to improve scheduling, communication, and workflow efficiency.  
Assist with special projects and cross\-functional initiatives.  
Perform other duties as assigned.  


Requirements:  


What We’re Looking For  
2–3 years of experience in service coordination, dispatching, scheduling, customer service, account management, field service operations, or a related role preferred.  
Strong organizational and time\-management skills.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
Strong customer service and conflict\-resolution abilities.  
Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced environment.  
Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.  
Ability to problem\-solve and make sound decisions when priorities change.  
Comfortable communicating with both customers and field employees.  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office.  
Experience with HubSpot, Pool Brain, NetSuite, or similar business systems is a plus.  


Benefits:  


* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Note: If you are CURRENTLY employed at Children's and/or have an active badge or network access, STOP here. Submit your application via Workday using the Career App (Find Jobs).

Day**Work Day(s)**


Monday\-Friday**Shift Start Time**


8:00 AM**Shift End Time**


5:00 PM**Worker Sub\-Type**


Regular
Children’s is one of the nation’s leading children’s hospitals. No matter the role, every member of our team is an essential part of our mission to make kids better today and healthier tomorrow. We’re committed to putting you first, and that commitment is at the heart of our company culture: People first. Children always. Find your next career opportunity and make a difference doing what you love at Children’s.

**Job Description**


Develops, implements, and supports the research process by assisting investigators in study design, completion of the approval process, and management of data specific to the subspecialty of involvement. Proactively supports the efforts that ensure delivery of safe patient care and services and promotes a safe environment at Children's Healthcare of Atlanta.**Experience**

* One year of research experience. May substitute required experience with equivalent years of education beyond the minimum education requirement

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Health or Biological Sciences

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health related, or business administration related program or relevant experience in lieu of education

**Certification Summary**

* Basic Life Support (BLS) within 30 days of employment if role requires patient contact
* ARUP Handling, Packaging and Shipping Infectious Substances or similar within 30 days of employment if role requires specimen acquisition
* Collaborative Institutional Training Initiative (CITI) within 30 days of employment

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Working knowledge of state and federal regulatory guidelines related to research
* Good computer skills including working knowledge of a PC and Microsoft Office (Word, Access, and Excel)
* Self\-directed and motivated to work independently toward short\- and long\-term goals
* Good communication, organization, and interpersonal skills
* Good working relationships with colleagues, subordinates, and superiors

**Job Responsibilities**


**Develops, conducts, and facilitates research protocols.**

* Supports investigators in writing study protocols.
* Performs participant screening, enrollment, study activities, and communication.
* Coordinates study visits and procedures, including specimen acquisition, transport, documentation, and shipment.
* Maintains equipment and supply resources for research studies.
* Completes data management activities and ensures data integrity.
* Assists in the development and completion of source documents and case report forms.
* Participates in sponsor correspondence, monitoring, and study meetings.
* Monitors compliance throughout all study activities and engages compliance oversight as needed.
* Directs patient interaction to conduct research protocols.
* Obtains informed consent by following policy, procedure, and regulatory requirements.
* Schedules study\-specific visits in conjunction with ancillary departments.
* Administers various research surveys in accordance with research study requirements.
* Completes research\-only testing as required and applicable per study and system requirements, including electrocardiograms.
* Performs phlebotomy if trained to do so.
* Provides research study education to participants as part of a study protocol.
* Completes documentation as needed within the medical record.

**Manages all regulatory processes related to clinical research activities.**

* Completes Institutional Review Board preparation, submission, modifications, reporting, and termination activities.
* Maintains all licensure, certification, and system education requirements for role.
* Maintains all regulatory documents.
* Assist with facilitating grants, contracts, and financial tasks for research and clinical trials.
* Assist with supporting Principal Investigator in study budgeting, sponsor interactions, routing, feasibility assessments, account management, and reconciliation.
* Completes research administrative duties according to Children’s policies regarding Epic enrollment, Clinical Trial Management System data entry, patient care invoice accuracy.

**Participates in education activities to support specific research activities and primary role at Children’s Healthcare of Atlanta.**

* May participate in departmental policy and quality projects.
* Completes departmental, system\-wide, and study\-specific education as required.

1575 Northeast Expy NE**Job Family**


Research

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a positive, personable Account Manager who can offer high\-quality, dependable support to both our operations staff and sales team and help improve our efficiency. The Account Manager will need to be ready to assist in the continued growth and development of our boutique firm’s portfolio of clients. Through our ongoing growth initiatives and strategic affiliate relationships, our firm has grown consistently over the past 21\+ years. Unique concepts and original approaches to problems help us to differentiate ourselves from the competition.


Our operations staff and sales team need an infusion of talent to help drive our firm’s next phase of progress. We are seeking a highly motivated, self\-disciplined individual with integrity to join our team. If you are a strong communicator who demonstrates professionalism and you are interested in applying your skills to facilitate Agile’s robust growth, we encourage you to apply today.


Applicants must have the ability to come into our Norcross office a minimum of 5 days per week, but the hours are flexible, and we are willing to work with your schedule to develop a routine that works for you.


You’ll connect with new people, tackle tough problems, and raise the bar on an excellent customer experience. We welcome applicants who are interested in upward mobility, a positive work environment, and can’t wait to get started!

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Base pay of $22\.50 per hour
* Health insurance for full\-time
* Company 401(k) program, with employer matching for full\-time
* Company profit\-sharing program for full\-time
* Paid vacation and holidays

 **Compensation:**
$22\.50 per hour

 **Responsibilities:*** Utilize scripts to handle difficult customer situations and bring them higher up, if necessary
* Ensure customer account information is up\-to\-date
* Create records of customer interactions and follow up to ensure all questions have been answered
* Keep customer satisfaction levels high by providing accurate information, resolving issues, and mitigating complaints
* Assist operations staff by contacting clients via phone and email to request and receive the required paperwork and other documentation that supports our projects
* Facilitate meetings, Zoom calls, and conference calls with clients and provide follow\-up emails summarizing those interactions

 **Qualifications:*** Display strong communication skills, active listening skills, and personal skills
* Experience working in a customer\-oriented atmosphere


* Ability to convey professionalism via phone and email
* Superior organizational skills to monitor the status of several different projects
* Work well with others and be a team player
* Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Prior administrative experience in the accounting, tax, or consulting industries a plus
* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a corporate environment
* BA/BS preferred

 **About Company** **Agile’s Purpose:**


We assist clients by aligning their tax and accounting systems with current sales \& use tax laws. That enables them to either maximize the benefit of the exemptions for which they qualify or become and remain compliant with their ongoing sales \& use tax collection, reporting, and filing obligations.

**Agile’s Vision:**


To establish \& maintain a reputation with consumers for developing \& delivering the most innovative, personalized, and comprehensive sales and use tax solutions to clients.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Individual Benefits
jobs.description:
Description:  



**About Legacy Risk Solutions**


Legacy Risk Solutions is a leading independent insurance agency platform headquartered in Gainesville, Georgia. Through its growing network of agency partners across the Southeast, Legacy provides commercial insurance, employee benefits, personal insurance, and risk management solutions to businesses and individuals. Built on a people\-first culture rooted in integrity, growth, and partnership, Legacy combines local expertise with the strength and resources of a larger organization to deliver exceptional service and long\-term success for clients, employees, and agency partners.

**Position Summary**


Legacy Risk Solutions is seeking an experienced Individual Benefits Account Manager to join our growing team. This role is responsible for supporting and servicing clients with individual insurance and benefits needs, providing knowledgeable guidance throughout the application, enrollment, renewal, and ongoing policy service process.


The ideal candidate is a client\-focused insurance professional with strong knowledge of individual health and benefits products, carrier requirements, and enrollment processes. This individual serves as a trusted resource for clients, helping them understand their coverage options, navigate policy questions, and resolve service issues while maintaining strong relationships with carrier partners and internal teams.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage and service a book of individual benefits clients throughout the policy lifecycle, including new enrollments, renewals, policy changes, and ongoing service needs.
* Assist clients in understanding available individual insurance options and identifying solutions that align with their coverage needs and circumstances.
* Prepare and review individual benefit quotes, applications, renewal information, and supporting documentation.
* Market and analyze available individual benefit products, coverage options, and rates across appropriate carrier partners.
* Explain plan benefits, premiums, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, networks, exclusions, and other important coverage provisions to clients.
* Coordinate new business applications and enrollments, ensuring required information and documentation are complete and submitted to carriers accurately and on time.
* Assist existing clients with annual renewals and evaluate alternative coverage options when appropriate.
* Monitor pending applications and enrollment activity and proactively follow up with clients and carriers to ensure timely completion.
* Process policy changes and qualifying life event requests through carrier websites and applicable online administration portals.
* Respond to client questions and service requests involving coverage, enrollment status, billing, claims, ID cards, policy documents, and other benefit\-related needs.
* Research and resolve billing, claims, enrollment, and policy administration issues by coordinating with clients and carrier partners.
* Assist clients with obtaining replacement ID cards, policy documents, and other carrier materials as needed.
* Maintain a strong understanding of carrier products, eligibility requirements, underwriting guidelines, enrollment periods, and applicable individual benefits regulations.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with carrier representatives and other business partners.
* Provide timely and responsive service to client calls and emails, with a goal of responding to inquiries within one business day.
* Maintain complete and accurate client records, communications, applications, policy documents, and other activity within the agency management system.
* Attend relevant carrier meetings, continuing education seminars, webinars, and training to maintain current knowledge of individual insurance products and industry developments.
* Participate in scheduled team meetings and collaborate with other team members to support department goals.
* Provide account management backup and support to the team when needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve client service, workflows, and internal processes.
* Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Requirements:  



**What We’re Looking For**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Active Accident, Sickness \& Life Insurance License required.
* Minimum of 3–4 years of insurance experience, preferably supporting individual health, life, or related benefits products.
* Strong knowledge of individual insurance products, carrier requirements, enrollment processes, and policy servicing.
* Experience working directly with individual clients and carrier partners preferred.
* Experience with carrier websites, quoting platforms, enrollment systems, and agency management systems preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain insurance terminology and coverage information in a clear, client\-friendly manner.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, applications, renewals, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to research and resolve client service, billing, claims, and enrollment issues.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and carrier partners.
* Client\-focused, solutions\-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering an exceptional service experience.
* Initiative and willingness to take ownership of responsibilities and support the broader team as needed.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Life insurance coverage
* Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage
* Accident and critical illness i

jobs.title: Licensed Insurance Sales Agent/Account Manager
jobs.description:
Jonathan Phillips \- State Farm Agency, located in Smyrna, GA has an immediate opening for a full\-time Licensed Insurance Sales Professional and we're looking for a motivated, personable professional to join our growing insurance agency. We are an award winning State Farm agency focused on fulfilling the needs of our customers and creating success for our team.


This role is primarily focused on generating new business, relationship building, and providing support for existing customers. If you have experience in the insurance industry, sales, or customer service I invite you to apply for the position in my office. **Only candidates who meet the following criteria will be considered for this role:**

  

1\. Must have an active Property and Casualty insurance license or willing to obtain.
2\. Must have an active Life, Accident and Sickeness insurance license or willing to obtain,
3\. Must be able to make the commute to our agency location in Smyrna, GA. This is an in\-office position with potential for remote opportunities.  



  

**Responsibilities include but not limited to:**


* Develop leads, schedule appointments, identify customer needs, and market appropriate products and services.
* Establish new customer relationships and maintain relationships with existing customers, as needed.
* Provide prompt, accurate, and friendly customer service. Service can include responding to inquiries regarding insurance availability, eligibility, coverages, policy changes, transfers, claim submissions, and billing clarification.

  



**What we provide:**


* Base Salary plus Commissions and Bonuses
* Paid Time Off (vacation and personal/sick days)
* Valuable experience
* Growth potential/Opportunity for advancement within my office

  



**Requirements:**


* Insurance Sales Experience in Property \& Casualty and L/H preferred
* Sales experience (outside sales or inside sales representative, retail sales associate, or telemarketing) preferred
* Successful track record of meeting sales goals/quotas preferred
* Excellent communication skills \- written, verbal and listening
* Self\-motivated
* Ability to multi\-task

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

jobs.title: Franchise Account Manager Trainer
jobs.description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**


The Franchise Account Manager (FAM) Trainer is an internal role responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving the training ecosystem that cultivates high\-performing Franchise Account Managers. This individual serves as both an expert practitioner and an educator, translating real\-world franchise relationship management into structured learning experiences that accelerate FAM productivity, deepen franchise partner satisfaction, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.

**PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**


The Franchise Account Manager (FAM) Trainer develops and delivers training that helps FAMs become confident, commercially minded franchise relationship managers. This role combines **franchise expertise, sales enablement, performance coaching, and instructional design** to accelerate FAM ramp time, strengthen franchisee relationships, and drive account growth.


The ideal candidate brings **hands\-on franchise or multi\-location experience** along with a strong background in **training, coaching, sales, or account management**.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

### **1\.** **Training Program \& Curriculum Development**

* Design and maintain a structured FAM development program covering onboarding, core skills, advanced capabilities, and ongoing development.
* Create practical training materials including playbooks, talk tracks, workshops, role\-plays, e\-learning, and assessments.
* Develop training around **consultative account management, franchisee relationship management, commercial growth, upselling/cross\-selling, conflict resolution, and performance management.**
* Continuously refresh content based on business needs, performance trends, product changes, and franchisee expectations.

### **2\. Training Delivery \& FAM Onboarding**

* Lead virtual and in\-person training for new FAMs and existing team members.
* Own the FAM onboarding and ramp journey through full productivity, including structured milestones and performance checkpoints.
* Facilitate recurring FAM development sessions and peer\-learning forums.
* Partner with HR, Operations, and FAM leadership to ensure new hires receive the right functional, technical, and cultural training.

### **3\. Performance Coaching \& Call Observation**

* Coach FAMs based on call observations, CRM data, performance metrics, and manager feedback.
* Observe live franchisee calls and provide actionable feedback on discovery, communication, consultative problem\-solving, objection handling, relationship management, and commercial acumen.
* Create individualized development plans for FAMs based on skill gaps and performance needs.
* Support both high\-potential and struggling FAMs through targeted coaching and skill development.

### **4\. Franchisee Relationship \& Conflict Coaching**

* Equip FAMs to confidently manage challenging franchisee conversations and resolve issues before they escalate.
* Coach FAMs on **de\-escalation, expectation setting, objection handling, solution alignment, and professional communication.**
* Help FAMs prepare for difficult conversations by reviewing account history, desired outcomes, and messaging.
* When needed, participate in complex franchisee escalations and model effective relationship\-management and resolution strategies.
* Turn recurring challenges and real\-world scenarios into training content and playbooks.

### **5\. Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track training effectiveness through ramp time, knowledge assessments, skill progression, performance improvement, and business outcomes.
* Gather learner and manager feedback and continuously improve the FAM development program.
* Identify recurring performance gaps and translate insights into targeted training and coaching initiatives.

### **6\. Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with FAM leadership, HR, Marketing, Product, Operations, and other teams to ensure training remains commercially relevant and aligned with business priorities.
* Support Sales Kick\-Off, Franchise Summit, and other company\-wide learning initiatives.
* Contribute to career development, competency frameworks, and succession planning for the FAM organization.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**


5\+ years of experience as a Franchise Account Manager, Key Account Manager, or equivalent field sales role within a franchise or multi\-site environment.


2\+ years in a formal training, coaching, or sales enablement capacity (internal or external).


Demonstrated ability to design and deliver structured learning programs; not just on\-the\-job shadowing.


Strong commercial acumen with a proven track record of managing complex franchise or wholesale partner relationships.

**Desirable**


Formal L\&D or coaching qualification (e.g. CIPD L\&D, ICF Coaching, ATD CPTD, or equivalent).


Experience using LMS platforms (e.g. Cornerstone, Docebo, Lessonly/Seismic Learning) and sales enablement tools (e.g. Gong, Chorus, Salesforce).


Background in instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, or similar frameworks).


Familiarity with franchise disclosure documents (FDD), franchise agreements, and the regulatory landscape.

**Why Ignite Visibility?**
--------------------------

* A collaborative environment focused on client success and career development
* Fully remote workforce with optional San Diego office
* Two\-time Landy Award Winner (Search Marketer of the Year \& Best Paid Search Initiative)
* Named Fastest\-Growing Private Companies in San Diego (20162020\)
* Named Best Places to Work in San Diego (2017, 2020\)
* Named Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies (20172020\)

  

Ignite Visibility is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**



The Account Manager is the primary point of contact for all matters related to assigned accounts. This role involves developing strong relationships with customers, engaging with key business executives and stakeholders, and identifying new business opportunities within existing accounts.


**Summary of Essential Job Functions/Responsibilities**


* **Order Processing:** Ensure timely and accurate processing of orders according to customer requirements
* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with clients.
* **Trusted Advisor:** Develop a trusted advisor relationship with key accounts, customer stakeholders, and executive sponsors
* **Contract Negotiation:** Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profitability
* **Business Development:** Identify and develop new business opportunities with existing customers and areas for improvement to meet sales quotas
* **Sales Collaboration:** Work with the sales team to identify and grow opportunities within the territory
* **Market Knowledge:** Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of plant workload, stock levels, market trends, contract processes, and delivery schedules to provide accurate information to customers
* **Product Knowledge:** Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the end\-user applications of assigned metal products to optimize sales potential
* **Inventory Coordination:** Coordinate with management to ensure optimal lead times and inventory levels, and identify aged/obsolete inventory with suggested dispositions
* **Reporting:** Prepare monthly reports on account status and communicate the progress of initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
* **Policy Adherence:** Ensure compliance with corporate mill claim policies and advise management of challenging customer requests, escalating issues as needed
* **Vendor Coordination:** Schedule appointments with vendors and operational staff to minimize production time for material inspections and ensure successful resolution of claims
* **Quality Control:** Provide data and insights to improve quality control
* **Additional Duties:** Perform other related duties as assigned


**Qualifications**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales, or a related field, or an Associate’s degree with equivalent relevant work experience
* **Experience:** Previous experience in sales, management, account management, or a relevant field
* **Skills:**
	+ **Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical skills to interpret sales performance and market trends
	+ **Results\-Driven:** High performance standards with the ability to motivate and lead the sales team
	+ **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities
	+ **Customer Service:** Customer service\-oriented with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively
	+ **Computer Skills:** Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite
	+ **Multi\-Tasking:** Ability to handle multiple customer accounts and tasks simultaneously
	+ **Reliability:** Demonstrated reliable work history

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world—making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
  

Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose — as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
  

If you are a highly motivated and tenacious individual looking to grow your career in a business\-to\-business (B2B) sales environment, we have a great opportunity for you!
  
  

Our Business Development Representative (BDR) team plays a key role within our broader Sales organization bringing new business opportunities to life! As a Business Development Representative, you will be driving new business growth by identifying and creating opportunities in untapped markets through proactive and strategic outbound prospecting and building a strong pipeline that leads to successful deals closed.
  
  

Join our team and thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment! You’ll connect with diverse B2B prospects, develop deep expertise in the risk and compliance industry, and sharpen your skills to persist, overcome challenges, and deliver results. Achieve your goals, accelerate your impact, and unlock exciting opportunities to further your career growth in Sales with our team!
  
  

You’ll thrive in this role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to your success. Join us and help shape what’s next!
  
  

**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match.
* High\-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.


**What you’ll do:**  

* Exceed your monthly quota by utilizing your ability to assess a prospect’s “fit”
* Acquire/generate qualified business leads by cold calling, engaging with and developing prospects to be closed by Sales team
* Document, track and monitor all leads and activities in Salesforce.com
* Utilize smart, targeted questions to speak knowledgeably with decision makers such as VPs, Directors and C\-suite personnel
* Acquire in depth knowledge of our full range of risk and compliance solutions and services, conveying that knowledge to potential customers, and adhering to company messaging and positioning
* Nurture relationships with longer term prospects
* Conduct territory development best practices with email, phone and chat using sales enablement tools to connect with new prospects and current customers


**What you’ll bring:**  

* Previous sales, telemarketing or lead generation experience; cloud computing and SaaS industry experience preferred
* Technical acumen to ramp up quickly on core technologies such as Salesforce, Groove, etc.
* A tenacious work ethic with a desire to have a career in sales
* Grit and know\-how with a curious and creative mindset to set goals to achieve bigger outcomes
* Highly motivated, self\-starter with a strong desire to meet and exceed quota monthly, maintaining a high call rate and ability to assess prospect’s “fit”
* A modest yet assertive and confident demeanor with empathy and compassion
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills, presentations skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives to engage and influence executive\-level decision makers
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast\-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow\-through
* AI Readiness. Curiosity and willingness to use AI and emerging technologies to elevate your work and deliver smarter outcomes
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values


**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is $24\.04 per hour and the target variable pay for this role is $20,000\. Target variable pay is based on individual achievement factors and is not guaranteed. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

Coordinate customer expectations for delivery and installation with operations and management teams. At Rain for Rent® , we move water—every day. As the leading provider of temporary liquid handling solutions, we’re recognized for our systems engineering expertise, cost\-effective problem solving, and the high value we deliver to organizations facing critical liquid management challenges. From water handling and irrigation to temporary liquid storage, our solutions consistently exceed customer expectations for quality and service. With more than 70 locations across the U.S., Canada, and the UK, Rain for Rent® remains committed to excellence. Honesty and integrity are at the core of everything we do. Through the years we have held steadfast by maintaining our values of hard work, honesty, integrity, commitment and good stewardship. Continual diversification and a willingness to change directions with our products and services have driven our success.


**Summary:**



As an Inside Sales Representative, you will be assisting branch sales force in achieving and exceeding revenue goals in assigned territory for all product lines by prequalifying leads, generating quotes and taking orders \- enabling the sales force to make greater number of face\-to\-face sales opportunities. Coordinate customer expectations for delivery and installation with operations and management teams. Represent the Company honestly and fairly with regard to maintaining good public relations with all customers, competitors and vendors.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Handles inbound sales leads to convert leads into sales, or refers them to field representatives or partners, as appropriate. Meets or exceeds assigned quarterly sales quotas. Makes outbound lead follow\-up calls to potential and existing customers or to partners by telephone and e\-mail to qualify leads and sell solutions. Meets outbound call metrics as set and measured on a monthly basis.
* Builds and maintains customer and/or partner relationships, emphasizes marketable features, quotes prices and credit terms, prepares sales orders, and estimates date of delivery based on delivery schedules, coordinates customer and/or partner training.
* Assists Outside Sales Representatives with optimizing opportunities through scheduling of appointments /meaningful selling interactions.
* Works in coordination with Outside Sales Representatives to update and maintain CRM records such as contact information, activities, accounts, leads and opportunities.
* Acts as the main point of contact with customer to take basic orders and assist with change orders.
* Supports respective sales team in areas such as quotation generation, customer follow\-up and support, accessing information about specific customers and other support functions. Serves as a liaison between customers and/or partners and appropriate company departments to resolve customer and/or partner issues, such as accounts receivables. Prepares reports of business transactions, enters new customer data and other sales data for current customers into computer database or CRM, overcomes technical and business objections of prospective customers, investigates and resolves customer or partner problems.
* Assists with setting up appointments for trade show events, association meetings, lunch and learns, product demonstrations and other business related meetings.


**What we offer:**


At Rain for Rent, we take pride in taking care of our team. We offer a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Our offerings include:


* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Matching 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Competitive base salary
* Nine paid holidays and a generous paid time off (PTO) program
* Tuition reimbursement to support continued education
* Company\-sponsored training and career development opportunities
* And many other valuable perks

This is our fourth consecutive year being recognized, and our second year achieving **Gold\-level** distinction. We are committed to hiring and supporting veterans. You should have a strong eye for content, an understanding of social media culture, excellent attention to detail, and a genuine interest in restaurants, hospitality, food, nightlife, and lifestyle brands.

Community Management

* Monitor comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and guest\-generated content across social channels.
* Engage with followers and guests in a timely, brand\-appropriate manner.
* Identify opportunities to repost or amplify user\-generated content.
* Escalate guest service issues or sensitive comments to the appropriate restaurant or marketing leadership.
* Help cultivate relationships with loyal guests, creators, influencers, and members of the local hospitality community.

Influencer \& Creator Marketing

* Research relevant local influencers, food creators, lifestyle personalities, and potential brand partners.
* Assist with influencer outreach, reservations, gifting, hosted dining experiences, and campaign coordination.
* Track influencer visits, posts, reach, engagement, and resulting content.
* Maintain organized influencer and creator databases.
* Identify high\-quality user\-generated content and potential creator partnerships.

Email \& CRM Marketing

* Assist with the development and execution of restaurant email marketing campaigns.
* Build and schedule newsletters, promotional emails, event announcements, and other guest communications.
* Coordinate creative assets, copy, links, reservation CTAs, and audience segmentation.
* Maintain email lists and help identify opportunities to grow each restaurant's guest database.
* Monitor email performance, including opens, clicks, conversions, and list growth.

Website \& Digital Presence

* Assist with maintaining restaurant websites and ensuring menus, hours, events, promotions, photography, and other information remain accurate and current.
