* Help maintain accurate information across Google Business Profiles, reservation platforms, review platforms, directories, and other restaurant discovery channels.

* Help execute partnerships, events, activations, and local marketing initiatives.

* Capture supplemental content independently between professional shoots.
* Perform basic photo and video editing for digital channels.

* Ensure creative assets are properly formatted for each digital channel.

* Identify high\-performing content and emerging trends.

jobs.title: Group Sales Coordinator - The Ritz-Carlton
jobs.description:
**Why us?**

Iconic architecture, a thriving culinary scene, beautifully landscaped public spaces and an array of museums are just part of what draws visitors to the Windy City. At The Ritz\-Carlton, Chicago, a luxury hotel set atop Water Tower Place in the historic Gold Coast, guests will have every chance to explore the city, from shopping along Michigan Avenue to viewing famous works at the Art Institute. Yet with our hotel’s spa, rooftop lounge, locally inspired restaurant, indoor lap pool and spacious accommodations overlooking the city, guests may not want to leave the premises.


The Ladies \& Gentlemen in Salesare dedicated to creating meaningful relationships and delivering exceptional experiences for our guests and clients. As aGroup Sales Coordinator, you will provide essential support to the Group Sales team by coordinating sales activities, maintaining accurate client and group information, preparing proposals and correspondence, and assisting with the details that move each group from initial inquiry through arrival. You will communicate professionally with clients and internal partners while anticipating needs and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and precision. Working closely with Sales, Catering, Conference Services, Front Office and other hotel departments, you will help create a seamless experience that exceeds expectations and builds lasting client relationships.


Recognized as “the gold standard” of hospitality, The Ritz\-Carlton selects only the most passionate and skilled hospitality professionals. As one of our Ladies and Gentlemen, you will reflect the values that make us the world’s finest luxury brand. Here, in a diverse environment where individual aspirations are fulfilled and quality of life is enhanced, you will be inspired to work alongside your fellow employees to bring special moments to life for our guests and each other. Through your organization, attention to detail, responsiveness and commitment to excellence, you will play an important role in supporting our sales team, strengthening client partnerships and creating Ritz\-Carlton guests for life.


**Job Overview**

Assist sales managers in obtaining customer satisfaction by performing clerical and administrative duties relating to guest and hotel communications and sales. Responds to telephone and in\-person inquiries regarding reservations, hotel information and guest concerns.


**Responsibilities**

* Answer sales office phones when sales staff not available. Respond to all sales inquiries accurately, timely and in a professional manner.
* Type correspondence, reports and necessary forms i.e. contracts, as well as prepare proposals or other letters as directed.
* Coordination of all group and wedding business as contracted by the sales manager/DOS. Contact and provide appropriate follow\-up on all signed/contracted business within five (5\) working days. Determine and coordinate all needs of the customer.
* Responsible for effectively communicating with the various departments to ensure that the meeting and related functions are executed to exceed the client’s expectations.
* Account Service and Management: Maintains well documented, accurate, organized and up\-to\-date file management in order to serve client and employer in the most expedient, organized and knowledgeable manner.
* Develops strong customer relationships through appropriate client communication and the use of professional, courteous and ethical interpersonal interaction.
* Work with sales personnel to achieve required sales team goals.
* Have current knowledge of hotel rates, strategies, discounts and promotions.
* Assist with completing any required sales reports.
* Develop and effective communication and information system with the hotel team to disseminate details of upcoming group, meeting events and special events in the primary marketing area.
* Assist hotel with implementing hotel specific selling strategies.
* Promptly, the same day or by 10am the next business day, follows\-up on all customers’ needs and inquires in an efficient and expedient manner.
* Represents themselves and the hotel with the highest level of integrity and professionalism, a service focused approach and a caring, sincere attitude at all times.
* Exhibits a positive and involved team attitude to all hotel departments and maintains open communication with all co\-workers for the best overall performance of the hotel.
* Display a neat, clean and business\-like appearance at all times.
* Creates monthly social hour calendar with the Director of Sales.
* Assists the Sales department with monthly luncheons, client events, etc.
* Conduct walk\-in tours
* Create gift bags for guest traces, VIP’s, Hug’s, etc. Keep supplies stocked and on hand.
* Work with EBC on all group turnover and proper execution of the groups.

**Qualifications**

**Education/Formal Training**

High school diploma or vocational secretarial.


**Experience**

Previous sales, hospitality, and secretarial experience preferred.


**Knowledge/Skills**

* Advanced knowledge/use of Microsoft Word applications: Word, Excel, Publisher and PowerPoint.
* Alphabetizing, grammar and punctuation skills.
* Standard business letter formats.
* Strong editing skills.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* Excellent communication skills necessary to communicate clearly with customers and other departments by phone or in person.
* Able to read contracts and letters.
* Able to use computers.
* Excellent attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills.
* Bending/kneeling \- repeated bending and kneeling required while filing
* Mobility \- must be able to reach all areas of hotel to assist clients. Occasional standing. Occasional carrying

jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**  

The **Administrative Coordinator** position reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.


The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for higher\-level administrative support to various directors within the organization and must use independent judgment and authority to execute projects and maintain workflow. The incumbent will work as part of team and demonstrate superior organization skills, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and attention to detail proficient Microsoft application skills (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and be highly flexible and adaptable.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Independently performs high level technical and administrative work supporting the division or unit.
* Serves as a project manager for a variety of special projects; conducts special studies and analyses and makes recommendations to resolve organizational, procedural and system problems.
* Creates and revises systems and procedures by analyzing operating practices, record\-keeping systems, forms control, supplies inventory, and office layout.
* Implements changes independently for areas of responsibility. For issues outside responsibility, makes recommendations and, following managerial review, implements changes.
* Uses organizational software applications to research and prepare documents and presentations. Collects, analyzes, and manage data.
* Manages calendar; sets meeting priorities; identifies objectives of meetings and identifies materials needed for meeting; exercises judgment to ensure appropriate parties attend meeting.
* Screens incoming email, mail and telephone calls to assign priority, route as needed, identify additional resources needed to address and/or respond to the communication.
* Independently plans and executes events, activities, and meetings.
* Assists with creation, preparation, and distribution of materials to be presented to all levels of organizational staff.
* Reads, researches, and routes correspondence while maintaining security and confidentiality of highly sensitive information.
* Authors responses on behalf of director or department
* Develops and maintains relationships with all internal and external customers including patients, providers, staff and vendors.
* Records meeting discussions by attending meetings and recording key discussions and conclusions.
* May perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Required****:**

* Associates Degree or equivalent relevant (administrative) experience
* 3\-5 years’ experience in a business office with a strong emphasis on database management and customer service.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, PowerPoint and Excel.
* Ability to organize and think independently.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

**Preferred****:**

* Bachelor of Arts degree or business equivalent.
* 5 years business experience.

  

**Additional Information**  

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

**Background Check**


Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

**Benefits**


We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being while providing protection for unexpected life events. Please visit our Benefits section to learn more.

**Sign\-on Bonus Eligibility (if sign\-on bonus offered for position):** Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position at NM may be eligible depending upon the job family.

jobs.title: Account Manager - North America
jobs.description:
We built and scaled a global customer base from our headquarters in Amsterdam. The United States became one of our most important markets, so we put people on the ground here. Our Chicago office in River North is open and running.

  

You'd be joining early, but not from zero. The person who built and ran our European mid\-market sales team has moved to Chicago. We have an experienced Account Management team in Amsterdam, and you’ll onboard with them to learn every hard\-won lesson from scaling that business: how customers actually get value from the platform, which conversations lead to expansion, how renewals are won long before they're due. Our first U.S. SDR is here, ramped and hitting their numbers. An Account Executive is closing new business alongside you. And one of our product marketers sits in this office, giving you a direct line into the product team when a customer needs something.

  

We've also been increasing investment in our marketing channels month over month, which means a growing customer base in North America for you to build on.

  

The timing couldn't be better. For years, FMCG companies have been stuck with limited choice among legacy market intelligence providers. Every quarter, more of them switch to Vesper. Once they do, the opportunity is to make Vesper indispensable to how they buy. That's your job. And you'll get to visit the canals in Amsterdam from time to time to meet the rest of your colleagues in person.

  

This is not your typical account management role. There's no queue of tickets and no script. You'll be the CEO of your portfolio: responsible for whether customers succeed with Vesper, whether they renew, and how much they grow.

#### **Why you should join us**

* **Own your portfolio outright.** You decide where your time goes, which accounts to invest in, and how to grow them. Real responsibility, no hand\-holding.
* **Retention and expansion, not just check\-ins.** You'll carry a number for both. The best account managers here find revenue that nobody asked them to find.
* **Sell to the toughest audience there is.** Procurement teams negotiate for a living. Renewing and expanding with them is one of the best commercial educations you can get.
* **The European playbook is in the building.** The leader who scaled our mid\-market business in Europe is now based in Chicago, and a Vesper product marketer sits here too, so customer patterns, product answers, and proven approaches are a desk away rather than an eight\-hour time difference.
* **Shape how we do this in North America.** You're senior enough that the way you run onboarding, business reviews, and renewals becomes the pattern the next hires follow. You'll help define the North American customer motion, not inherit it.
* **We invest in your growth.** We bring in outside trainers, run the internal Vesper Academy, and coach you on negotiation, commercial conversations, and account strategy.
* **Face\-to\-face, not just video.** You'll visit strategic accounts across North America and represent Vesper at trade shows and industry events.

#### **What you'll be doing**

* **Own the full post\-sale lifecycle.** Onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion. You manage all of it, proactively, for your book of North American accounts.
* **Grow your portfolio.** Understand your customers' workflows deeply enough to find expansion opportunities before they surface as requests, then build the business case and close them.
* **Protect and win renewals.** Know where every account stands well ahead of the date, negotiate value rather than discount, and forecast your book honestly.
* **Make customers demonstrably better at their jobs.** You don't need to be a commodity consultant, but you do need to know the platform inside out and how each customer can extract the most value from it based on what they're actually trying to achieve.
* **Keep Vesper essential.** Make sure customers know what the platform can do, stay current on new releases, and treat Vesper as a fixture in their workflow rather than a subscription they review once a year.
* **Feed the roadmap.** Ask the right questions, listen, and get real customer signal back to our product team. With a product marketer down the hall, that loop is short.
* **Set the standard.** As the first local Account Manager, you'll help build the playbook for North American account management and support newer team members as we grow the office.

#### **What you'll bring**

* 4\+ years owning customer relationships commercially, whether as an Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, or Account Executive in technology, or a background in procurement or trading that you've since turned commercial. Roughly four years plus, but experience matters more than the count.
* A track record of carrying and hitting a retention or expansion number
* A strong commercial mindset. What we mean by that: you understand how your customers' businesses work and how they make money, you've negotiated value before, and you actually enjoy the idea of selling something.
* Genuine curiosity about customer workflows, and the discipline to turn what you learn into adoption and revenue
* Comfort using data to decide where your attention goes
* A natural team player. You contribute to the team's target, not just your own, and support the people around you.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment where some processes exist and others you'll build; you learn quickly and adapt as our proposition evolves
* Excellent written and spoken English. Spanish or French is a plus
* Experience with a CRM is helpful (we use HubSpot)
* Willingness to travel across North America for customer visits and industry events
* Authorization to work in the United States without visa sponsorship
* Based in Chicago, or willing to relocate, and able to work on\-site

*The role can be a Senior Account Manager for candidates with the right experience.*

#### **What you get**

* Personal responsibility with a ton of autono

We are seeking a results\-driven **National Account Manager** to drive new business growth within the restaurant chain industry. The ideal candidate is a proactive sales hunter with a proven ability to open doors, engage key decision\-makers, negotiate effectively, and close complex deals. jobs.title: ILUS - Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:
**About Us**
Daifuku Intralogistics America Corporation is a leading provider of intelligent material handling systems. With hundreds of engineers in\-house, the company designs, manufactures, integrates, and installs a full spectrum of intralogistics solutions to meet client needs. These include leading\-edge conveyor and sortation systems, voice\- and light\-directed order fulfillment equipment, a suite of warehouse controls \& execution software, robotics, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), mezzanines, and structures, all backed by critical round\-the\-clock service and support.  

If you want to join a team of industry leading experts who want to create an impact on the future of material handling solutions, we want to hear from you! **Job Summary**
The A**ssociate Project Manager** is a structured development role designed to build a pipeline of future Project Managers capable of leading complex material handling automation projects. Under the guidance of experienced Project Managers, this role develops hands\-on capability across planning, execution, commissioning, customer acceptance and financial delivery for projects involving conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, ASRS, controls, software, and warehouse technologies.  

Through structured mentoring, field assignments, training and increasing project responsibility, the Associate Project Manager will build the technical, financial, operational and leadership skills with the goal of developing readiness to independently manage projects and customer relationships, typically within 12–24 months, based on demonstrated performance and business needs.  

To accelerate learning and broaden industry experience, the Associate Project Manager will complete travel\-intensive field assignments across customer sites and project locations. These assignments provide exposure to multiple project types, technologies, installation methods, startup activities, operational readiness initiatives and customer acceptance processes.  

This position serves as the entry point into the Project Management career track. Success will be measured by demonstrated readiness to assume Project Manager responsibilities, with opportunities for continued advancement based on performance, experience, and business needs..  


Responsibilities:
**Project Execution**  

* Support planning, execution, commissioning and closeout of automation projects involving conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, ASRS systems, racking, controls and software integrations.
* Assist with project schedules, budget tracking, cost control, forecasting, risk management, reporting, procurement and contract administration.
* Coordinate activities among engineering, software, operations, procurement, installation teams, suppliers and customers.
* Track and drive project milestones, action items, risks, issues and change requests.
* Support change management, project controls, and financial reporting activities.
* Promote compliance with company, customer and site\-specific safety requirements during all project activities.
 **Customer \& Vendor Coordination**  

* Prepare and deliver clear project status reports, presentations and updates for customers, vendors, internal stakeholders and customer leadership.
* Communicate project progress, risks, issues, decisions and recommended actions clearly in both written and verbal formats, supporting timely issue resolution and stakeholder alignment.
* Build effective working relationships with customers, suppliers, subcontractors and internal stakeholders.
* Support vendor management and supplier performance activities.
 **Commissioning \& Operational Readiness**  

* Assist with installation, startup, commissioning and customer acceptance testing.
* Support operational readiness planning and project closeout activities.
 **Professional Development**  

* Progressively assume ownership of defined project scope, schedule, financials, field execution and customer\-facing activities.
* Develop competencies aligned with the Daifuku Project Management Skills Matrix, mentoring plan, field rotation requirements and career progression framework.
* Demonstrate readiness for promotion through milestone\-based evaluations covering technical knowledge, customer communication, project controls and leadership capability.
* Build the communication skills required to present project status, risks, financial performance, and recovery plans confidently and effectively to customer and company leadership.
 **Travel Requirements**  

* Ability to travel extensively (up to 80%) to customer and project sites, including occasional evenings and weekends, to support installation, commissioning, customer go\-live and closeout activities.
* Open to temporary relocation within the United States for 12–24 months, including the possibility of sequential assignments at multiple project locations, to support major program and project site needs.
* Relocation assistance may be provided when required, in accordance with company policy and assignment terms.

Qualifications: **Required**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is strongly preferred, Degrees in Project Management, Construction Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain or a related field may also be considered when supported by relevant technical background.
* 0\-3 years of experience in project coordination, engineering, construction, logistics, or industrial automation environments.
* Valid driver's license.
 **Preferred**  

* Internship, co\-op, or project support experience.
* Exposure to automation, warehouse operations, manufacturing, or construction.
* Experience with Microsoft Project or similar scheduling tools.
* CAPM certification or interest in pursuing PMP or similar project management certification.
* Japanese language skills are a plus.
 **Characteristics of Successful Candidates**  

* Strong leadership potential and initiative.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

Bartlett Tree Experts is currently seeking a full\-time Arborist Representative to join our growing team. As an Arborist Representative, you will play an integral role in helping grow our business by developing and maintaining long\-term client relationships. * Base salary (draw) plus commission

As our Sale Representative I, you will support ENGIE’s growth objectives by identifying, developing, and converting new Commercial \& Industrial (C\&I) customer opportunities within the PJM market. The Sale Representative I will be responsible for building a qualified sales pipeline, cultivating strong customer relationships, and delivering energy solutions aligned with customers’ business objectives. Working closely with sales leadership and cross\-functional teams, the Sale Representative I will develop expertise in retail electricity markets while contributing to regional sales growth, customer acquisition, and retention objectives.



This role serves as an entry point into ENGIE’s commercial sales organization and offers a structured pathway for professional development and advancement within the sales function.

  



 Key Accountabilities:


* Sales \& Customer Acquisition

* Assist in developing competitive proposals that meet customer requirements
* Work collaboratively with internal teams to facilitate pricing requests, contract generation, and onboarding activities
* Achieve individual sales goals related to customer acquisition, gross margin, and contracted volume

  



Relationship Management

Market Awareness \& Product Knowledge

**Company:** Qualitrol
  
  

**About Us:**  

Qualitrol International is a global automation parts reseller and repair facility. We service customers worldwide, providing excellent customer and sales support. Our repair division is home to expert technicians that are ready to serve your needs any day or time of the week.
  
Acquired by CIMTEC Automation as their repair division, Qualitrol International has come full circle to becoming the \#1 repair facility for GE's 90\-70, Rx7i's and 90\-30's. * Prospect for new clients through cold calling, networking, and lead follow\-up
* Conduct market research to uncover sales potential and understand customer requirements
* Consult with clients to identify their automation repair needs and challenges, analyze needs, and propose effective solutions using Qualitrol's service capabilities.

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack's AI\-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR's impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.



Founder\-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do.


We're growing quickly, and we're looking for an ambitious, tech\-savvy, and detail\-oriented **Outbound Sales Development Representative** to join our team and make a big impact.



As an Outbound SDR at Muck Rack, you will work closely with our sales team to generate opportunities through outbound outreach. You should be excited about working in a fast\-paced sales environment where you'll be the first "face" of Muck Rack to prospective customers, representing our team, culture, and brand.


**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* **Personalize your interactions** — leverage Muck Rack's tools and prospect insights to make outreach timely, relevant, and informed from the first touch
* **Prospect strategically**— develop efficient, creative outreach systems tailored to target accounts, using our systems to identify patterns and prioritize who to contact and when
* **Plan your day with purpose** — lean on AI\-assisted workflows to structure your time, stay on top of follow\-ups, and keep your pipeline moving without things falling through the cracks
* **Stay plugged into PR** — monitor industry news to surface timely, relevant outreach opportunities
* **Maintain clean CRM hygiene** — keep lead records, activities, and reporting accurate and up to date in Salesforce
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally** — partner closely with Account Executives and Marketing to align outreach efforts and drive pipeline growth

* Meetings booked, held, and converted to pipeline (S2 opportunities)

* Exceptional written communication skills — you write emails that actually get read and responses that move things forward
* Strong phone presence — you can build rapport quickly and keep a conversation going
* Ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, startup environment without dropping the ball
* A quick study with new tools (including AI tools) — we work in Google Workspace, Salesforce, Outreach, Slack, Nooks, SalesNav, etc

* Proactively incorporate AI tools into day to day work to improve productively and accelerate delivery

* Skills Assessment
* 15\-minute Recruiter Screen with SDR Manager

* Panel interview with several members of our team
* 30\-minute Bar Raiser

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for following up on leads and building pipeline for sellers across all of Motorola's North American Government Sales organization. We represent all of Motorola Solution's products and endeavor to help our customers in their quest of "Solving for Safer" by using our end\-to\-end suite of safety products.
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Development Representative is a key contributor in a rapid growth company while representing a product suite that makes an impact on people's lives. Motorola Solutions is a global leader in public safety and enterprise security. Join our team and help us continue to grow!


**Responsibilities include:**

* Run call cadences (with support of an automated dialer) to educate our future customers on the value our solutions bring and drive interest in an initial conversation.
* Ask smart, targeted questions to build rapport with our prospects and identify opportunities.
* Focus on targeted outbound list.
* Collaborate with seasoned sales professionals within a territory you support to find, develop and build key stakeholder interest, and crystalize the needs of the organization across multiple customer profiles and buyer groups.
* Re\-engage lapsed and long\-term leads as we introduce new product features with a focus on bringing them back into the funnel.
* Record prospect interactions and update records within our CRM.

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to articulate value propositions via phone, video, email, and other various social networking platforms.
* Detail oriented, take exceptional meeting/activity notes, and effective in task and time management.
* Highly motivated, passionate, and results driven.
* Willing and able to contribute to team efforts by accomplishing related tasks as needed .
* Commitment to company vision, mission and values.

Under 10%

None

New Grad

Yes

* 10 Paid Holidays

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Parental \& Family Leave

**Overview**

**Position Summary:**  
The Maintenance Coordinator will be the central point of contact for scheduling and tracking repair and maintenance requests across all locations. This role works closely with our in\-house construction and maintenance teams (a sister entity within our organization) to dispatch the right resource for each job, and coordinates with outside vendors when internal staff aren't available or the job requires specialized trades. This is primarily a desk\-based role. This role may also occasionally support new restaurant opening logistics.

* Serve as the main point of contact for maintenance and repair requests coming in from store locations (SoCal, Fresno, Hawaii)
* Triage incoming requests and determine whether to route to internal construction/maintenance staff or an outside vendor
* Schedule and dispatch internal maintenance/construction crews for repairs, installs, and facility work
* Schedule and coordinate outside vendors/technicians (HVAC, plumbing, refrigeration, specialized trades) when internal staff can't cover the job
* Track open work orders from request to completion across both internal crews and outside vendors, following up to ensure timely resolution
* Maintain a master maintenance log/calendar across all 100\+ locations
* Communicate with store managers to prioritize urgent vs. routine repairs
* Coordinate scheduling between internal crews to avoid overlaps or gaps in coverage
* Negotiate and coordinate service calls, quotes, and invoices with third\-party vendors
* Monitor recurring issues by location/equipment type and flag patterns to leadership
* Assist with scheduling preventive maintenance programs (HVAC servicing, equipment inspections, etc.)
* Maintain vendor contact lists, service agreements, and warranty documentation for outside vendors
* Support occasional coordination tasks for new restaurant openings as needed
* Handle general administrative duties: invoices, purchase orders, vendor/crew files

**Qualifications:**

* 1–3 years experience in facilities coordination, maintenance scheduling, dispatch, or similar operations/admin role
* Strong organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple open work orders and coordinate both internal staff and outside vendors simultaneously
* Comfortable communicating with internal crews, vendors, and store\-level managers via phone/email
* Proficient in Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable learning new software/tracking systems
* Problem\-solver who can prioritize urgent issues under time pressure
* Reliable, punctual, and detail\-oriented
* Multi\-unit restaurant, retail, or facilities/property management experience is a plus

Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $55,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

new_jobs.title: VISTA Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Piece by Piece is a Los Angeles nonprofit offering free mosaic art workshops to residents of South LA, Skid Row, and other neighborhoods affected by homelessness, trauma, or economic insecurity. Workshops promote healing, build skills, and generate income. As the VISTA Program Coordinator, you will build on the classroom, attendance, certification, and peer mentorship systems developed in Year Two. You will gather feedback from instructors, staff, and participants, then update classroom workflows, expand attendance and certification tracking, and launch the peer mentorship program by onboarding and matching trained mentors with new participants. You will finish by documenting every system in clear guides and training staff to maintain them. We are looking for someone with strong organizational skills, an interest in classroom or program operations, and comfort building simple tools, checklists, and training materials. **Program Coordinator: Mobile \& Permanent School Pantry**

**Temporary Position Description**

**Location**: Irvine, CA

**Reports To:** Program Supervisor

**Status**: Full\-Time, Hourly, Non\-Exempt; $26\.28 \- $27\.83/hour (DOE)

**Schedule**: Monday – Friday, 40 hours/week, Hybrid: in\-office 3 days \& remote 2 days

Would you like to go to work knowing that every day you’ll be making a real difference in the lives of community members in Orange County? At Second Harvest Food Bank that’s exactly what you’ll be doing – contributing to our mission to provide food for those who need it. You’ll be working alongside team members who are committed to living out the Food Bank’s core values of **Integrity \& Accountability, People First, Compassion, Purpose Driven, and Stewardship**. **Come join our upbeat, collaborative team who are improving lives every day.**

**About Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County**

Second Harvest Food Bank’s (SHFB) Vision: An Orange County with food and nutritional security for all. Our Mission: In collaboration with our partners, we provide dignified, equitable and consistent access to nutritious food, creating a foundation for community health. Since 1983 we have been a source of food security for all members of our community when they need our help.

**POSITION DESCRIPTION:** 

The role of the Program Coordinator is to manage the Mobile School Pantry \& Permanent School Pantry Programs. The primary objective of this position is to coordinate all aspects of both feeding programs to ensure food\-insecure individuals, families and children are being provided fresh, nutritious food at locations throughout Orange County.

The Mobile School Pantry (MSP) Program entails free “farmer’s market” style distributions at schools once a month – overseen and run by school staff and parent volunteers. Each distribution provides fresh produce and other perishable and staple items for 90\-250 families each month. We currently have 76 schools participating in the MSP program.

The Permanent School Pantry (PSP) Program involves distributing food at 7 on\-site pantries at K\-12 schools and community centers, with distributions happening multiple days each week. Clients book appointments to “shop” from the pantries on a weekly basis to select their groceries.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

**Mobile School Pantry and Permanent School Pantry**

* Oversee all aspects of coordinating the MSP Program and the PSP Program.
* Develop, maintain, and cultivate new and existing MSP and PSP partnerships.
* Train and supervise a portfolio of MSP and PSP sites. Set proper expectations for program operations to ensure the program model is carried out by partner, staff, and volunteers at all times. Training for parent volunteers will be in English and/or Spanish.
* Carry out new partner onboarding processes, re\-application processes, as well as on\-site, hands\-on partner training and re\-training as needed.
* Coordinate site delivery schedules with each partner and SHFB Logistics Department.
* Ensure monthly reporting is completed on\-time and accurately by all partners. Proactively look for anomalies in the data and seek answers from partners to address concerns.
* Proactively look for solutions to partner challenges in executing both programs. Including providing guidance and/or working with internal SHFB departments to overcome obstacles.
* Conduct compliance site visits at each MSP and PSP distribution location. Visit all partners once or twice per year, as needed.
* Ensure partner compliance with program rules and regulations, as detailed in the MSP \& PSP Program Agreements.
* Proactively look for ways to continuously improve both programs, including their effectiveness and how we can continue to better meet the needs of our partners and their clients.
* Ensure all Program information in documents, files, and spreadsheets is kept up to date.
* Communicate and work with SHFB Logistics and Operations departments to effectively execute the MSP Program and PSP Program as needed.
* Demonstrate Service Excellence and Integrity when carrying out all aspects of program management.
* Provide continuous feedback and insight to the Product Flow Specialist about product needs; advocate on behalf of MSP \& PSP partners so that we can better understand their needs and build our operating plan around those insights.
* Actively participate in weekly team meetings and report updates, concerns, and successes in group meetings and at 1:1s.
* Attend webinars and trainings to increase food bank, food \& nutritional insecurity, and Feeding America knowledge.
* Assist in collecting client stories for Grant Reports and various Development Department needs.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:**

* Ability to lift 25\-50 pounds to carry equipment and supplies as needed.
* Regular driving throughout Orange County.
* Extended periods of sitting working on computer or on phone.
* Indoor office environment, indoor warehouse environment with moderate noise at food bank location.
* Up to 25% of time spent off\-site at Partner locations and attending various meetings.
* Office hours are 8am – 4:30pm, but schedule varies based on department needs. Possible evening and weekend hours.

**REQUIREMENTS:** 

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience.
* Must have prior professional experience in non\-profit or program coordination.
* Bilingual in Spanish is required, in addition to English. Must be able to read, write, and present to an audience in both English and Spanish.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* A professional who is a reliable, proactive communicator and actively engaged member of the team.
* Self\-starter with the ability, confidence, and good judgment to move projects forward with minimal supervision from direct Supervisor.
* Nurture strong professional relationships with coworkers, partners – current and potential, and external stakeholders.

The Restore Social Media Coordinator brings the ReStore marketing calendar to life through timely, mission\-aligned content, and manages the day\-to\-day execution of ReStore’s social media presence: content creation, photography and video, publishing, and community engagement.


The ideal candidate is creative, organized, comfortable in a fast\-paced retail environment, and able to recognize compelling content opportunities as they happen.


This position is **Part\-Time**, 25 \- 28 hours a week

**Responsibilities**

**Content Creation \& Publishing**

* Create and publish content across Instagram and Facebook according to the established ReStore marketing calendar, maintaining the weekly cadence detailed under Weekly Content Expectations.
* Capture, edit, and publish photos and short\-form video (Reels, Stories) of merchandise, store activity, employees, donations, and events, including music, text overlays, and transitions as appropriate.
* Write captions and calls\-to\-action that support sales, donations, events, and Habitat’s mission, and maintain consistent brand voice and visual identity across channels in alignment with organization\-wide brand standards.
* Plan content capture in advance for major campaigns and events, while staying flexible to cover timely merchandise, trends, and unplanned opportunities.
* Regularly visit ReStore locations to source fresh content, and maintain an organized digital library of photos, video, and templates, repurposing content across formats to maximize its value.
* Verify pricing, dates, locations, and other promotional details for accuracy before publication.

**Community Management \& Customer Engagement**

* Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, and mentions during scheduled daily check\-in windows, in a timely, friendly, and professional manner consistent with ReStore’s brand voice.
* Answer routine customer questions (locations, hours, merchandise, promotions) and loop in store teams for anything requiring additional information.
* Escalate customer complaints, sensitive issues, or mission\-related inquiries to the appropriate team member.
* Engage with followers to strengthen community relationships and convert online engagement into store visits, donations, and event participation.

**Digital Design \& Email Support**

* Create campaign graphics, banners, and social frames using established brand templates, and perform basic photo editing (cropping, resizing, color correction).
* Prepare and edit photography and graphics for the weekly ReStore email blast.
* Coordinate with internal staff or external marketing partners when additional creative support is needed.

**Performance \& Reporting**

* Track platform analytics (reach, engagement, video views, follower growth) and use the insights to identify which content and campaigns perform best.
* Provide periodic updates to leadership on content performance, audience trends, and notable successes, evaluated on meaningful engagement and business impact rather than follower count alone.
* Recommend new content ideas, trends, and creative concepts based on performance data and platform trends.




**Weekly Content Expectations**

* Stories: Monday through Friday
* Primary posts: 7 per week, including at least 3 Reels/short\-form videos
* Community management: scheduled daily check\-in windows (see above)
* Email marketing: weekly email blast photography/image prep


Quantity should never come at the expense of quality, accuracy, or brand consistency.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in nonprofit management, fundraising, or related field.
* At least 2 years of experience in creating social media content for a business, nonprofit, or brand, including intern experience.
* Demonstrated ability to capture engaging photography and video using a smartphone and/or camera.
* Knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, Stories, Reels, and short\-form video editing.
* Working knowledge of Canva, Adobe Express, Photoshop, or similar tools, with basic graphic design skills (composition, typography, layout).
* Strong written communication skills for concise, engaging social copy.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines and work independently.
* Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment on when to escalate customer concerns, and the ability to accept feedback and revise creative work quickly.
* Experience with social media scheduling/analytics tools and email marketing platforms.
* Portfolio demonstrating social content, photography, video, or design work.

new_jobs.title: HR & Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

**The Operations \& HR Coordinator provides administrative, logistical, and systems support for BHNC's human resources and organizational operations functions. Reporting directly to the HR \& Operations Manager, this position plays an important role in ensuring that HR processes, employee records, office systems, compliance documentation, facilities coordination, and administrative workflows are accurate, organized, timely, and consistently maintained. The Coordinator serves as the primary administrative support to the HR \& Operations Manager and works closely with employees, supervisors, Finance, program staff, vendors, consultants, and other organizational partners. Success in this position requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, follow\-through, discretion, comfort managing multiple deadlines, and the ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.**

**BERNAL HEIGHTS NEIGHBORHOOD CENTER**

**Now celebrating our 49th year as a community\-based, member\-led nonprofit organization, BHNC's mission is to preserve and enhance the ethnic, cultural, and economic diversity of Bernal Heights and surrounding neighborhoods. We accomplish our mission by developing affordable housing throughout San Francisco; providing linguistically and culturally responsive services to our community's most vulnerable adults, seniors, youth, and their families; developing leaders; and organizing and empowering our tenants, clients, members, and allies to advocate for their needs and for the needs of the community.**

**BHNC meets its mission through five key program areas: affordable housing development, youth programs, senior programs, employment development, and community engagement.**

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Human Resources Administration \& Employee Lifecycle**

* **Maintain accurate, confidential, and audit\-ready personnel files, HR records, and employee information in ADP and other HR systems.**
* **Coordinate administrative aspects of recruitment, onboarding, employee changes, performance reviews, training, and offboarding, including scheduling, documentation, background checks, and follow\-up.**
* **Maintain HR calendars and tracking systems for evaluations, certifications, required trainings, benefits, leaves, and other employee\-related deadlines.**
* **Prepare routine HR documentation and reports and follow up with employees and supervisors regarding outstanding requirements.**
* **Provide confidential administrative support for employee relations, investigations, grievances, and performance management matters as directed by the HR \& Operations Manager.**

**Benefits, Leave, Payroll \& Compliance**

* **Support administration of employee benefits, open enrollment, leaves, Workers' Compensation, return\-to\-work processes, and related employee documentation.**
* **Coordinate employee and payroll changes with the HR \& Operations Manager and Finance, maintaining accurate supporting documentation.**
* **Maintain required Federal, California, and San Francisco employment postings, compliance calendars, safety records, and documentation.**
* **Support HR and compliance audits, including personnel, wage\-and\-hour, benefits, Workers' Compensation, OSHA, IIPP, and Workplace Violence Prevention records.**
* **Track deadlines, missing documentation, and potential compliance issues and promptly escalate them to the HR \& Operations Manager.**

**Office \& Facilities Operations**

* **Coordinate day\-to\-day office operations, including supplies, facilities requests, IT and telecommunications needs, equipment, mail, and administrative systems.**
* **Maintain organized operational records, including vendor information, contracts, certificates of insurance, warranties, and other organizational documentation.**
* **Coordinate with vendors and staff to ensure operational and facilities issues are addressed and resolved timely.**
* **Support front desk and other administrative operations as needed.**

**Events \& Organizational Support**

* **Coordinate administrative and logistical aspects of community room rentals, including scheduling, agreements, documentation, and internal coordination.**
* **Provide logistical and administrative support for major organizational activities and events, including Fiesta on the Hill, membership activities, open houses, staff events, and other organizational initiatives.**
* **Coordinate vendors, supplies, schedules, and other event\-related logistics as assigned.**

**Project, Systems \& Workflow Coordination**

* **Use Asana and other organizational systems to manage projects, recurring responsibilities, deadlines, and follow\-up.**
* **Maintain departmental calendars, task lists, checklists, templates, standard operating procedures, and tracking systems.**
* **Provide regular status updates to the HR \& Operations Manager regarding deadlines, outstanding tasks, and unresolved issues.**
* **Identify opportunities to improve administrative systems, recordkeeping, and workflow efficiency.**
* **Complete special projects and other duties as assigned.**

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* **Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.**
* **Demonstrated ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and competing priorities.**
* **Strong follow\-up and follow\-through skills.**
* **Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with discretion.**
* **Sound judgment regarding when an issue should be escalated to management.**
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
* **Ability to interact professionally and respectfully with employees, managers, community members, vendors, consultants, and partners from diverse backgrounds.**
* **Ability to work independently while maintaining regular communication with the HR \& Operations Manager.**
* **Ability to create and maintain reliable administrative systems and accurate records.**

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. new_jobs.title: Regional Account Manager, IgAN Nephrology, East Bay, CA
new_jobs.description:
Location: Oakland, United States Job reference: R\-258985 Date posted: 08/27/2026
**Regional Account Manager, IgAN Nephrology, East Bay, CA**


**The territory consists of: Oakland, San Jose, Monterey, and Fresno CA.**


**About the job:**The Regional Account Manager (RAM) position is within our Rare Hematology and Nephrology Franchise, a division of Alexion, AstraZeneca Rare Disease and will focus on the launch of IgAN as a potential new indication. The RAM will be assigned a sales territory focused on academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and other strategic sites of care, focused on nephrology. This individual would be responsible for the growth and expansion of the IgAN indication while supporting appropriate assigned indication opportunities with key nephrology customers.


**Why Join Us?**At Alexion, we’re united by a shared purpose: to transform the lives of people affected by rare diseases. In Neurology, that purpose is personal. We connect deeply with patients and their care teams, and we work together to deliver innovative therapies that make a real difference. Here, your work means more—more impact, more growth, and more connection.


What You’ll DoAs a Regional Account Manager – Rare Nephrology, you’ll build trusted relationships with healthcare professionals across your territory. You’ll represent Alexion’s nephrology indications, helping providers understand our therapies and how they support patients with rare nephrological conditions.


Territory: Must live within the geography


**You will:**• Consistently achieve or exceed sales objectives in assigned territory • Create and maintain strategically targeted account\-specific business plans that reflect an in\-depth understanding of local market forces impacting product sales, diagnostic pathways, referral patterns, and treatment adoption.• Develop and maintain strong, in\-depth clinical, technical, and scientific knowledge across assigned indications, with emphasis on renal disease education and the needs of nephrology customers.• Demonstrate the ability to educate on the clinical approach to relevant disease states, leading to successful differential diagnosis, appropriate testing, and timely treatment of focus patient populations.• Build and maintain productive relationships with nephrologists and other key stakeholders in academic centers, community hospital systems, physician clinics, infusion centers, and related sites of care.• Collaborate closely with internal cross\-functional stakeholders, including peer RAM(s), TLL(s), SAL(s), MSL(s), FRM(s), PEM(s), Market Access, Diagnostics, and enterprise partners.• Handle customer questions and objections in a way that is consistent with product indications and sales training methodology, including the ability to compliantly triage inquiries to the appropriate partner.• Understand and demonstrate proper use of products to clinicians in hospital, clinic, and infusion center environments.• Lead the implementation of a patient\-centric partnership model that includes physicians, their staff, patients, clinics, hospitals, and relevant care partners.• Effectively utilize CRM tools to manage territory priorities, track account engagement, document sales activities, and submit required reports accurately and on time; and adopt CRM AI\-embedded tools to prioritize opportunities and optimize call execution• Effectively use AI\-driven insights for territory planning, HCP targeting, and pre\-call strategy; translate analytics into focused customer engagement and account action plans• Execute local promotional activities and programs for the assigned therapeutic areas.• Provide a high level of product expertise and customer service to all accounts.• Proactively interact with Alexion management to refine product and market initiatives based on field insights, access trends, and account needs.• Perform work in alignment with and adhering to Alexion’s Code of Ethics and Business Conduct and Alexion policies and procedures.

new_jobs.description:
**Please review the job details below.**
----------------------------------------

  

Lanteris Space is seeking an experienced Cost Account Manager to support our Cost Plus Civil Space programs for our offices in Palo Alto CA. This role may also be performed remotely within the U.S. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and reporting cost account performance to ensure compliance with contract requirements, internal financial controls, and program objectives. This role requires strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to work cross\-functionally with engineering, procurement, scheduling and program management teams.


**Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned cost accounts within the Cost Plus program, ensuring accurate tracking of labor, materials, subcontracts, and other direct costs
* Monitor budget\-to\-actual variances and provide timely analysis of cost performance
* Develop and maintain Estimates at Completion (EAC) and Estimates to Complete (ETC)
* Support monthly financial close processes and reconciliation activities
* Identify cost trends, risks, and opportunities for cost savings
* Prepare variance analysis reports and explanations for management review
* Support Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs) and other program reviews
* Ensure compliance with FAR/DFARS regulations and contract requirements for Cost Plus programs
* Prepare accurate and timely financial reports for internal and external stakeholders
* Support government audits (DCAA/DCMA) by providing documentation and cost justification
* Maintain proper cost segregation between contract line items and ensure allowability of costs
* Partner with project leads, engineers, and program managers to forecast resource needs
* Collaborate with procurement on subcontract cost management
* Work with accounting to ensure proper cost allocation and recording
* Participate in program meetings to provide financial insights and recommendations

**Minimum Requirements**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field
* 8 years of experience in cost account management, preferably in aerospace/defense
* Experience with Cost\-Plus government contracts (CPFF, CPAF, CPIF) with responsibility for technical, financial, and contractual performance.
* Experience managing program financials, including forecasting, funding management, Estimates at Completion (EACs), staffing, and resource planning.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or MBA
* Professional certification (CPA, CMA, or EVP certification)
* Knowledge of commercial space architectures, missions, systems, requirements, and acquisition methods required and be able to strategize unique solutions.
* Experience with Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) development and maintenance
* Experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS)

  

In support of pay transparency at Lanteris Space Systems, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings. The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job\-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.


 The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $97,000\.00 \- $161,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $107,000\.00 \- $178,000\.00 annually. The base pay for this position within California is: $111,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 annually.
For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market\-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.  



  

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process.

new_jobs.description:
**About Adapt**


Every company will have a central company agent. Adapt is the platform for building, running, and governing it. We connect the models a company chooses to its systems, data, people, and workflows. With persistent memory, secure compute, deep integrations, reusable skills, and enterprise controls, Adapt helps the agent understand real context, complete real work, and improve over time.  

We believe this infrastructure should be open, portable, secure, and controlled by the organizations that depend on it. Models will change. What a company builds with Adapt stays theirs. Join us in building the platform that will define how companies work with AI. **About the role**


We are hiring the first dedicated owner of Revenue Operations to build one trusted revenue system from first signal through expansion. You will own the system\-of\-record architecture, data definitions, automation, and operating cadence that connect Marketing, Sales, pilots, product usage, billing, and customer growth.


The role centers on the end\-to\-end user funnel, HubSpot and data foundations, routing and ownership, reliable forecasting, and a small set of high\-value automations. You will be an early and demanding user of Adapt, bringing AI into the revenue team’s daily workflows and turning the strongest patterns into governed, repeatable systems.

 **What you will own**

* Full funnel and CRM architecture. Maintain clear lifecycle, qualification, opportunity, deployment, and expansion definitions, plus the CRM objects, properties, associations, permissions, and workflows that support them.
* Routing and handoffs. Design and enforce fit, intent, assignment, response\-time, qualification, and closed\-won handoff rules.
* Pipeline and forecasting. Run opportunity hygiene, forecasting, pipeline inspection, and decision\-ready reporting that revenue leadership can trust.
* Cross\-system context. Connect marketing engagement, sales activity, product usage, billing, and customer signals into useful account and opportunity context using analytics, SQL, APIs, and integrations.
* Automation and governance. Build auditable workflows and lightweight internal tools that remove repetitive work while preserving ownership, permissions, and human review.

 **What success looks like**

* The company operates from one agreed funnel, one active sales pipeline, and trusted definitions.
* Routing, opportunity data, forecast reporting, and customer handoffs are reliable enough to support daily and weekly decisions.
* A small number of trusted AI\-assisted revenue workflows are documented, adopted, and automated, returning time to customer\-facing teams while preserving ownership and human review.
* A revenue operating system where no potential customer signal or lead is left behind.

 **What we are looking for**

* 4\+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or go\-to\-market systems
* Deep experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM platform, including architecture, workflows, permissions, reporting, and data quality
* Strong analytical ability using SQL, spreadsheets, BI, or product analytics tools
* Comfort with APIs, integrations, workflow automation, and lightweight internal\-tool development
* Experience supporting a product\-led, usage\-based, pilot\-led, or hybrid B2B sales motion
* An AI\-native operating mindset and experience using AI, automation, or agents to improve how revenue teams work
* Experience connecting CRMs with product data, billing, support, marketing, or customer success systems
* Experience deploying agentic revenue workflows across Sales and Marketing with clear governance and human review

 **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation strategy including large equity grants for early hires at an early stage in the company's journey
* Inclusive healthcare packages (medical, dental, vision)
* Frontier AI access: Claude Code, OpenAI, Cursor, Codex, and most importantly unlimited internal use of Adapt itself

  

OTE: $180\-220k. Actual offer depends on skills, experience, and location. Total comp also includes equity, benefits, and potential bonus or variable pay. Your recruiter will walk you through the details.

  

Adapt is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Adapt encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

As a Sales Development Representative at Cursor, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. **POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low\-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017\) and the Brookings Institution (2020\).Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.
