new_jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - International Student Services
new_jobs.description:
Administrative Coordinator \- International Student Services


**POSITION DETAILS**


Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens, LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre\-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one\-third of LaGuardia’s degree\-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first\-generation college students.


Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25\. Forty\-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Upon graduation most students transfer to four\-year colleges, typically in CUNY, to complete their baccalaureate degrees. Graduates of career programs such as Nursing, Computer Technology, and Veterinary Technology enter the workforce. LaGuardia ranked fifth among U.S. community colleges in economic mobility – moving low\-income students into the middle class and beyond – in studies by Stanford University (2017\) and the Brookings Institution (2020\). Please visit www.laguardia.edu to learn more.


The Admissions Office plays a critical role in supporting prospective students through the college entry process by providing clear information, accessible services, and a welcoming environment for all visitors and applicants.


Reporting to the Associate Director of Admissions Services, the Administrative Coordinator supports the operational and administrative functions of the Admissions Office and serves as a central point of coordination for student\-facing services. The position assists in ensuring efficient front desk operations, administrative workflow, and office logistics that support recruitment activities, application processing, and general student service delivery. \_


The Administrative Coordinator will manage front desk operations, coordinate office materials and supplies, support administrative processes related to admissions operations, and assist with daily office coordination. The role contributes to maintaining a welcoming, organized, and student\-centered environment while supporting the overall operational effectiveness of the Admissions Office.


The Administrative Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day operations of the Admissions Office and assists in coordinating administrative processes that support recruitment activities, student service delivery, and admissions operations. Duties include, but are not limited to, the following:


* Coordinate front desk operations and serve as the primary point of contact for prospective students, applicants, and visitors; Coordinate daily administrative functions to ensure efficient workflow within the Admissions Office;
* Provide general information regarding admissions procedures, application processes, and student services; respond to general inquiries via phone, email, and in\-person visits;
* Assist with managing student service flow and visitor check\-in processes within the Admissions Office;
* Prepare, copy, assemble, and distribute admissions materials, informational packets, and office documentation;
* Maintain office records, files, and departmental databases to ensure accuracy and accessibility;
* Assist in preparing administrative reports, spreadsheets, and internal documentation as needed.
* Update and maintain records within university systems and internal tracking documents;
* Support admissions workshops, information sessions, and events through administrative coordination and preparation of materials;
* Coordinate office supply inventory and ordering to ensure the office is appropriately stocked; assist with coordination of office equipment and operational needs.
* Assist with coordination of departmental initiatives, recruitment activities, and special projects that support Admissions operations and student engagement;
* Contribute to maintaining a professional, organized, and student\-centered office environment.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


Bachelor's Degree required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience supporting administrative or office operations, preferably in a higher education or student services environment.
* Experience working in a high\-volume, student\-facing or customer service setting.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced office environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Experience coordinating office logistics such as front desk operations, materials preparation, or supply management.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with diverse populations.
* Bilingual ability preferred (Spanish strongly preferred).


**CUNY TITLE OVERVIEW**


Supports projects, initiatives, and activities that impact an academic or administrative department.


* Manages basic office functions such as communications, meeting schedules, work plans, staff assignments, and distributing information.
* Collects data for, prepares, and distributes reports and presentations using word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
* Updates office databases, lists, and files to ensure completeness and accuracy; maintains current information on department web site(s); maintains department archives and collections.
* Conducts internet and/or database research and performs basic systems queries to locate information related to department activities.
* Maintains department fiscal plans and budgets; assists in budget administration and invoice processing.
* Provides basic information, instructions, and materials as requested by students, faculty, and others who contact the department.
* May supervise office staff and student workers.
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Who are we?**


City Harvest is New York’s first and largest food rescue organization and a fast\-paced, high\-performing nonprofit dedicated to helping feed millions of New Yorkers who struggle to put meals on their tables. During our more than 40 years serving New Yorkers in need, we have rescued more than one billion pounds of fresh, nutritious food and delivered it free of charge to hundreds of food pantries, soup kitchens, community partners, and our own Mobile Markets across the five boroughs. This year, we will rescue and distribute more than 100 million pounds of nutritious food to our neighbors in need. City Harvest works alongside our community partners to boost community capacity, expand nutrition education, and strengthen local food systems. Since our founding in 1982, City Harvest has always been there to feed our city one day, one meal, and one New Yorker at a time while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and excellence to maximize our impact across New York City.

**Who are you?**


You are a team player and a highly motivated self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced environment. You have a passion for logistics, data, and continuous improvement, and you’re eager to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to keep our operations running smoothly. Experience with routing, dispatching, and performance management is a plus. You focus on details while keeping an eye on the big picture, and you see challenges as opportunities to improve how we serve New Yorkers.

**Job Description:**


The Logistics Coordinator plays a critical role in City Harvest’s daily operations by managing routing, dispatch, and data analysis that drive key organizational outcomes. This person supports the planning, scheduling, and monitoring of routes while helping identify and implement improvements to increase on\-time performance, reduce undeliverables, and enhance capacity utilization. The role collaborates closely with Transportation, Network Relations, Supply Chain NY, Warehouse, and Business Intelligence teams to ensure smooth execution.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Support day\-to\-day planning, routing, and logistics operations for City Harvest’s network.
* Provide real\-time updates and act as a key point of contact for routing changes, callouts, and urgent adjustments.
* Analyze operational data in Field Service, Samsara, and Power BI to identify trends and recommend process improvements.
* Assist in creating and maintaining routing documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Contribute to the achievement of departmental KPIs, including on\-time performance, capacity utilization, and delivery success rates.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with other departments to address logistics issues and ensure smooth coordination of deliveries and pickups.
* Support seasonal routing efforts (e.g., holiday proteins, large rescues, special events) and manage high\-volume irregular stop requests.
* Contribute to data accuracy by reconciling route completion data and processing undeliverables with detailed notes.
* Communicate effectively across teams to keep stakeholders informed on key operational updates and issues.

**Skills \& Experience**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics CRM, Samsara, and Excel; familiarity with Power BI.
* Ability to adapt quickly and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Attention to detail, accuracy in documentation, and commitment to continuous improvement

**Why work at City Harvest?**


There are many fantastic reasons to choose a career with City Harvest. In addition to fighting food insecurity in New York, City Harvest offers the following Benefits and Rewards:

* Competitive market salaries
* Generous time off
* Full benefits (medical, dental, vision) \- employer contributions towards premiums
* Pet Insurance
* 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer\-matching
* Free Mental Health Services with Better Help
* Commuter Benefits
* Employer\-provided life insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Discounted staff perks (e.g. movie tickets, gym memberships, cellular plans)


At City Harvest, we enjoy working in a team\-based environment and value the benefits of a diversified workplace. City Harvest is an Equal Opportunity Employer

**What this job involves**


We are looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Leasing team. You will provide high level support to commercial real estate brokerage producers. You will have the opportunity to engage in a well\-rounded list of contributions for the team, which will include: administrative, financial, marketing and operational functions for the business. As an integral member of our team, you will partner with the Sales Account Executives from inception to execution of digital \& cross platform ad campaigns that meet our clients’ objectives. new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. new_jobs.title: LearnVantage Software Sales Account Exec Manager Enterprise Account Management
new_jobs.description:
Software Sales Manager \| Senior Level \| Full time
Job No. R00353050 \| Multiple Locations
  
**We Are:**


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's comprehensive technology learning and training service, built on a $1 billion investment to help the world's leading organizations reskill and upskill their workforces for the AI economy. Launched in March 2024, LearnVantage brings together three industry\-leading training organizations — Udacity (AI, data science, and digital skills), Award Solutions (advanced wireless, 5G, and network technologies), and Ascendient Learning (instructor\-led IT training and vendor\-authorized certifications) — into a single, AI\-powered platform that delivers personalized, outcomes\-driven workforce transformation at enterprise scale.


We sit at the intersection of Accenture's deepest client relationships and the most urgent workforce challenge in the market: helping global enterprises close the AI skills gap at speed and at scale. With Accenture's trust, reach, and account access as our foundation, LearnVantage is positioned to become the defining workforce reinvention partner for the world's most important organizations.

**You Are:**


A strategic, relationship\-driven enterprise seller who knows how to navigate large, complex organizations — both externally with clients and internally within Accenture. You are equally comfortable sitting in an account planning session with a Managing Director as you are presenting a workforce reinvention business case to a client's CHRO. You understand how Accenture operates, how Diamond Account teams think, and how to position LearnVantage as a natural, high\-value extension of the work Accenture is already doing.


You are not a lone wolf. You are a collaborator, an orchestrator, and a trusted partner to the Accenture account teams you work alongside. You know that in this environment, internal influence is as important as external selling — and you have the credibility, patience, and commercial instincts to build both.

**The Work:**

* Embed within Accenture's Diamond Account and strategic account teams as the dedicated LearnVantage sales resource, attending account planning sessions, QBRs, and client meetings to identify and qualify workforce reinvention opportunities within active Accenture engagements
* Build trusted, recurring relationships with Client Account Leads (CALs), Managing Directors, and Accenture industry leads across assigned accounts, establishing yourself as the go\-to LearnVantage expert within the Accenture ecosystem
* Identify the right moment to introduce LearnVantage into active Accenture transformation programs — attaching AI, data, cloud, networking, and certification training to technology implementations, managed services agreements, and change management programs already underway
* Lead executive\-level discovery and solution presentations with client C\-suite stakeholders (CIO, CHRO, CDO, CEO, CLO), positioned as a strategic LearnVantage partner rather than a training vendor add\-on
* Design comprehensive LearnVantage workforce solutions — drawing on LearnVantage AI programs, Award Solutions 5G and network training, and Ascendient Learning IT certification — that complement and accelerate the technology transformations Accenture is delivering
* Present value\-selling business cases that connect LearnVantage investments to measurable client outcomes: AI capability development, technology adoption speed, workforce productivity, talent retention, and long\-term competitive readiness
* Navigate Accenture's internal commercial processes — including CCI considerations, Accenture Funding mechanisms, and co\-investment structures — with the knowledge and credibility to advocate for LearnVantage's commercial interests while maintaining strong internal relationships
* Manage LearnVantage pipeline across all assigned Accenture accounts with disciplined CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and regular visibility for both LearnVantage and Accenture leadership
* Convert Accenture\-introduced opportunities into closed, contracted LearnVantage engagements and expand those engagements over time into multi\-year, multi\-solution workforce partnerships
* Serve as the voice of the client and the CAL back to LearnVantage's product, curriculum, and go\-to\-market teams — surfacing emerging skill gaps, deal structure needs, and market opportunities that improve LearnVantage's relevance within the Accenture ecosystem


Travel to client sites and Accenture offices as required to support strategic account pursuits; travel estimated at 30–50% depending on assigned accounts


  
**Here's What You Need:**


* Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development, account management, sales leadership, or new logo acquisition in a consulting, technology, or professional services environment.
* Demonstrated track record of originating and closing significant net new business in mid\-market or multi\-subsidiary environments, preferably $500K\+ ARR deals or more
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

**Bonus Points If:**


* You have direct experience with Accenture's account structure, including familiarity with Diamond Accounts, CAL/MD relationships, and Accenture's internal commercial processes (CCI, Accenture Funding, co\-investment)
* You have experience selling corporate learning, AI and digital skills platforms, managed learning services, IT certification training, or workforce technology into large enterprise accounts
* You have familiarity with any LearnVantage solution area — AI/ML (Udacity), advanced wireless and 5G (Award Solutions), or instructor\-led IT certification (Ascendient Learning)
* You have experience building and scaling a co\-sell motion within a large partner or alliance ecosystem
* You have experience leading or mentoring sales talent and an interest in helping build the LearnVantage sales team as

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview:
**Salary range:** $85,000 \- $90,000 **Position Summary:**  

The purpose of this position is to service territory customers through a concentrated focus and compliance with NYK marketing strategies. To strive to achieve/surpass pre\-determined targets and to maintain relationships with customers towards creating long\-lasting relationships.
Responsibilities:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Travel and develop personal and professional relationships particularly with High/Heavy and Automotive.
* Preplan sales itineraries and calendar significant events in the territory.
* Work in coordination with Trade and Customer Service to ensure that the account base is serviced in a manner which will result in customer satisfaction.
* Develop sales strategy for region to achieve budgeted revenues.
* Conduct satisfaction surveys in coordination with customer service team on a regular basis to identify strengths and weaknesses for further improvement of service to customers.
* Prepare sales reports and sign off on their accuracy before submitting them.
* Develop and communicate information regarding the competitive landscape including any changes in competitor services or related issues.
* Establish a referral network with local businesses and find ways to maximize value from those connections.
* Engage with the accounts receivable team to ensure collections in an agreed timeline.
* Apply company values (Integrity, Innovation and Intensity) in all relationships.
* Compliance with performance criteria as set forth by the trade team.
* Completion of annual goals, targets and projects outlined in annual review.
* Maintain and enhance quality relations with customers within outlined areas of responsibility.
* Portray a positive team approach internally.
* Take responsibility for relations with colleagues and customers.
* Respect the differences of others and treat others with respect.
* Remain open and encourage new ideas while ensuring we respect the principles of our corporate identity.
* Seek internal NYK group synergies and propose recommendations with mutual benefits for both the group and the customer.
* Improve upon skills requiring attention outlined in the employee performance appraisal and self\-evaluation.
* Continually seek out ways to better the service product offered to customers.
* Continue professional development in the area of business management.
* Ability to work in a multi\-tasked environment.


Qualifications:
**1\. SPECIAL SKILLS*** Social skills necessary to interact effectively with outside customers as well as NYK internal necessary
* Diligent approach to obtaining more profitable business
* Knowledge of pricing and service contracting
* Ability to effectively complete tasks within budget constraints
* Excellent analytical/problem solving skills
* Excellent planning and organizational skills
* Key customer relationships required
* Strong verbal and written communication skills

**2\. PREFERRED EDUCATION*** Bachelor's degree required

**3\. WORK EXPERIENCE*** Minimum of 5 years of related experience

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.* **Benefits****NYK offers a generous Employee Benefits Package including:*** Medical, Dental, and Vision
* 401k with a company match and Pension Plan
* Flexible Spending Accounts, Life Insurance, Tuition Assistance Program, Vacation, and much more.

*Any and all benefits offered are subject to the eligibility requirements, terms, and provisions set forth in the respective policies and plan documents, which you may request from Human Resources.* **About NYK Group Americas Inc.**
Founded in 1885, Nippon Yusen Kabushiki Kaisha (NYK Line) has become a leader in global marine transport by meeting challenges head on and achieving steady growth. NYK recognizes our role in providing safe and reliable services for a broad range of trade and commercial activities that are the basis for developing the world's economies and cultures.  

NYK Line *NYK Group Americas Inc. values each individual employee and is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce by providing equal employment opportunities for all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, citizenship status, uniform service member status, age, disability, sexual and gender orientation, genetic information, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws.* ***NGA Group Companies do not include salary ranges in job postings,*** ***except where required by state law******, because the total compensation is dependent on the candidates’ experience, the position location, and several other factors. At times, job posting sites add a salary range without the approval of the NGA Group Companies and the ranges provided may be inaccurate and/or misleading. We encourage candidates to apply to our NGA Group Companies and discuss their compensation expectations as part of the recruitment process.***

**Overview:**


The Daily Beast is seeking a Community Manager to help grow and engage our audience across Substack, Reddit, YouTube, and our on\-site commenting platform. This cross\-functional role sits across editorial, social, audience, and product. You’ll work closely with our editors and producers to make sure our conversations are sharp, lively, and on\-brand—and that our readers keep coming back for more.


If you live on Substack and believe internet discourse can be better with the right tone\-setters, this position is for you.


The role will be primarily Sunday through Thursday and based in our NYC office four days a week.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and execute a robust Substack community content plan that complements our growing network of authors and publications, highlighting their voices and expanding their reach

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in social media, community management, audience development, or digital journalism
* Familiarity with Reddit and Substack, including what drives engagement and how conversations flow
* Strong editorial instincts with the ability to write sharp, engaging prompts and comment responses
* Analytical mindset with basic comfort reading data to inform content and community strategy
* Highly organized and able to work across multiple teams in a fast\-paced environment
* Genuine interest in media, news, and digital communities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with community engagement tools
* Prior experience running AMAs, live chats, or community newsletters
* Understanding of basic video editing skills is highly desirable
* Familiarity with moderation workflows and digital comment culture

**Why Join Us?**  

This is a chance to help shape the next chapter of the Daily Beast’s social strategy—building not just bigger numbers, but deeper connections. You’ll be part of a collaborative, creative team that’s unafraid to take smart risks and do things differently.

Richelieu is a leading North American distributor, importer, and manufacturer of specialty hardware and complementary products. Our products are targeted to an extensive customer base of kitchen and bathroom cabinet, storage and closet, home furnishing and office furniture manufacturers, door and window, residential and commercial woodworkers, and hardware retailers including renovation superstores. In turn, you will be building a thriving business of your own.

* Hold responsibility for system information and reporting in CRM application

  


**What We Are Looking For**


* Technically\-minded, preferably with experience or education in chemistry /science
* Knowledge of wood coatings or powder/spray coatings is key to success in this position; spray application finish background is a plus

* Passionate, proactive, coachable, strong work ethic
* Ability to schedule and manage your own time, delivering on the activities that produce results
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
* Developed analytical, planning, organizing, and monitoring skills
* Experience in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software an asset
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; must be able to effectively use Excel, Word, Outlook for daily responsibilities and tasks
* As this position requires regular automobile travel, you must have your own independent, reliable transportation. This position requires you to work "in the field," making in\-person visits to customers three to four days per week
* This position may occasionally involve lifting/pushing/carrying items up to 50 pounds

  


**Compensation and Benefits**


* **Total annual earnings** (base pay \+ commission) potential for the first 1\-2 years is estimated to be approximately $85,000 \- $115,000 (with no cap on commissions; total earnings will likely increase over time)

new_jobs.description:
Position Description: Greenleaf is an owner\-operator of commercial and multi\-family real estate in the Southeast, with a vertically integrated platform spanning acquisitions, asset management, property operations, and private capital. The Transaction Coordinator supports the Director of Transactions by coordinating and tracking the transaction process of the purchase, disposition, and refinancing of assets. **Responsibilities:*** Assist the Director of Transactions throughout all phases of the transaction lifecycle, from initial contract through closing
* Serve as a point of contact for key transaction partners and respond to correspondence within 24 hours
* Calculate and track all critical dates of a contract with all parties, flagging deadlines to the Director of Transactions to ensure on\-time delivery with 100% accuracy (Earnest Money, document delivery, Inspection Period, Site Visits – appraisal, PCA, Phase I, survey, title, closing timeline)
* Work with cross\-functional teams and serve as the transaction bridge between phases and teams throughout the project timeline
* Research and receive proposals from 3rd party vendors for due diligence reporting (PCA, Survey, Environmental, etc.)
* Collect, organize, and file all due diligence documents and report findings to the Director of Transactions (LOI, PSA, Amendments, historical P\&L’s, leases, property agreements, utility bills, insurance survey, PCA/ESA Reports, appraisal, title objections)
* Assist with the coordination of onsite inspections
* Assist in the formation of entities, drafting and preparation of transaction\-related documents, including contracts, amendments, and operating agreements, under the direction of the Director of Transactions
* Support the Director of Transactions with all aspects of transaction closing, including preparing signature pages, assisting with closing statement preparation, and coordinating closing day communication
* Post\-closing administrative items as needed with consistent filing

 **Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in business, real estate, finance or other related degree
* Minimum 2\-3 years of relevant real estate experience
* An understanding of commercial real estate transactions and industry terms, valuation principles and concepts preferred
* Strong organizational and coordination skillset with an ability to multitask and meet deadlines
* Strong communication (written and oral) and customer service skills
* High level of attention to detail, analytical mindset and ability to work independently or in a team environment

 **Get to Know Greenleaf**
Greenleaf is an organization built of team members in the Southeast based on 4 core principles: dream big, work hard, play by the rules, and take care of each other. Greenleaf was founded in 2007 with one single family home and just 3 employees. We have since grown to approximately 60 team members and continue to grow. Greenleaf places our family of residents, employees, and investors first in every decision throughout the business. We believe in holding and investing in each piece of real estate for the long term to be well positioned for market cycles and opportunities. **Greenleaf Management has a lot to offer:*** Competitive Salary: DOE
* Bonus Program
* Benefits: 401(k) retirement and a comprehensive benefits suite including Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance to give your family the coverage you deserve!
* Dreams: Share your personal/professional goals and we'll help you reach them

  

Greenleaf is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We perform background checks and drug screens. We are also in a tobacco free work environment.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

This position provides general budgeting and administrative support to the director and regional field operations with particular emphasis on accounts payable. A key component of this position is to incorporate the Lawson system into the regional accounts payable process and to oversee budgeted versus actual expenditures.  

\*\*Job level and pay commensurate with experience and skill set.\*\*
Responsibilities:
* Initiates Major Maintenance job numbers and requests Capital job numbers as needed for region projects. Ensures corporate and regional authority limits and procedures are followed.
* Supports budget and spending for smaller region office\-related capital or major maintenance projects and other region projects as assigned. Prepares cost projections, processes, and analyzes bids, oversees budget control and reporting, and reviews cash flow.
* Prepares and reviews cost tracking reports extracted from general ledger or other accounting reports monthly as well as upon request of Region Director or project manager.
* Researches, analyzes, recommends, and confirms corrections or changes to accounting entries on general ledger, CWIP and various reports.
* Researches and analyzes invoices or other charges as needed or upon request of Region Director or project manager. Makes recommendations and resolves discrepancies with vendors.
* Accounts Payable and Purchasing – knows local/company policy and ensures company policies and procedures for invoice processing, data entry, purchasing, and procurement cards are followed. Invoice approvals within expenditure authority as required.
* Coordinates and implements best purchasing/pricing practices.
* Print and distribute reports on a routine basis (weekly, monthly, etc.,)
* Create new vendors as needed by each region.
* Assist with employee’s expenses and submittal.
* Coordinates and completes annual and updated monthly budget forecasting for various business units and types of budgets.
* Creates and manages step increase payroll data files for all employees.
* Formulates and implements policies and procedures for the regional accounts payable process.
* Regional Fleet maintenance\-vehicle purchases/disposal/transfers/annual registrations and monthly reports.
* Assist in tracking regional training requirements.
* Act as liaison with KM Mobile Communications in the maintenance of pager/cell phone/air card/smart phones\-tracking/monitoring/receiving data access payments due to KM.
* Coordinate staff additions, transfers, office moves, and changes, events, meetings, training classes, etc.
* Provides basic in\-house computer software support and training such as Lawson and PAWS, as assigned.
* Maintains and balances regional working fund.
* Provide support and perform other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:
**Education:*** High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

**Required Qualifications:****Experience / specific knowledge:*** Minimum 3 to 5 years general clerical experience with solid knowledge of general office procedures, including record maintenance systems, budgeting, and administrative practices.
* Excellent PC skills: knowledge and proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Outlook is required.
* A satisfactory driving record as determined by the Company and current, valid State driver’s license are required.

**Competencies, skills, and abilities**:* Good oral and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with computer applications, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Must be a detail\-oriented professional who can take direction as well as work independently.
* Must be a proactive individual with the ability to exercise good judgment and resolve issues.
* Must be flexible and able to work effectively in a team environment and consistently maintain a professional and respectful demeanor/attitude with co\-workers, clients, vendors, and regulatory agencies.
* Must be dependable and able to maintain confidentiality.
* Must be able to work under pressure while meeting critical time frames on multiple task/projects.
* Must be a problem solver with the ability to find resolutions.
* Must be able to work with a team, take direction from supervisors, adhere to required work schedules, focus attention on details and follow work rules.

**Physical demands:*** Normal bending, stooping, and twisting in an office environment.


The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed. This position may perform other duties as assigned.
Job level and pay commensurate with experience and skill set.**Preferred Qualifications:*** College degree preferred, but not required.

**Working Conditions:*** Occasion overtime and extended work hours in cases of emergencies or business needs.
* May be required to work alone and independently.

  


Why Join Kinder Morgan:

Kinder Morgan is a large energy infrastructure company operating in North America. Access to reliable, affordable energy is a critical component for improving lives around the world. We are committed to providing energy transportation and storage services in a safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible manner for the benefit of the people, communities, and businesses we serve.

  



Kinder Morgan provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, gender (including gender identity and expression), sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, family status, status as an individual authorized to work in the U.S., or any other status protected by law.

  



For more information about Kinder Morgan, our culture, opportunities available, and to join our Talent Community, please visit our careers site at **www.kindermorgan.com**.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager (Commercial Landscaping)
new_jobs.description:
**THE POSITION**


This position is a high\-impact role, working closely with the Branch Manager, Production Manager, and production teams to create and maintain meaningful client relationships. This person will manage existing relationships, develop new business opportunities, and identify networking opportunities within the industry.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

**Client Service and Retention**

* Drive customer satisfaction and retention by understanding the individual needs of our customers and the spaces that bring them joy and peace
* Provide excellent service and communication with a focus on problem\-solving
* Promote high standards for customer service, safety, and LandCare's culture
* Provide organizational management, leadership and communication between the client and production team
* Maintain LandCare's Landscape Quality Audit process in conjunction with the Production Manager to identify property maintenance needs and enhancement opportunities
* Create client proposals, contracts, and recommendations and estimates that are designed to meet each client's objectives
* Coordinate between client expectations and production reality to ensure every project reflects our commitment to quality
* Promote sustainable solutions that create landscapes supporting the health of the planet while meeting client needs

**New Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities by cultivating and maintaining business relationships with existing customers
* Actively prospect for potential clients and pursue new business relationships through authentic relationship building
* Participate in, organize, and lead networking events to foster relationships with potential and existing customers as both a leader in the industry and a representative of LandCare
* Engage with property owners who understand the transformative power of thoughtfully designed outdoor environments that benefit both people and the planet

**Professional Development**

* Participate in programs that focus on building operational excellence
* Engage in networking and growth opportunities through our Women's Initiative Network
* Join Book Clubs and other learning initiatives that foster continuous professional growth
* Access mentorship and training programs designed to advance your career in meaningful ways
  

  

  

**Benefits**  

Besides the great team environment and the ability to work outside, we also have a strong benefits package for our team members:


* Competitive base salary
* Team based profit sharing program
* 401K for all employees with 3\.5% company match
* Company\-provided vehicle
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid Time Off Policy \+ 9 corporate holidays
* Formal training and development program

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. We’re seeking a positive, personable Account Manager who can offer high\-quality, dependable support to both our operations staff and sales team and help improve our efficiency. The Account Manager will need to be ready to assist in the continued growth and development of our boutique firm’s portfolio of clients. Through our ongoing growth initiatives and strategic affiliate relationships, our firm has grown consistently over the past 21\+ years. Unique concepts and original approaches to problems help us to differentiate ourselves from the competition.


Our operations staff and sales team need an infusion of talent to help drive our firm’s next phase of progress. We are seeking a highly motivated, self\-disciplined individual with integrity to join our team. If you are a strong communicator who demonstrates professionalism and you are interested in applying your skills to facilitate Agile’s robust growth, we encourage you to apply today.


Applicants must have the ability to come into our Norcross office a minimum of 5 days per week, but the hours are flexible, and we are willing to work with your schedule to develop a routine that works for you.


You’ll connect with new people, tackle tough problems, and raise the bar on an excellent customer experience. We welcome applicants who are interested in upward mobility, a positive work environment, and can’t wait to get started!

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Base pay of $22\.50 per hour
* Health insurance for full\-time
* Company 401(k) program, with employer matching for full\-time
* Company profit\-sharing program for full\-time
* Paid vacation and holidays

 **Compensation:**
$22\.50 per hour

 **Responsibilities:*** Utilize scripts to handle difficult customer situations and bring them higher up, if necessary
* Ensure customer account information is up\-to\-date
* Create records of customer interactions and follow up to ensure all questions have been answered
* Keep customer satisfaction levels high by providing accurate information, resolving issues, and mitigating complaints
* Assist operations staff by contacting clients via phone and email to request and receive the required paperwork and other documentation that supports our projects
* Facilitate meetings, Zoom calls, and conference calls with clients and provide follow\-up emails summarizing those interactions

 **Qualifications:*** Display strong communication skills, active listening skills, and personal skills
* Experience working in a customer\-oriented atmosphere


* Ability to convey professionalism via phone and email
* Superior organizational skills to monitor the status of several different projects
* Work well with others and be a team player
* Intermediate skills with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Prior administrative experience in the accounting, tax, or consulting industries a plus
* Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a corporate environment
* BA/BS preferred

 **About Company** **Agile’s Purpose:**


We assist clients by aligning their tax and accounting systems with current sales \& use tax laws. That enables them to either maximize the benefit of the exemptions for which they qualify or become and remain compliant with their ongoing sales \& use tax collection, reporting, and filing obligations.

**Agile’s Vision:**


To establish \& maintain a reputation with consumers for developing \& delivering the most innovative, personalized, and comprehensive sales and use tax solutions to clients.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - Individual Benefits
new_jobs.description:
Description:  



**About Legacy Risk Solutions**


Legacy Risk Solutions is a leading independent insurance agency platform headquartered in Gainesville, Georgia. Through its growing network of agency partners across the Southeast, Legacy provides commercial insurance, employee benefits, personal insurance, and risk management solutions to businesses and individuals. Built on a people\-first culture rooted in integrity, growth, and partnership, Legacy combines local expertise with the strength and resources of a larger organization to deliver exceptional service and long\-term success for clients, employees, and agency partners.

**Position Summary**


Legacy Risk Solutions is seeking an experienced Individual Benefits Account Manager to join our growing team. This role is responsible for supporting and servicing clients with individual insurance and benefits needs, providing knowledgeable guidance throughout the application, enrollment, renewal, and ongoing policy service process.


The ideal candidate is a client\-focused insurance professional with strong knowledge of individual health and benefits products, carrier requirements, and enrollment processes. This individual serves as a trusted resource for clients, helping them understand their coverage options, navigate policy questions, and resolve service issues while maintaining strong relationships with carrier partners and internal teams.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage and service a book of individual benefits clients throughout the policy lifecycle, including new enrollments, renewals, policy changes, and ongoing service needs.
* Assist clients in understanding available individual insurance options and identifying solutions that align with their coverage needs and circumstances.
* Prepare and review individual benefit quotes, applications, renewal information, and supporting documentation.
* Market and analyze available individual benefit products, coverage options, and rates across appropriate carrier partners.
* Explain plan benefits, premiums, deductibles, copays, coinsurance, networks, exclusions, and other important coverage provisions to clients.
* Coordinate new business applications and enrollments, ensuring required information and documentation are complete and submitted to carriers accurately and on time.
* Assist existing clients with annual renewals and evaluate alternative coverage options when appropriate.
* Monitor pending applications and enrollment activity and proactively follow up with clients and carriers to ensure timely completion.
* Process policy changes and qualifying life event requests through carrier websites and applicable online administration portals.
* Respond to client questions and service requests involving coverage, enrollment status, billing, claims, ID cards, policy documents, and other benefit\-related needs.
* Research and resolve billing, claims, enrollment, and policy administration issues by coordinating with clients and carrier partners.
* Assist clients with obtaining replacement ID cards, policy documents, and other carrier materials as needed.
* Maintain a strong understanding of carrier products, eligibility requirements, underwriting guidelines, enrollment periods, and applicable individual benefits regulations.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with carrier representatives and other business partners.
* Provide timely and responsive service to client calls and emails, with a goal of responding to inquiries within one business day.
* Maintain complete and accurate client records, communications, applications, policy documents, and other activity within the agency management system.
* Attend relevant carrier meetings, continuing education seminars, webinars, and training to maintain current knowledge of individual insurance products and industry developments.
* Participate in scheduled team meetings and collaborate with other team members to support department goals.
* Provide account management backup and support to the team when needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve client service, workflows, and internal processes.
* Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Requirements:  



**What We’re Looking For**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Active Accident, Sickness \& Life Insurance License required.
* Minimum of 3–4 years of insurance experience, preferably supporting individual health, life, or related benefits products.
* Strong knowledge of individual insurance products, carrier requirements, enrollment processes, and policy servicing.
* Experience working directly with individual clients and carrier partners preferred.
* Experience with carrier websites, quoting platforms, enrollment systems, and agency management systems preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain insurance terminology and coverage information in a clear, client\-friendly manner.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple clients, applications, renewals, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to research and resolve client service, billing, claims, and enrollment issues.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members and carrier partners.
* Client\-focused, solutions\-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering an exceptional service experience.
* Initiative and willingness to take ownership of responsibilities and support the broader team as needed.

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Life insurance coverage
* Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage
* Accident and critical illness i

new_jobs.title: Market Development Account Manager- Southeast
new_jobs.description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------


We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------



The Market Development Account Manager is responsible for securing access to and reimbursement for Teva’s psychiatric products and other therapies by building and nurturing strong relationships, primarily with large mental health facility and specialty pharmacy stakeholders and government organizations.


A successful individual in this role:

* Develops effective business plans to meeting and exceed territory\-level goals
* Builds rapport and relationships by interacting effectively with internal and external contacts at all levels, demonstrating awareness of their needs and responding with appropriate action
* Demonstrates a collaborative approach and coordinates efforts between sales leadership, other sales teams, Market Access, Sales Operations, and Sales Training
* Reviews and analyzes weekly/monthly data reports to identify trends and develop plans to address areas of concern
* Thinks, plans, and acts strategically with long term focus versus task orientation
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------



All areas of responsibility listed below are essential to the satisfactory performance of this position by any incumbents with reasonable accommodation if necessary. Any non\-essential functions are assumed to be included in other related duties or assignments.

* Develop and nurture strong relationships with key customers such as healthcare institutions, hospitals, clinics, mental health facilities, specialty pharmacies, and government organizations.
* Leverage in\-depth knowledge of Teva’s psychiatric products and therapies to provide expert guidance and support to key accounts with a focus on large mental health facilities.
* Create and implement strategic account plans tailored to each key customer and align them with the company’s objectives; act as point on large regional psychiatric facility accounts.
* Identify the unique needs and challenges of each key account and propose customized solutions that align with Teva’s products and services.
* Partner with the Specialty Pharmacy team to develop plans that align with the goals of the specialty pharmacy organization.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for cross\-functional departments on how CMHCs align with specialty pharmacy organizations for cross\-functional departments.
* Align specialty pharmacy organizations with large mental health clinics based on the mental health clinics’ needs and goals.
* Work closely with internal Teva departments such as Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain to address customer needs and resolve any issues promptly.
* Identify and provide training and education to key account stakeholders, including healthcare professionals and staff, to ensure proper product utilization and patient care.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of key account relationships and regularly report progress to senior management.
* Gather feedback from key accounts and use it to continuously improve products and services as well as to address any concerns or issues.
* Collaborate with payers and government bodies to secure product access and reimbursement for psychiatric treatments.
* Perform all functions in compliance with Teva’s policies and procedures.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------



Any equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience that fulfills the requirements of the position will be considered.


Education/Certification/Experience:  

* Bachelor’s degree required
* Minimum of 5 years of Biotech / Pharma experience including customer\-facing responsibility. Psychiatric therapeutic areas strongly preferred
* Successful track record of achieving sales goals
* Experience in pertinent settings of care (e.g. CHMCs, private practice, specialty pharmacy) and thorough understanding of reimbursement coverage and pull\-through strategies
**Also Good to Have**
---------------------



Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

* Ability to interact with customers in live and virtual environments and proficiency with technology
* Understanding of the buy\-and\-bill model
* Leadership skills and ability to collaborate with multiple sales teams
* Proven written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills
* Valid US driver's license and acceptable driving record required
* Candidate must be able to successfully pass background, motor and drug screening
* Occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds


Additionally, U.S. new hires for customer facing roles will be required to complete all credentialing requirements for access to their customers’ targets within 60 days of their start date. Such credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, additional vaccinations and medical testing. Any request for an exception to the credentialing requirements will need to be approved by the national sales leader within the first 60 days of employment.


TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS


Selected candidate must be able to travel regularly throughout the assigned area and attend meetings at both Teva offices and off\-site locations through the US and periodically internationally as required.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

* Use a computer, including participating in face to face video meetings on camera
* Sit or stand for extended periods of time
* Travel as required, which may include travel by car, train,

new_jobs.description:
***Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.***


We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.


Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

**Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –****Apply Now**

**Get to Know the Opportunity:**
--------------------------------


Benefitfocus, a Voya company, is a leading provider of cloud\-based benefits software solutions for consumers, employers, insurance carriers, and brokers. Our integrated platform enables clients to shop, enroll, manage, and exchange benefits information more efficiently through a consumer\-centric experience.


The Client Relationship Manager (CRM) is responsible for developing high\-trust relationships with Benefitfocus Health Plan customers, measured through customer satisfaction, relationship health, and customer retention. This role provides continuity across all stages of the customer lifecycle and serves as a strategic partner focused on helping customers achieve desired business outcomes while maximizing the value of their Benefitfocus solutions.

***This role is fully remote, with no regular in\-office requirement.***
