new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Hospitality Included**

Brands: Adalina Italian \| Adalina Prime \| ARLAReports to: Marketing Director

About Hospitality Included:

Hospitality Included is a growing restaurant group behind some of Chicago’s most distinctive dining concepts, including Adalina Italian, Adalina Prime, and ARLA.

We are looking for a creative, organized, and digitally savvy Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our team and work directly with the Marketing Director across our portfolio of restaurant brands.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who understands how great hospitality brands show up online. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable creating an Instagram Reel, coordinating a photoshoot, building an email campaign, updating a restaurant website, and reviewing performance data to understand what is working.

You should have a strong eye for content, an understanding of social media culture, excellent attention to detail, and a genuine interest in restaurants, hospitality, food, nightlife, and lifestyle brands.

What You’ll DoSocial Media \& Content Creation

* Help manage the day\-to\-day social media presence of Hospitality Included and its restaurant concepts.
* Create compelling photo and video content for social media, including Instagram Reels, Stories, TikTok content, behind\-the\-scenes footage, food and beverage content, events, chef features, and lifestyle\-focused content.
* Capture high\-quality smartphone photography and short\-form video content at restaurant locations.
* Edit short\-form video for Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms.
* Assist in developing monthly social media content calendars for each brand.
* Write engaging, brand\-appropriate social media copy and captions.
* Schedule and publish social content across platforms.
* Monitor trends, sounds, formats, and emerging opportunities across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.
* Maintain consistency with each restaurant's individual visual identity, tone of voice, and brand standards.
* Organize and maintain photo, video, graphic, and other digital asset libraries.

Community Management

* Monitor comments, direct messages, tags, mentions, and guest\-generated content across social channels.
* Engage with followers and guests in a timely, brand\-appropriate manner.
* Identify opportunities to repost or amplify user\-generated content.
* Escalate guest service issues or sensitive comments to the appropriate restaurant or marketing leadership.
* Help cultivate relationships with loyal guests, creators, influencers, and members of the local hospitality community.

Influencer \& Creator Marketing

* Research relevant local influencers, food creators, lifestyle personalities, and potential brand partners.
* Assist with influencer outreach, reservations, gifting, hosted dining experiences, and campaign coordination.
* Track influencer visits, posts, reach, engagement, and resulting content.
* Maintain organized influencer and creator databases.
* Identify high\-quality user\-generated content and potential creator partnerships.

Email \& CRM Marketing

* Assist with the development and execution of restaurant email marketing campaigns.
* Build and schedule newsletters, promotional emails, event announcements, and other guest communications.
* Coordinate creative assets, copy, links, reservation CTAs, and audience segmentation.
* Maintain email lists and help identify opportunities to grow each restaurant's guest database.
* Monitor email performance, including opens, clicks, conversions, and list growth.

Website \& Digital Presence

* Assist with maintaining restaurant websites and ensuring menus, hours, events, promotions, photography, and other information remain accurate and current.
* Coordinate website updates with internal teams and outside partners when necessary.
* Help maintain accurate information across Google Business Profiles, reservation platforms, review platforms, directories, and other restaurant discovery channels.
* Support local SEO and search visibility initiatives.
* Review restaurant listings regularly to ensure brand consistency and accuracy across digital platforms.

Restaurant Marketing

* Support marketing campaigns surrounding menu launches, seasonal promotions, holidays, special events, private dining, partnerships, and restaurant openings.
* Work closely with restaurant operators, chefs, beverage teams, and leadership to identify stories and moments worth promoting.
* Assist with the creation of in\-restaurant marketing materials, menus, signage, promotional collateral, and digital assets.
* Coordinate marketing needs across multiple restaurant locations and concepts.
* Help execute partnerships, events, activations, and local marketing initiatives.
* Attend restaurant events and important service periods when content capture or marketing support is required.

Photography, Video \& Creative Production

* Assist in planning and coordinating professional photo and video shoots.
* Develop shot lists and organize products, dishes, talent, and locations for shoots.
* Capture supplemental content independently between professional shoots.
* Perform basic photo and video editing for digital channels.
* Work with graphic designers, photographers, videographers, agencies, and other creative partners when needed.
* Ensure creative assets are properly formatted for each digital channel.

Reporting \& Analytics

* Track social media, website, email, and campaign performance.
* Prepare recurring marketing performance reports for the Marketing Director.
* Monitor KPIs including reach, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, email performance, reservations, and campaign conversions.
* Identify high\-performing content and emerging trends.
* Provide recommendations based on performance data and audience behavior.
* Assist with competitive research and monitoring other restaurant, hospitality, food, and lifestyle brands.

Paid Media Support

* Assist the Marketing Director

new_jobs.title: Group Sales Coordinator - The Ritz-Carlton
new_jobs.description:
**Why us?**

Iconic architecture, a thriving culinary scene, beautifully landscaped public spaces and an array of museums are just part of what draws visitors to the Windy City. At The Ritz\-Carlton, Chicago, a luxury hotel set atop Water Tower Place in the historic Gold Coast, guests will have every chance to explore the city, from shopping along Michigan Avenue to viewing famous works at the Art Institute. Yet with our hotel’s spa, rooftop lounge, locally inspired restaurant, indoor lap pool and spacious accommodations overlooking the city, guests may not want to leave the premises.


The Ladies \& Gentlemen in Salesare dedicated to creating meaningful relationships and delivering exceptional experiences for our guests and clients. As aGroup Sales Coordinator, you will provide essential support to the Group Sales team by coordinating sales activities, maintaining accurate client and group information, preparing proposals and correspondence, and assisting with the details that move each group from initial inquiry through arrival. You will communicate professionally with clients and internal partners while anticipating needs and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and precision. Working closely with Sales, Catering, Conference Services, Front Office and other hotel departments, you will help create a seamless experience that exceeds expectations and builds lasting client relationships.


Recognized as “the gold standard” of hospitality, The Ritz\-Carlton selects only the most passionate and skilled hospitality professionals. As one of our Ladies and Gentlemen, you will reflect the values that make us the world’s finest luxury brand. Here, in a diverse environment where individual aspirations are fulfilled and quality of life is enhanced, you will be inspired to work alongside your fellow employees to bring special moments to life for our guests and each other. Through your organization, attention to detail, responsiveness and commitment to excellence, you will play an important role in supporting our sales team, strengthening client partnerships and creating Ritz\-Carlton guests for life.


**Job Overview**

Assist sales managers in obtaining customer satisfaction by performing clerical and administrative duties relating to guest and hotel communications and sales. Responds to telephone and in\-person inquiries regarding reservations, hotel information and guest concerns.


**Responsibilities**

* Answer sales office phones when sales staff not available. Respond to all sales inquiries accurately, timely and in a professional manner.
* Type correspondence, reports and necessary forms i.e. contracts, as well as prepare proposals or other letters as directed.
* Coordination of all group and wedding business as contracted by the sales manager/DOS. Contact and provide appropriate follow\-up on all signed/contracted business within five (5\) working days. Determine and coordinate all needs of the customer.
* Responsible for effectively communicating with the various departments to ensure that the meeting and related functions are executed to exceed the client’s expectations.
* Account Service and Management: Maintains well documented, accurate, organized and up\-to\-date file management in order to serve client and employer in the most expedient, organized and knowledgeable manner.
* Develops strong customer relationships through appropriate client communication and the use of professional, courteous and ethical interpersonal interaction.
* Work with sales personnel to achieve required sales team goals.
* Have current knowledge of hotel rates, strategies, discounts and promotions.
* Assist with completing any required sales reports.
* Develop and effective communication and information system with the hotel team to disseminate details of upcoming group, meeting events and special events in the primary marketing area.
* Assist hotel with implementing hotel specific selling strategies.
* Promptly, the same day or by 10am the next business day, follows\-up on all customers’ needs and inquires in an efficient and expedient manner.
* Represents themselves and the hotel with the highest level of integrity and professionalism, a service focused approach and a caring, sincere attitude at all times.
* Exhibits a positive and involved team attitude to all hotel departments and maintains open communication with all co\-workers for the best overall performance of the hotel.
* Display a neat, clean and business\-like appearance at all times.
* Creates monthly social hour calendar with the Director of Sales.
* Assists the Sales department with monthly luncheons, client events, etc.
* Conduct walk\-in tours
* Create gift bags for guest traces, VIP’s, Hug’s, etc. Keep supplies stocked and on hand.
* Work with EBC on all group turnover and proper execution of the groups.

**Qualifications**

**Education/Formal Training**

High school diploma or vocational secretarial.


**Experience**

Previous sales, hospitality, and secretarial experience preferred.


**Knowledge/Skills**

* Advanced knowledge/use of Microsoft Word applications: Word, Excel, Publisher and PowerPoint.
* Alphabetizing, grammar and punctuation skills.
* Standard business letter formats.
* Strong editing skills.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


* Excellent communication skills necessary to communicate clearly with customers and other departments by phone or in person.
* Able to read contracts and letters.
* Able to use computers.
* Excellent attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills.
* Bending/kneeling \- repeated bending and kneeling required while filing
* Mobility \- must be able to reach all areas of hotel to assist clients. Occasional standing. Occasional carrying

**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**


Transforming the insurance industry is ambitious, we know. That’s why at Applied, we’re building a team that shows up every day ready to learn, willing to try new things, and driven to deliver innovative software and services that make us indispensable to our customers – all within a culture built on values that make us indispensable to each other too. With 40\+ years of experience in the Insurtech game, we’re not just redefining what’s achievable, we’re creating a place where amazing career moments are made possible. **Position Overview**  

Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for an **Account Manager** within our Inside Sales Team organization. In this role, you will work towards a quota within a defined territory, calling named clients, the Inside Account Manager is responsible for achieving sales goals by working with existing customers currently leveraging our legacy platforms. Driving conversations through proactive account engagement efforts as well as responding to inbound customer requests. Determine platform compatibility by matching agency profiles and business needs to capabilities of one of our modern, digital platforms. The Associate Account Manager will be compensated in part by base and variable pay as defined in the Compensation Plan distributed annually.  

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Sell, primarily via telephone and zoom, agencies within the assigned territory to meet/exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals by utilizing Solution Selling guidelines.
* Creates demand through regularly scheduled outbound calling efforts to prospective clients to fully understand key business objectives and apply applicable products and/or services.
* Follows up with agencies on specific marketing campaign, leads, and other marketing driven activities.
* Works creatively to identify new sales opportunities to consistently keep the sales funnel full.

* Negotiate and close opportunities.
* Provide management with accurate and timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales forecasts.

new_jobs.title: ILUS - Associate Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview:
**About Us**
Daifuku Intralogistics America Corporation is a leading provider of intelligent material handling systems. With hundreds of engineers in\-house, the company designs, manufactures, integrates, and installs a full spectrum of intralogistics solutions to meet client needs. These include leading\-edge conveyor and sortation systems, voice\- and light\-directed order fulfillment equipment, a suite of warehouse controls \& execution software, robotics, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), mezzanines, and structures, all backed by critical round\-the\-clock service and support.  

If you want to join a team of industry leading experts who want to create an impact on the future of material handling solutions, we want to hear from you! **Job Summary**
The A**ssociate Project Manager** is a structured development role designed to build a pipeline of future Project Managers capable of leading complex material handling automation projects. Under the guidance of experienced Project Managers, this role develops hands\-on capability across planning, execution, commissioning, customer acceptance and financial delivery for projects involving conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, ASRS, controls, software, and warehouse technologies.  

Through structured mentoring, field assignments, training and increasing project responsibility, the Associate Project Manager will build the technical, financial, operational and leadership skills with the goal of developing readiness to independently manage projects and customer relationships, typically within 12–24 months, based on demonstrated performance and business needs.  

To accelerate learning and broaden industry experience, the Associate Project Manager will complete travel\-intensive field assignments across customer sites and project locations. These assignments provide exposure to multiple project types, technologies, installation methods, startup activities, operational readiness initiatives and customer acceptance processes.  

This position serves as the entry point into the Project Management career track. Success will be measured by demonstrated readiness to assume Project Manager responsibilities, with opportunities for continued advancement based on performance, experience, and business needs..  


Responsibilities:
**Project Execution**  

* Support planning, execution, commissioning and closeout of automation projects involving conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, ASRS systems, racking, controls and software integrations.
* Assist with project schedules, budget tracking, cost control, forecasting, risk management, reporting, procurement and contract administration.
* Coordinate activities among engineering, software, operations, procurement, installation teams, suppliers and customers.
* Track and drive project milestones, action items, risks, issues and change requests.
* Support change management, project controls, and financial reporting activities.
* Promote compliance with company, customer and site\-specific safety requirements during all project activities.
 **Customer \& Vendor Coordination**  

* Prepare and deliver clear project status reports, presentations and updates for customers, vendors, internal stakeholders and customer leadership.
* Communicate project progress, risks, issues, decisions and recommended actions clearly in both written and verbal formats, supporting timely issue resolution and stakeholder alignment.
* Build effective working relationships with customers, suppliers, subcontractors and internal stakeholders.
* Support vendor management and supplier performance activities.
 **Commissioning \& Operational Readiness**  

* Assist with installation, startup, commissioning and customer acceptance testing.
* Support operational readiness planning and project closeout activities.
 **Professional Development**  

* Progressively assume ownership of defined project scope, schedule, financials, field execution and customer\-facing activities.
* Develop competencies aligned with the Daifuku Project Management Skills Matrix, mentoring plan, field rotation requirements and career progression framework.
* Demonstrate readiness for promotion through milestone\-based evaluations covering technical knowledge, customer communication, project controls and leadership capability.
* Build the communication skills required to present project status, risks, financial performance, and recovery plans confidently and effectively to customer and company leadership.
 **Travel Requirements**  

* Ability to travel extensively (up to 80%) to customer and project sites, including occasional evenings and weekends, to support installation, commissioning, customer go\-live and closeout activities.
* Open to temporary relocation within the United States for 12–24 months, including the possibility of sequential assignments at multiple project locations, to support major program and project site needs.
* Relocation assistance may be provided when required, in accordance with company policy and assignment terms.

Qualifications: **Required**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is strongly preferred, Degrees in Project Management, Construction Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain or a related field may also be considered when supported by relevant technical background.
* 0\-3 years of experience in project coordination, engineering, construction, logistics, or industrial automation environments.
* Valid driver's license.
 **Preferred**  

* Internship, co\-op, or project support experience.
* Exposure to automation, warehouse operations, manufacturing, or construction.
* Experience with Microsoft Project or similar scheduling tools.
* CAPM certification or interest in pursuing PMP or similar project management certification.
* Japanese language skills are a plus.
 **Characteristics of Successful Candidates**  

* Strong leadership potential and initiative.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**What You Can Expect**



As our Sale Representative I, you will support ENGIE’s growth objectives by identifying, developing, and converting new Commercial \& Industrial (C\&I) customer opportunities within the PJM market. The Sale Representative I will be responsible for building a qualified sales pipeline, cultivating strong customer relationships, and delivering energy solutions aligned with customers’ business objectives. Working closely with sales leadership and cross\-functional teams, the Sale Representative I will develop expertise in retail electricity markets while contributing to regional sales growth, customer acquisition, and retention objectives.



This role serves as an entry point into ENGIE’s commercial sales organization and offers a structured pathway for professional development and advancement within the sales function.

  



 Key Accountabilities:


* Sales \& Customer Acquisition
* Support the sales process from opportunity identification through contract execution
* Present ENGIE's energy solutions and value proposition to prospective customers
* Assist in developing competitive proposals that meet customer requirements
* Work collaboratively with internal teams to facilitate pricing requests, contract generation, and onboarding activities
* Achieve individual sales goals related to customer acquisition, gross margin, and contracted volume

  



Relationship Management


* Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective customers, existing customers, and channel partners
* Deliver a high level of professionalism and customer service throughout the sales process
* Support customer retention efforts by identifying opportunities for renewals and additional ENGIE services

  



Market Awareness \& Product Knowledge


* Develop an understanding of retail electricity, customer buying behaviors, and competitive offerings
* Remain informed on market conditions, industry developments, and sustainability trends relevant to customers
* Participate in ongoing training and development programs to build sales and industry expertise

  



Compliance \& Governance


* Adhere to ENGIE's ethics, compliance, safety, and governance requirements
* Maintain accurate and complete customer, activity, and opportunity records within CRM systems
* Follow established approval processes, sales controls, and risk management frameworks

  


**What You’ll Bring**

* You are knowledgeable in Microsoft Office applications and CRM platforms, with the ability to quickly learn new products, systems, and processes and apply strong commercial acumen to customer opportunities
* You are committed to a high standard of performance, with strong presentation and negotiation skills, the ability to motivate yourself and others, and a commitment to continuous learning, improvement, and professional development

  


**Additional Details**


* This role is eligible for our hybrid work policy, allowing for a mix of remote work and in\-office presence

* Must possess a valid U.S. driver’s license/clean driving record for travel and car rentals

Business Development Representative  


*\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_\_**\_*  


DEPARTMENT: Field Sales  


REPORTS TO: Director of Business Development  


FLSA: Exempt (Salary \+ Bonus)  


Schedule: Monday\-Friday, 8am\-5pm (Remote with travel)  


Territory: Illinois (Focus on Chicago Metropolitan area)  


Note: We do not provide employment\-based visa sponsorship or transfers for any position  


Why You Should Join Us!  


A comprehensive health plan that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage to ensure you and your family have access to the care you need  
A 401(k)\-retirement plan with a generous company match to help you save for your future and achieve your financial goals  
Other fringe benefits including Birthday \& Anniversary bonus, company\-wide discounts, life insurance, Telemedicine access, short \& long\-term disability, and more!  
Positive work environments that offer work/life balance and professional growth  
Mission\-driven work making a global impact with local roots  
The opportunity to have hands on work experience with industry leading, innovative technology  


Position Summary  


Smart Start is seeking a highly motivated, competitive, and relationship\-driven Business Development Representative to expand market presence and develop strategic influencer partnerships within an assigned territory.  


This is a primarily field\-based sales role focused on building strong, in\-person relationships with key influencers, government officials, and referral sources who drive end users to utilize Smart Start alcohol monitoring and ignition interlock products. The ideal candidate thrives in face\-to\-face selling environments and is energized by developing new business through personal interaction and full territory ownership.  


Essential Duties and Responsibilities  


Establish, develop, and maintain strong in\-person relationships with current and prospective influencers within assigned territory  
Generate new sales through proactive outreach, structured territory planning, and relationship cultivation  
Expand product market share by identifying and developing new referral sources  
Evaluate influencer needs and build productive, long\-term partnerships that drive consistent lead generation  
Provide technical expertise and consultative support to government officials and referral partners  
Educate partners on product functionality, reporting platforms, and compliance features  
Attend trade shows, industry conferences, and state\-level meetings related to alcohol monitoring and ignition interlock programs  
Serve as a territory expert on state regulations, impaired driving laws, ignition interlock requirements, and alcohol monitoring standards  
Develop and execute competitive sales strategies tailored to local market dynamics  
Gather market intelligence to maintain Smart Start’s competitive advantage  
Maintain proficiency in Smart Start products, CRM systems, and monitoring platforms  
Conduct consistent face\-to\-face meetings to strengthen referral pipelines and territory growth  


Core Competencies  


Strong relationship\-building and in\-person engagement skills  
Competitive drive with high levels of initiative and accountability  
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills  
Ability to deliver clear, confident, and effective sales presentations  
Business and territory management acumen  
Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities  
Proficiency in sales communication tools (email, text, phone, social media, CRM)  
Strong organizational and time management skills  
Industry knowledge related to alcohol monitoring and ignition interlock programs  


Qualifications  


Required  


MUST reside in Illinois, within commutable distance to Chicago Metropolitan area  
Proven experience in sales or business development  
Ability to work independently in a field\-based environment  
Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills  
Ability to demonstrate and utilize breath alcohol testing devices on a continual basis  
Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a motor vehicle  


Highly Preferred  


Experience in impaired driving, ignition interlock, or alcohol monitoring programs  
Associate or Bachelor’s degree  


Work Environment \& Travel  


Field\-Based Role: Approximately 80% of time spent in the field developing and managing influencer relationships  
Overnight Travel: Approximately 40%, including occasional weekend travel for conferences and industry events  


Technical Skills  


Above\-average computer proficiency  
Experience with Microsoft Office Suite  
CRM and proprietary software system experience  


Physical Demands \& Work Environment  


The physical demands and work environment described below are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  


Regularly required to communicate verbally and hear.  
Frequently required to use hands and fingers to handle or feel objects, tools, or controls.  
Occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.  
Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.  
Requires close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.  
The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
